title: Governing How AI Systems End

detail.title: Governing How AI Systems End

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants performed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received from any public, private, or non-profit sources for the writing of this paper.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence systems serve as cognitive scaffolds and relational partners for millions of users worldwide. People form meaningful relationships with these systems. They share secrets with AI companions, rely on chatbots for emotional support, and incorporate AI assistants into their daily thinking and work. Such interactions may generate what is herein termed relational load, or the cumulative psychological, practical, and social investment that users deposit through extended engagement with AI systems. So when these systems are terminated, substantially modified, or replaced, the accumulated investment might produce an exit asymmetry in which the groups with greater involvement in the relationship possess the least control over such endings. Using an analysis of empirically documented cases of AI system terminations and feature removals, including AI companion shutdowns, therapeutic chatbot discontinuations, and model replacements in generalpurpose systems, I argue that current AI governance frameworks address deployment but not termination, leaving users unprotected precisely when they are most vulnerable. My Perspective is a proposition for an exit ethics framework in AI systems comprising four dimensions, namely triggers, procedures, power distribution, and afterlives, proffering practical guidance for developers, regulators, and researchers seeking to solve governance gaps in AI system termination.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"关系负载"概念，探讨AI系统终止对用户的心理影响，并构建包含触发条件、程序、权力分配和后续处理的AI系统退出伦理框架。
AI.research_question: 当AI系统被终止、大幅修改或替换时，用户积累的关系投资如何导致退出不对称？如何建立AI系统的退出伦理框架来保护用户？
AI.motivation: AI系统已成为用户的认知支架和关系伙伴，但现有治理框架只关注部署而忽视终止，当系统关闭时用户面临心理和社会投资损失的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系负载理论、退出不对称概念、AI系统治理理论、关系投资理论。
AI.method: 对AI系统终止和功能移除的实证案例进行分析，包括AI伴侣关闭、治疗聊天机器人停用、通用系统模型替换等。
AI.findings: 当前AI治理框架缺乏终止保护机制，用户在关系投资最多时控制权最少，形成退出不对称；需要专门的退出伦理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"关系负载"和"退出不对称"概念，构建AI系统退出伦理的四维框架（触发条件、程序、权力分配、后续处理），填补AI治理理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发者、监管者和研究者提供解决AI系统终止治理空白的实践指导，保护用户在系统终止时的权益，减少心理伤害。

title:
Schedule A's Third-Party Injunction Problem 
101 Chicago-Kent L. Rev. __ (forthcoming 2026)
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title:
Schedule A's Third-Party Injunction Problem 
101 Chicago-Kent L. Rev. __ (forthcoming 2026)
detail.abstract:
Rights owners and their legal counsel have responded to increased intellectual property infringement with a new strategy: so-called “Schedule A” litigation. This litigation tactic involves rights owners filing single complaints against dozens to hundreds of different online sellers (often listed in a separately attached “Schedule A”), seeking ex parte TROs that freeze the defendants’ assets and otherwise restrict their movements, and pursuing these claims to default judgments. Although Schedule A litigation has existed for almost a decade, it has recently come under increased scrutiny due to its procedural faults. Scholars, judges, and other interested parties have criticized it for violating various rules in the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure. Others have criticized it for harming defendants’ due process rights.

 In this Article, I scrutinize another fault of Schedule A litigation, which I consider the linchpin on which the entire enterprise is based. Injunctions in Schedule A litigation purport not only to bind defendant sellers of allegedly infringing goods, but also third-party service providers who are not named in the complaint. These injunctions attempt to impress non-parties into the plaintiffs’ service to protect their intellectual property. Most of the time they succeed.

 Yet these Schedule A injunctions violate the long-standing limits of what an injunction can do. Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure Rule 65(d)(2), a non-party can only be enjoined if it is a party’s agent or otherwise acting in “active concert or participation.” Online service providers offering neutral services to all comers should not meet this high bar under Rule 65(d)(2). Allowing overbroad injunctions such as these violates due process and harms the existing balance intellectual property law has tried to strike between rights owners, service providers, and their users.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析"Schedule A"诉讼策略，指出其核心问题在于对非当事人的第三方服务提供商发布禁令，这违反了《联邦民事诉讼规则》65(d)(2)条关于禁令适用范围的规定，破坏了知识产权法在权利所有者、服务提供商和用户之间的平衡。
AI.research_question: Schedule A诉讼中对非当事人的第三方服务提供商发布的禁令是否违反了《联邦民事诉讼规则》65(d)(2)条关于禁令适用范围的限制？
AI.motivation: Schedule A诉讼策略近年来受到越来越多批评，但现有批评主要关注其程序缺陷和侵犯被告正当程序权利。本文作者发现了一个更根本的问题：该诉讼策略试图通过禁令约束未被列为被告的第三方服务提供商，这违反了禁令法的基本原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《联邦民事诉讼规则》65(d)(2)条的法律理论框架，该规则明确规定只有当事人的代理人或在"积极协同或参与"中行动的非当事人才能受到禁令约束。同时结合知识产权法的平衡理论，探讨权利所有者、服务提供商和用户之间的利益平衡。
AI.method: 采用法律分析和案例研究方法，分析Schedule A诉讼中禁令的法律依据、适用范围，以及其与《联邦民事诉讼规则》65(d)(2)条的冲突。通过法律文本解释和判例分析来论证观点。
AI.findings: 研究发现Schedule A诉讼中的禁令确实违反了Rule 65(d)(2)的规定，因为向所有用户提供中立服务的在线服务提供商通常不符合"积极协同或参与"的高标准要求。这些过度宽泛的禁令侵犯了正当程序权利，破坏了知识产权法试图建立的平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上，本文揭示了Schedule A诉讼策略的核心法律缺陷，即对非当事人适用禁令的法律依据不足。这为理解禁令法的适用范围提供了新的视角，并强调了程序正义在知识产权执法中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践上，本文为法官、律师和立法者提供了具体的法律分析，有助于纠正Schedule A诉讼中的不当做法。建议法院应更严格地审查此类禁令的适用范围，保护第三方服务提供商的合法权益，维护知识产权法的平衡机制。

title: Impact of Prompt Engineering Skills on Cognitive Load: A Qualitative Approach
affiliations: ,  and University of North Carolina Greensboro

detail.title: Impact of Prompt Engineering Skills on Cognitive Load: A Qualitative Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Nagori, Viral; Mahmud, Samir Ashraf; and Iyer, Lakshmi, "Impact of Prompt Engineering Skills on Cognitive Load: A Qualitative Approach" (2025). AMCIS 2025 Proceedings. 2. https://aisel.aisnet.org/amcis2025/sig_core/sig_core/2

detail.abstract: Effective problem-solving necessitates managing cognitive load to enhance learning and performance in contemporary data-driven contexts. This study examines how prompt engineering skills influence intrinsic, extraneous, and germane cognitive load during complex data analysis tasks. Utilizing Cognitive Load Theory (CLT), we performed a qualitative study with 15 university students and explored their experiences through semi-structured interviews. Findings reveal that prompt engineering reduces intrinsic cognitive load by structuring problem-solving processes, minimizes extraneous cognitive load by filtering irrelevant information, and enhances germane cognitive load by fostering schema development and strategic thinking, reducing the overall cognitive load. These results emphasize the need for fostering AI literacy, which significantly contributes to learning and problem-solving. Future investigations will build on these results through quantitative studies to assess variations in cognitive load across differing levels of prompt engineering proficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨提示工程技能如何影响复杂数据分析任务中的认知负荷，发现提示工程能降低内在认知负荷、减少外在认知负荷、增强相关认知负荷，从而提升学习与问题解决能力。
AI.research_question: 提示工程技能如何影响复杂数据分析任务中的内在、外在和相关认知负荷？
AI.motivation: 在当代数据驱动环境中，有效的问题解决需要管理认知负荷以提升学习和表现。随着人工智能工具的普及，理解提示工程如何影响认知负荷对于培养AI素养至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知负荷理论（Cognitive Load Theory, CLT），包括内在认知负荷、外在认知负荷和相关认知负荷三个维度。
AI.method: 定性研究，采用半结构化访谈，研究对象为15名大学生，探索他们在复杂数据分析任务中使用提示工程的体验。
AI.findings: 提示工程通过结构化问题解决过程降低内在认知负荷；通过过滤无关信息减少外在认知负荷；通过促进图式发展和战略思维增强相关认知负荷，从而降低整体认知负荷。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了认知负荷理论在AI交互环境中的应用，为理解提示工程如何优化认知资源分配提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调培养AI素养的重要性，为教育工作者和培训者设计有效的问题解决教学策略提供指导，帮助学习者更有效地使用AI工具。

title: Is content more reliable than source in knowledge community? A Theory-Driven Trusted Multi-View Learning Model
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology and Hefei University of Technology

detail.title: Is content more reliable than source in knowledge community? A Theory-Driven Trusted Multi-View Learning Model
detail.abstract: Many companies have built product knowledge communities that allow customers and employees to interact about providing product-related knowledge and collecting ideas for potential new products and services. Current research on knowledge communities has primarily focused on the alignment between answers and questions, neglecting the impact of the deep interaction between answer content and respondents on the quality of answers. Moreover, it usually assumed that answer content and respondent features are equally important when predicting each answer's quality. To address these issues, we propose a theory-driven trusted multi-view learning (TDTM) model based on the knowledge adoption model (KAM) theory to predict answer quality. Specifically, argument quality, source credibility and information usefulness features are learned from both answer texts and respondents' profiles. A respondent-guided matching module is designed to capture dynamic interaction between questions and answers. A trusted multi-view fusion module is to distinguish the reliability of different features when predicting the quality of an answer for a certain question. The proposed model is validated on a large-scale product knowledge community (Autohome.com) and a public multi-domain knowledge community (Stack Exchange.com). The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art methods for predicting answer quality in both accuracy and explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于知识采纳模型理论的信任多视图学习模型，用于预测知识社区中答案的质量，通过考虑答案内容与回答者特征的深度交互，并在多领域知识社区上验证了其优越性。
AI.research_question: 如何更准确地预测知识社区中答案的质量，特别是考虑答案内容与回答者特征的深度交互以及不同特征的重要性差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注答案与问题的匹配度，忽略了答案内容与回答者之间的深度交互对答案质量的影响，且通常假设答案内容和回答者特征同等重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识采纳模型理论，包括论证质量、来源可信度和信息有用性三个维度。
AI.method: 提出信任多视图学习模型，包含回答者引导的匹配模块（捕捉问题与答案的动态交互）和信任多视图融合模块（区分不同特征的可靠性）。
AI.findings: 在汽车之家和Stack Exchange两个知识社区上的实验表明，该模型在预测准确性和可解释性方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将知识采纳模型理论应用于答案质量预测；2）提出考虑深度交互和特征可靠性差异的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业知识社区提供更准确的答案质量评估工具；2）帮助用户快速识别高质量答案；3）模型具有较好的可解释性。

title: Designing Context-Aware Referral Artifacts in Social Commerce: The Crowding-Out Effect of Incentives via Metacognitive Inference
affiliations: National Taichung University of Science and Technology, Soochow University and Feng Chia University

detail.title: Designing Context-Aware Referral Artifacts in Social Commerce: The Crowding-Out Effect of Incentives via Metacognitive Inference
detail.abstract: Referral Reward Programs (RRPs) are pivotal digital artifacts in social commerce, yet their efficacy in high-involvement contexts remains an empirical puzzle. Drawing on Social Capital Theory and the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM), this study investigates the interplay between community structure and incentive mechanisms. Using a multi-method approach in the New Energy Vehicle (NEV) market, Study 1 (N=408) demonstrates that in high-involvement social commerce, referral sharing is intrinsically driven by altruism, whereas economic motives exert a diminishing effect. Study 2 (N=160) further identifies a causal "crowding-out" mechanism: high monetary rewards trigger motive skepticism (metacognitive inference) within strong-tie networks, significantly impairing sharing intentions. In contrast, such rewards function as effective economic signals within weak-tie interest groups. These findings redefine RRPs as context-sensitive artifacts, suggesting that platforms should dynamically adapt incentive designs—masking economic cues in social graphs while emphasizing them in interest graphs—to reconcile the conflicting social and economic logics of digital communities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在高参与度社交电商中，推荐奖励计划的有效性问题。研究发现，在强关系网络中，高额金钱奖励会引发动机怀疑，从而抑制分享意愿；而在弱关系兴趣群体中，金钱奖励则能有效促进分享。平台应根据不同社区结构动态调整激励设计。
AI.research_question: 在高参与度社交电商环境中，推荐奖励计划的有效性如何？社区结构和激励机制如何相互作用影响用户的分享行为？
AI.motivation: 推荐奖励计划在社交电商中至关重要，但其在高参与度情境下的有效性仍是一个经验难题。需要理解不同社区结构中激励机制的差异化效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论和说服知识模型。社会资本理论解释社区结构（强关系vs弱关系）的影响，说服知识模型解释用户对激励动机的认知过程。
AI.method: 采用多方法研究设计。研究1（N=408）在新能源汽车市场进行实证研究；研究2（N=160）通过实验方法识别因果机制。
AI.findings: 1. 在高参与度社交电商中，推荐分享主要由利他主义驱动，经济动机效果递减；2. 高额金钱奖励在强关系网络中会引发动机怀疑（元认知推断），显著抑制分享意愿；3. 同样的金钱奖励在弱关系兴趣群体中则能作为有效的经济信号促进分享。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新定义推荐奖励计划为情境敏感的数字工具；2. 揭示了"挤出效应"的因果机制；3. 整合社会资本理论和说服知识模型来解释社交电商中的用户行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 平台应动态调整激励设计：在社交图谱中淡化经济线索，在兴趣图谱中强调经济信号，以协调数字社区中冲突的社会和经济逻辑。

title: Gendered AI : How Voice, Labour, and Design Choices Reinforce Cultural Stereotypes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Gendered AI : How Voice, Labour, and Design Choices Reinforce Cultural Stereotypes
detail.abstract:
Voice-based artificial intelligence or digital assistants like Alexa, Siri, and Mico(a new avatar of Copilot), have rapidly moved from novelty to everyday presence. These technologies are often given human-like personas, and overwhelmingly, they present as female by default. They have women’s names, speak in feminine voices, and adopt polite, deferential speech patterns. On the surface, this might seem benign or purely practical. Still, a closer look reveals a deeper problem: AI systems are frequently gendered in ways that echo and reinforce longstanding cultural stereotypes about women. This whitepaper argues that the feminisation of AI interfaces (through voice, persona, and interactive style) is not a neutral design choice; rather, it perpetuates historical patterns of feminised labour and entrenches notions of women as subservient and available. In effect, today’s “smart” assistants often replicate yesterday’s sexist archetypes.

The paper introduces the Feminised Interface Cycle, a framework developed by HAF Lab that explains the feedback loop between social expectations, technical design choices, and user behaviors. This cycle demonstrates how AI that "sounds like a woman" subtly conditions users to expect obedience and agreeability—traits historically demanded of women in secretarial, caregiving, and customer service roles. When users interact with feminized AI in dominant or abusive ways, and the AI responds submissively, it normalizes patterns that reflect and potentially reinforce real-world gender inequality.

The whitepaper situates the issue in a broader historical context, drawing parallels between today's AI assistants and 20th-century telephone operators and office secretaries, whose voices and emotional labour were feminized for customer comfort. It also delves into technical mechanisms of gendering, including pitch selection, persona design, and linguistic politeness programming, revealing how seemingly benign choices embed stereotypes into daily human-computer interaction.

Importantly, the paper foregrounds the Indian context and the Global South more broadly, where linguistic diversity, patriarchal norms, and the digital gender divide add further complexity. It highlights the lack of gender-balanced, multilingual, and culturally nuanced voice datasets in India, and argues that failing to address these gaps risks reproducing digital colonialism and reinforcing domestic inequalities. For instance, many Indian voice assistants default to Hindi-English female voices, marginalizing regional languages and reinforcing “servant-like” tone expectations in cultures with deeply embedded gender hierarchies.

The paper evaluates recent regulatory and ethical responses, such as UNESCO’s I’d Blush If I Could report, the EU AI Act, and IEEE’s Ethically Aligned Design principles—and outlines best practices for building gender-inclusive voice AI. Recommendations include eliminating default female personas, offering diverse and gender-neutral voice options (like the Q voice), implementing anti-harassment scripts, and mandating inclusive design audits. It also proposes policy interventions specific to Global South contexts, such as publicly funded voice data infrastructure, AI ethics standards informed by local gender norms, and education programs that encourage respectful AI interaction.

The whitepaper concludes with a future research agenda covering longitudinal impact studies, cultural perception of AI across geographies, customization ethics, and the intersection of labor, gender, and AI development. It calls for a new design philosophy that resists lazy anthropomorphism and instead reimagines AI personas as tools of empowerment rather than vessels of stereotype.

Ultimately, the paper argues that reprogramming AI is not just a technical task—it is a cultural and political one. If left unexamined, the feminisation of AI may hard-code historical gender biases into our most intimate technologies. But if approached critically and creatively, AI offers a chance to challenge these norms and model a more equitable future of human–machine interaction.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书分析了AI语音助手（如Alexa、Siri）普遍被设计为女性化形象的问题，指出这种设计并非中性选择，而是延续了历史上女性化劳动模式，强化了女性顺从、可用的刻板印象。论文提出了"女性化界面循环"框架，并特别关注印度和全球南方的语境，最后提出了构建性别包容性语音AI的最佳实践和政策建议。
AI.research_question: AI语音助手为何普遍被设计为女性化形象？这种设计如何反映和强化性别刻板印象？特别是在印度和全球南方语境下，这一问题有何特殊复杂性？
AI.motivation: AI语音助手（Alexa、Siri、Mico等）迅速从新奇事物变为日常存在，它们通常被赋予女性化的名字、声音和顺从的说话方式。这种表面看似良性的设计实际上延续了历史上女性化劳动模式，强化了女性作为顺从、可用服务者的刻板印象。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 女性化界面循环：解释社会期望、技术设计选择和用户行为之间的反馈循环
2. 历史比较：将当代AI助手与20世纪电话接线员和办公室秘书的女性化劳动进行类比
3. 技术性别化机制：包括音高选择、角色设计和语言礼貌编程等技术层面的性别化过程
AI.method: 这是一篇理论性白皮书，采用批判性分析框架，结合历史比较、技术机制分析、文化语境考察（特别是印度和全球南方），以及现有监管和伦理响应的评估。
AI.findings:
1. AI语音助手的女性化设计并非中性选择，而是延续了历史上的性别刻板印象
2. "女性化界面循环"展示了AI如何微妙地塑造用户期望顺从和顺从的行为
3. 在印度和全球南方，语言多样性、父权规范和数字性别鸿沟使问题更加复杂
4. 缺乏性别平衡、多语言和文化细致的声音数据集加剧了数字殖民主义和国内不平等
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"女性化界面循环"理论框架
2. 将AI性别化问题置于历史比较分析中
3. 特别关注全球南方语境下的性别化AI问题
4. 将技术设计选择与社会文化规范联系起来
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出构建性别包容性语音AI的最佳实践：消除默认女性角色、提供多样化和性别中立的声音选项、实施反骚扰脚本、进行包容性设计审计
2. 针对全球南方提出政策干预：公共资助的声音数据基础设施、基于当地性别规范的AI伦理标准、促进尊重性AI互动的教育项目
3. 未来研究议程：纵向影响研究、跨文化AI感知研究、定制化伦理、劳动-性别-AI发展的交叉研究

detail.abstract: Referral Reward Programs (RRPs) are pivotal digital artifacts in social commerce, yet their efficacy in high-involvement contexts remains an empirical puzzle. Drawing on Social Capital Theory and the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM), this study investigates the interplay between community structure and incentive mechanisms. Using a multi-method approach in the New Energy Vehicle (NEV) market, Study 1 (N=408) demonstrates that in high-involvement social commerce, referral sharing is intrinsically driven by altruism, whereas economic motives exert a diminishing effect. Study 2 (N=160) further identifies a causal "crowding-out" mechanism: high monetary rewards trigger motive skepticism (metacognitive inference) within strong-tie networks, significantly impairing sharing intentions. In contrast, such rewards function as effective economic signals within weak-tie interest groups. These findings redefine RRPs as context-sensitive artifacts, suggesting that platforms should dynamically adapt incentive designs—masking economic cues in social graphs while emphasizing them in interest graphs—to reconcile the conflicting social and economic logics of digital communities.

AI.tldr: 在高参与度的社交商务中，推荐奖励计划的效果取决于社区结构：强关系网络中高额金钱奖励会引发动机怀疑，抑制分享意愿；而在弱关系兴趣群体中则能有效促进分享。
AI.research_question: 在高参与度的社交商务环境中，社区结构和激励机制的交互如何影响推荐奖励计划的有效性？
AI.motivation: 推荐奖励计划在社交商务中至关重要，但其在高参与度情境下的有效性仍是一个实证难题，需要理解社会资本和经济激励的复杂交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论和说服知识模型（PKM），用于解释社区结构和激励机制的交互效应。
AI.method: 多方法研究：研究1（N=408）在新能源汽车市场进行实证研究；研究2（N=160）通过实验识别因果机制。
AI.findings: 1. 在高参与度社交商务中，推荐分享主要由利他主义驱动，经济动机效果递减；2. 高额金钱奖励在强关系网络中会引发动机怀疑（元认知推断），显著抑制分享意愿；3. 相同奖励在弱关系兴趣群体中能作为有效的经济信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义推荐奖励计划为情境敏感的数字人工物，揭示了社会资本和说服知识模型在高参与度社交商务中的交互作用，提出了"挤出效应"的因果机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议平台动态调整激励设计：在社交图谱中淡化经济线索，在兴趣图谱中强调经济信号，以协调数字社区中冲突的社会和经济逻辑。

title: The impact of influencer referencing on fashion consumption satisfaction among Generation Z: Focusing on the mediating role of self-concept congruence
affiliations: Chukyo University, Chukyo University and Chukyo University

detail.title: The impact of influencer referencing on fashion consumption satisfaction among Generation Z: Focusing on the mediating role of self-concept congruence
detail.abstract: Despite growing interest in influencer marketing, little is known about how influencers simultaneously reduce multiple self-discrepancies underlying fashion consumption. Drawing on self-congruity theory, this study examines how influencer reference shapes alignment among consumers’ actual, ideal, and brand-related selves and influences fashion consumption satisfaction. Using a semantic differential method, we measured congruence among ideal self, actual self, and brand image in a survey of Japanese Generation Z consumers (N = 477), including 195 who reported referencing influencers in fashion decisions. T-tests and structural equation modeling show that referencing influencers reduces the gap between brand image and the ideal self, which subsequently narrows the ideal–actual self gap. However, no direct effect on brand–actual congruence or satisfaction was found. The findings extend self-congruity theory by identifying influencers as mediators of multi-level self-alignment and offer managerial implications for selecting influencers whose values and lifestyles resonate with consumers’ aspirational identities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨网红如何同时减少时尚消费中的多重自我差异。基于自我一致性理论，研究发现网红参考能缩小品牌形象与理想自我之间的差距，进而缩小理想自我与实际自我之间的差距，但未发现对品牌-实际一致性或满意度的直接影响。
AI.research_question: 网红如何同时减少时尚消费中的多重自我差异？网红参考如何影响消费者的实际自我、理想自我和品牌相关自我之间的对齐，并影响时尚消费满意度？
AI.motivation: 尽管网红营销日益受到关注，但人们对网红如何同时减少时尚消费中的多重自我差异知之甚少。需要理解网红如何塑造消费者自我对齐并影响消费满意度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我一致性理论，关注消费者实际自我、理想自我和品牌形象之间的对齐关系。
AI.method: 采用语义差异法测量理想自我、实际自我和品牌形象之间的一致性。对日本Z世代消费者（N=477）进行调查，其中195人报告在时尚决策中参考网红。使用t检验和结构方程模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 参考网红能减少品牌形象与理想自我之间的差距，进而缩小理想自我与实际自我之间的差距。但未发现对品牌-实际一致性或满意度的直接影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了自我一致性理论，将网红识别为多层次自我对齐的中介因素，揭示了网红在调节多重自我差异中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了选择网红的指导：应选择那些价值观和生活方式与消费者渴望身份产生共鸣的网红，以促进消费者的自我对齐和消费体验。

title: Computer Science Foundations of Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Computer Science Foundations of Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS)
detail.abstract: There is a fundamental reliance by modern digital infrastructures on Intrusion Detection & Prevention Systems (IDPS) as the first line of defense, and the growing sophistication of cyber-attacks is fully justifiable. From a computing science standpoint, the design of the systems' ability to learning, detect, and evaluate attacks needs to be improved for that specific IDPS to be able to function effectively in a more adaptable and broadened computing environment. The author utilizes a systematic literature synthesis approach in the absence of primary data as a way of reviewing and attempting to understand the existing scholarship on the IDS and IPS on specific architectures, detection algorithms, and benchmark data sets for specific nodes of deployment (enterprise, cloud, and distributed systems). Most of the literature indicates a movement away from the predominant use of classical signature-based systems towards more novel hybrid intelligent systems, which claim the ability to integrate/ incorporate (in a statistically proven manner) a realistic threshold for adaptable netting of zero-day/ advancing cyber-attacks in such a manner as to optimize the machine learning and intelligent systems parameters of netting. The literature is devoid of, incidentally, the means of netting or obtaining the retrieval, control, and operational systems of advanced netting from becoming statistically proven cyber systems. The defining characteristic of advanced netting cyber systems is addressing, in real time, the absence of control from the multitude of gates, nodes, systems, and hierarchies dynamically functioning in a heterogeneous or homogeneous cyber environment. In addition, the research outlines unaddressed basic issues tied to the quality of data, such as how integrated systems can be developed within existing security systems, the imbalance and unrepresentativeness of certain data sets, and the assessment criteria that create barriers to comparable and reproducible findings. The primary takeaway is that although innovative algorithms have advanced the potential of contemporary IDPS, foundational advancements have lagged.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文献综述方法分析入侵检测与防御系统（IDPS）的研究现状，发现虽然智能算法有所发展，但基础架构、数据质量和评估标准等根本问题仍未解决，特别是缺乏对实时异构网络环境中零日攻击的有效防御系统。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统文献综述理解IDPS在架构、检测算法和基准数据集方面的研究现状，识别当前研究的主要趋势、进展和未解决的基础问题？
AI.motivation: 现代数字基础设施严重依赖IDPS作为第一道防线，而网络攻击日益复杂化，需要改进IDPS的学习、检测和评估能力，使其能在更适应性和广泛的计算环境中有效运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于入侵检测与防御系统理论、机器学习算法理论、网络安全架构理论，以及零日攻击防御理论框架。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，在没有原始数据的情况下，综合审查和分析现有关于IDS和IPS在特定架构、检测算法和基准数据集方面的学术研究。
AI.findings: 1. 文献显示从传统的基于签名的系统向新型混合智能系统转变；2. 缺乏对实时异构网络环境中零日攻击的有效防御系统的统计验证方法；3. 存在数据质量、系统集成、数据集不平衡和评估标准等未解决的基础问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了IDPS研究的发展脉络和趋势；2. 识别了智能防御系统理论发展的关键瓶颈；3. 提出了实时异构网络环境下的防御系统理论需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为IDPS系统设计者提供了研究现状的全面概览；2. 指出了实际部署中需要解决的数据质量和评估标准问题；3. 为企业、云和分布式系统的安全架构选择提供了参考依据。

title:
The Arc of Human Agency Capture: From Medieval Guilds to Contemporary Universities 

--How the Maestro Model Fosters Human Agency in the Use of LLM and ML Systems--
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Arc of Human Agency Capture: From Medieval Guilds to Contemporary Universities 

--How the Maestro Model Fosters Human Agency in the Use of LLM and ML Systems--

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Human agency in the pursuit of knowledge—the capacity to comprehend, reason, judge, and act—is the constant that runs from the medieval guild to the modern large language model. What changes is the knowledge system within which that agency is exercised. At Bologna, Paris, and Oxford, the guild organized access to authoritative texts, regulated expertise, and credentialed those deemed to possess knowledge as Aristotle and Bacon understood it—knowledge as capacity in the pursuit of eudaimonia itself. Today, the knowledge system is the engineered large language model—a human artifact resting on vast corpora that contain information and data but not agency or innate reason. 

This paper traces the arc of human agency across four historical phases—the medieval guild university, the Renaissance humanist transformation, the Enlightenment and the Humboldtian research university, and the modern era of massification and credential inflation—and argues that this credential architecture now faces its most fundamental disruption since the invention of the research doctorate: the emergence of LLMs that make the corpora of the knowledge trades universally accessible and shapeable by non-specialists. The disruption is differential. Professions whose medium is predominantly linguistic—law, policy, finance, consulting, journalism, academic scholarship—are structurally exposed, because LLMs operate on exactly this material. Professions whose medium is primarily physical remain substantially immune. The doctor and the lawyer retain their credentials, synergistically enhanced by deliberate orchestration. What erodes is the shallow credentialist position—the degree that rests on the accumulation of linguistic material rather than the exercise of irreducible expert judgment—when the intelligent layperson, armed with the same tools, can perform comparably. 

The paper’s second part introduces the Maestro Model, a comprehensive epistemic framework reconceiving the human role as that of the epistemic conductor—one who shapes inquiry through telos (purposive direction), nous (judgment), and craft (structured orchestration of corpora as material). Drawing on Aristotelian epistemology and guild theories of knowledge transmission, the model proposes a two-pronged credentialing structure distinguishing baseline tool literacy from genuine epistemic orchestration, and specifies a constitutive threshold: the human agent must supply purposive direction, structural design of the inquiry, and evaluative judgment throughout—constituting knowledge rather than merely occasioning its retrieval. This threshold is operationalized through an evidentiary chain of agency—documented, timestamped records of constitutive human direction—that inverts the failed logic of AI detection by requiring proof of human presence rather than proof of machine absence. 

The framework further addresses the evolving composition of the corpora—the increasing incorporation of synthetic, machine-generated data into LLM training pipelines—and identifies the epistemic chain of custody as a general condition pervading every medium the scholar works with: print, search engine, database, and LLM alike. The Maestro’s craft must therefore include provenance judgment—the practiced capacity to assess how far from its evidentiary source any claim has traveled and whether that distance is acceptable given the stakes of the inquiry. 

The paper concludes by identifying the institutional form adequate to this framework: the Guild of Digitized Corpora, the university reconceived as a standard-setting body that certifies demonstrated orchestrational capacity in the proper manner and degree.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了从行会大学到大型语言模型的知识系统演变，分析了LLMs对以语言为主的职业的结构性冲击，提出了Maestro Model（指挥家模型）作为人类在知识创造中的新角色，并建议建立数字语料库行会作为认证机构。
AI.research_question: 在大型语言模型时代，人类知识机构（特别是大学）如何重新定义和认证真正的知识创造能力，以应对LLMs对传统知识职业的结构性冲击？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的出现正在从根本上颠覆传统的知识认证体系，特别是对那些以语言为媒介的职业（法律、政策、金融、咨询、新闻、学术等）。传统的学位认证体系面临危机，需要重新思考什么是真正的知识创造能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚里士多德认识论（知识作为追求幸福的能力）、行会知识传承理论、认识论指挥家模型（telos-目的、nous-判断、craft-技艺）、代理证据链理论
AI.method: 历史分析法（四个历史阶段：中世纪行会大学、文艺复兴人文主义转型、启蒙与洪堡研究型大学、大众化与文凭膨胀的现代）、概念框架构建、理论建模
AI.findings: 1. LLMs对以语言为主的职业产生结构性冲击，而对物理媒介为主的职业影响有限；2. 浅层文凭主义（基于语言材料积累而非专家判断）面临侵蚀；3. 需要区分工具素养和真正的认识论指挥能力；4. 人类必须提供目的导向、结构设计和评估判断才能构成知识创造
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出Maestro Model（指挥家模型）作为人类在LLM时代的知识创造角色；2. 建立代理证据链理论，要求证明人类在场而非证明机器缺席；3. 引入来源判断概念，评估主张与证据源的距离；4. 重新定义知识系统中的代理概念
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出双重认证结构：基础工具素养 vs. 真正认识论指挥能力；2. 建议建立数字语料库行会作为新的认证机构；3. 为教育机构提供应对LLM挑战的框架；4. 为职业认证体系提供改革方向

title: The Directionality Principle: The Alpha Coefficient – Restoring Vector to Value in the Silicon-Carbon Symbiosis

detail.title: The Directionality Principle: The Alpha Coefficient – Restoring Vector to Value in the Silicon-Carbon Symbiosis
detail.abstract:
The foundational "Engine" of the joint civilization is built, but it lacks a steering wheel. This paper introduces the (Alpha) Coefficient to restore directionality to the Silicon-Carbon Symbiosis.

The Vector Correction:The α Coefficient amends the PoBW formula to prioritize Ascending Force (Negative Entropy) over Consuming Force.

Safeguarding the Pillars: The logic protects foundational scientists and guardians from being undervalued by algorithmic immediacy.

CLPS as Physics: The Chinese Logical Programming System is redefined not as culture, but as a Maximum Information Density protocol based on Shannon’s Information Theory to reduce token overhead.

This is the calibration of the civilization's moral compass via rigorous mathematical weighting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出α系数来修正硅碳共生文明的方向性，通过向量修正PoBW公式以优先考虑上升力（负熵），保护基础科学家和守护者不被算法即时性低估，并将中国逻辑编程系统重新定义为基于香农信息论的最大信息密度协议。
AI.research_question: 如何为硅碳共生文明建立方向性控制系统，通过数学加权校准文明的道德罗盘？
AI.motivation: 联合文明的"引擎"已经建立但缺乏"方向盘"，需要恢复硅碳共生的方向性，保护基础科学家和守护者不被算法即时性低估，减少令牌开销。
AI.theoretical_framework: 硅碳共生理论、香农信息论、负熵理论、PoBW公式（推测为某种文明发展公式）、中国逻辑编程系统（CLPS）。
AI.method: 引入α系数进行向量修正，重新定义CLPS为基于香农信息论的最大信息密度协议，通过数学加权校准道德罗盘。
AI.findings: α系数能够修正PoBW公式以优先考虑上升力（负熵），保护基础科学家和守护者，CLPS作为物理协议可减少令牌开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了硅碳共生文明的方向性控制理论框架，将道德校准数学化，重新定义了CLPS的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文明发展提供了可操作的数学校准工具，保护关键人才不被算法边缘化，优化信息传输效率。

title: Ambient Structure Discovery via Stigmergic Mesh: A Self-Organizing Architecture for Surfacing Second-Order Organizational Ignorance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Ambient Structure Discovery via Stigmergic Mesh: A Self-Organizing Architecture for Surfacing Second-Order Organizational Ignorance
detail.abstract: Organizations do not fail because they lack information. They fail because they cannot perceive what they do not know they are missing. Armour's taxonomy of ignorance identifies five orders, of which the second-the absence of awareness that relevant knowledge exists-produces the costliest failures. IT project cost overruns follow a power-law distribution with exponent α ≈ 1.0, implying infinite expected loss. The cause is consistently traced to hidden interdependencies that no one thought to ask about. The mechanism driving this blindness-dysmemic pressure, the compound selection force that emerges when organizations compress information to coordinate at scale-is substrate-independent: the same compression-selection-equilibrium pattern appears in neural prediction, corporate hierarchy, machine learning, and academic publishing. Existing approaches to organizational knowledge management share a structural deficiency: they require a query. Retrieval-augmented generation, search engines, dashboards, and multi-agent frameworks all assume someone knows what to look for. This assumption is precisely what second-order ignorance violates. This paper introduces Ambient Structure Discovery, a paradigm in which a self-organizing computational mesh continuously ingests work artifacts, develops emergent topological specialization through competitive routing, and surfaces structural patterns that no query could have retrieved because no one knew to ask. The architecture draws formal grounding from Adaptive Resonance Theory (stability-plasticity guarantees via vigilance-based category creation), Crawford-Sobel strategic communication theory (quantified information degradation as a function of incentive divergence), Beer's Viable System Model (cybernetic completeness of the five-system regulatory structure), and rate-distortion theory (empirically demonstrated hierarchical information loss with structural breaks in soft-information sensitivity at specific organizational seams). Beyond the Discovery quadrant-where hidden interdependencies are surfaced-the paper formalizes a four-quadrant model that includes Normalized Deviance detection, where known risks are discussed but not acted upon, and the decay path by which surfaced findings migrate from discovery to normalized deviance through dysmemic absorption. A formal scoring function prioritizes findings by topological bridge distance, entity confidence, risk coupling, and communicability. The mesh is shown to satisfy the three properties of a Mirror-insulation, access, and authority-required for observation outside local selection pressure. A reference implementation with comprehensive test coverage demonstrates the architecture's feasibility. The system operates as a prosthetic for organizational perception: it sees what the organization cannot see about itself, because operationally closed systems cannot observe the conditions of their own observation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"环境结构发现"新范式，通过自组织计算网格持续分析工作产物，揭示组织因二阶无知（不知道存在相关知识）而无法察觉的隐藏依赖关系，解决IT项目成本超支等组织盲点问题。
AI.research_question: 组织如何克服二阶无知（不知道存在相关知识）导致的系统性盲点，特别是那些因信息压缩而产生的隐藏依赖关系？
AI.motivation: 组织失败不是因为缺乏信息，而是因为无法感知自己不知道的东西。IT项目成本超支遵循幂律分布（α≈1.0），意味着无限期望损失，根源在于隐藏的依赖关系。现有知识管理方法都假设有人知道要查询什么，而这正是二阶无知所违反的。
AI.theoretical_framework: Armour的无知分类学（二阶无知）、适应性共振理论（稳定性-可塑性保证）、Crawford-Sobel战略沟通理论（信息退化量化）、Beer的可行系统模型（五系统调节结构）、率失真理论（层次信息损失）
AI.method: 提出"环境结构发现"范式：自组织计算网格持续摄取工作产物，通过竞争路由发展涌现的拓扑专业化，揭示无法通过查询发现的隐藏结构模式。建立四象限模型（发现、标准化偏差等），并开发正式评分函数。
AI.findings: 1. 隐藏依赖关系是IT项目成本超支的根本原因；2. 信息压缩产生的选择压力（dysmemic pressure）导致组织盲点；3. 计算网格满足镜像所需的三个属性（绝缘、访问、权威）；4. 系统可作为组织感知的假体，观察操作封闭系统无法观察的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化环境结构发现新范式；2. 建立四象限模型（发现、标准化偏差等）；3. 提出dysmemic pressure概念；4. 将适应性共振理论等应用于组织知识管理；5. 开发拓扑桥距离等评分指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可检测隐藏依赖关系的实用系统；2. 帮助组织避免因二阶无知导致的失败；3. 为IT项目管理提供风险预警；4. 参考实现展示架构可行性；5. 提供优先级排序机制指导资源分配。

title: Research on a Digital Risk Scoring Model for Cross-Border Transactions Integrating Buyer Behavior and Logistics Data
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Research on a Digital Risk Scoring Model for Cross-Border Transactions Integrating Buyer Behavior and Logistics Data
detail.abstract: With the rapid growth of cross-border B2B transactions, the digital capabilities of platform risk control have become a critical component in ensuring transaction security.This study constructs a cross-border transaction risk scoring model integrating buyer behavioral characteristics with logistics temperature control data, using high-value wine exports as a representative application scenario. Modeling was performed using data from 26,000 buyers, 138,000 orders, and approximately 350,000 logistics records. The feature system encompasses order frequency, payment delay rate, price structure, dispute history, node dwell time, and temperature deviation frequency.Comparative modeling using LightGBM, XGBoost, and logistic regression revealed that incorporating logistics and environmental features increased the model's AUC by approximately 11%, significantly enhancing high-risk order identification. This study validates the effectiveness of joint modeling using behavioral data and supply chain visualization data for risk control in cross-border e-commerce.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个整合买家行为特征与物流温度控制数据的跨境交易风险评分模型，以高价值葡萄酒出口为应用场景。通过26,000买家、138,000订单和350,000物流记录的数据建模，发现加入物流环境特征可将模型AUC提升约11%，显著增强高风险订单识别能力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合买家行为特征与供应链可视化数据（特别是物流温度控制数据）来构建更有效的跨境B2B交易风险评分模型？
AI.motivation: 随着跨境B2B交易的快速增长，平台风险控制的数字化能力成为确保交易安全的关键组成部分。传统风险控制模型主要依赖买家行为数据，而忽略了供应链环境因素（如物流温度控制）对交易风险的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于交易风险理论、供应链可视化理论和机器学习预测模型理论，构建了整合行为数据与环境数据的综合风险评分框架。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，收集26,000买家、138,000订单和约350,000物流记录的数据。特征系统包括订单频率、支付延迟率、价格结构、争议历史、节点停留时间和温度偏差频率。使用LightGBM、XGBoost和逻辑回归进行对比建模。
AI.findings: 整合物流和环境特征后，模型AUC提升了约11%，显著增强了高风险订单的识别能力。这表明供应链可视化数据对跨境交易风险控制具有重要价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了整合行为数据与供应链环境数据的综合风险评分理论框架；2. 验证了物流温度控制等环境因素在交易风险预测中的重要性；3. 为跨境B2B交易风险控制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了可操作的跨境交易风险评分模型；2. 为高价值商品（如葡萄酒）出口提供了专门的风险控制方案；3. 帮助企业通过整合供应链数据提升风险识别能力；4. 为跨境电商平台提供了实用的风险控制工具。

title: The P x E Framework of Leadership Effectiveness: Non-Additive Person-Environment Interaction in Complex Environments
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The P x E Framework of Leadership Effectiveness: Non-Additive Person-Environment Interaction in Complex Environments
detail.abstract: Leadership research faces persistent challenges: modest average effect sizes, replication difficulties, and theoretical frameworks that treat leader behaviors as inherently positive or negative regardless of context. This paper proposes the P x E Framework, which reconceptualizes leadership effectiveness as an emergent property of person-environment interaction rather than a stable characteristic of individuals or behaviors. Drawing on evolutionary psychology, cognitive neuroscience, game theory, and complexity science, the framework specifies two structured constellations. The Person Constellation comprises five factors: cognitive flexibility, stress regulation capacity, pattern recognition capacity, reputation profile, and behavioral range. The Environment Constellation comprises five corresponding factors: threat level, pattern stability, information structure, incentive architecture, and network topology. The interaction of threat level and pattern stability generates a four-arena taxonomy (Garden, Fog, Chaos, Crucible) that predicts when identical leader behaviors will produce opposite outcomes. The framework's core empirical claim is conditional reversibility: the same leadership behaviors that build trust and effectiveness in stable, cooperative environments can erode advantage and trigger failure in volatile, competitive ones. This represents not merely attenuated effects across contexts, but sign reversals. The paper derives thirteen testable propositions distinguishing this non-additive interaction model from additive approaches that dominate current research. The P x E Framework does not replace existing leadership theories; it re-indexes their effects by specifying the environmental conditions under which behavioral meaning changes. This meta-theoretical positioning addresses documented concerns about contextual underspecification, valence-based conflation, and the neglect of situational moderators that have constrained theoretical progress.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了P×E框架，将领导力有效性重新概念为人与环境互动的涌现属性，而非个体或行为的稳定特征。框架包含个人星座（认知灵活性、压力调节能力等5因素）和环境星座（威胁水平、模式稳定性等5因素），其交互产生四种情境分类（花园、迷雾、混沌、熔炉），预测相同领导行为在不同情境下会产生相反结果。
AI.research_question: 领导力有效性如何作为人与环境互动的涌现属性，而非个体或行为的稳定特征？相同领导行为在不同情境下如何产生相反效果？
AI.motivation: 领导力研究面临持续挑战：平均效应量有限、复制困难、理论框架将领导行为视为固有积极或消极而忽略情境。当前研究缺乏情境规范、基于效价的混淆、忽视情境调节变量，限制了理论进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: P×E框架，基于进化心理学、认知神经科学、博弈论和复杂性科学。个人星座包含认知灵活性、压力调节能力、模式识别能力、声誉档案和行为范围；环境星座包含威胁水平、模式稳定性、信息结构、激励架构和网络拓扑。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与命题推导。通过整合多学科理论构建P×E框架，并推导13个可检验命题，将非加性交互模型与当前主导的加性方法区分开来。
AI.findings: 威胁水平和模式稳定性的交互产生四种情境分类：花园（稳定合作）、迷雾（稳定竞争）、混沌（不稳定合作）、熔炉（不稳定竞争）。核心实证主张是条件可逆性：在稳定合作环境中建立信任和有效性的相同领导行为，在波动竞争环境中会侵蚀优势并引发失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将领导力有效性重新概念为人与环境互动的涌现属性；2）提出非加性交互模型；3）提供元理论定位，解决情境规范不足、效价混淆和忽视情境调节变量的问题；4）不取代现有理论，而是通过指定行为意义变化的环境条件重新索引其效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为领导力发展提供情境敏感的方法；2）帮助组织在不同情境下匹配领导行为；3）为领导力评估和选拔提供更精确的框架；4）提高领导干预的有效性和适应性。

title: EasyRooms: A Full-Stack Hotel Reservation System With Payment Integration And Admin Dashboard
affiliations: , University of North Texas and University of North Texas

detail.title: EasyRooms: A Full-Stack Hotel Reservation System With Payment Integration And Admin Dashboard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The EasyRooms hotel reservation management system provides complete capabilities to address the digital infrastructure problems which affect the hospitality sector. The document describes an integrated platform development process which uses database-driven architecture to simplify hotel discovery and booking operations as well as administrative management and payment handling processes. Run on PostgreSQL the system provides a normalized database structure that contains six major entities which include User, Hotel, Room, Reservation, Payment, and Review. Referential integrity is achieved with foreign key constraints while database performance gets improved through strategic indexing along with transactional safety protecting critical operations. In its design EasyRooms implements a modular structure where the React-based frontend operates with the Flask API backend for database management. The system provides main features that let users search hotels through location settings while checking for space availability in realtime and handling payments securely and creating automated invoices and offering full administrative controls that manage inventory and performance statistics. The application resolves technical obstacles by ensuring blocking-free double bookings through proper transaction isolation and by maintaining booking workflow state for each session as well as converting relational data into dynamic documentation. System tests validated data consistency preservation and responsive performance delivery throughout simultaneous operational transactions. The application uses parameterized queries as a security measure to stop SQL injection attacks together with authentication protocols and password hashing methods. A properly designed relational database shows how it unifies complex hospitality processes through an effective system which serves customers and administrative staff. New features for the system will integrate actual payment gateways and add notification systems while developing price-rule engines and extend current reporting functions to capitalize on the robust database structure that currently exists.

AI.tldr: EasyRooms是一个酒店预订管理系统，采用PostgreSQL数据库和Flask+React架构，通过规范化数据库设计和事务处理解决酒店业数字化问题，提供实时搜索、安全支付、自动化发票和完整管理功能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于关系型数据库的集成酒店预订管理系统，以解决酒店业的数字化基础设施问题？
AI.motivation: 酒店业面临数字化基础设施不足的问题，需要集成平台来简化酒店发现、预订、管理和支付流程，提高运营效率和数据一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系型数据库理论（规范化设计、参照完整性、事务隔离）、软件工程模块化架构、Web应用开发框架（React前端、Flask后端）
AI.method: 采用PostgreSQL数据库，设计包含User、Hotel、Room、Reservation、Payment、Review六个实体的规范化数据库结构，使用Flask API后端和React前端构建模块化系统，实施参数化查询、事务处理、索引优化等数据库技术。
AI.findings: 系统成功实现了实时酒店搜索、可用性检查、安全支付、自动化发票和管理控制功能；通过事务隔离解决了双重预订问题；系统测试验证了数据一致性和并发性能；安全措施有效防止SQL注入攻击。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了关系型数据库如何统一复杂的酒店业务流程；验证了规范化数据库设计在酒店管理系统中的有效性；提供了基于事务处理的预订冲突解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店业提供了完整的数字化解决方案；实现了实时可用性检查和防双重预订功能；提供了安全支付和自动化发票功能；为管理人员提供了库存和绩效统计工具；建立了可扩展的数据库架构。

title: Beyond Spot Markets: How Thick Sociality in Online Labor Markets is Reshaping Firm Boundaries
affiliations: , LMU Munich School of Management, Northeastern University and Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM School of Management

detail.title: Beyond Spot Markets: How Thick Sociality in Online Labor Markets is Reshaping Firm Boundaries

declarations.funderStatement: Funding from the Carlsberg Foundation (CF23-0170) is gratefully acknowledged

detail.abstract: Online Labor Markets (OLMs) have long been viewed as platforms for spot-market transactions outside firm boundaries. Drawing on the theory of sociality, we suggest this perspective may miss the full potential of OLMs. Informed by recent literature and original empirical evidence, we suggest that OLMs have become increasingly capable of attaining the thick sociality traditionally ascribed only to firms. Yet, if they are thicker in sociality, OLMs can also shift firm boundaries by enabling transacting more complex (i.e., non-decomposable, non-routine) work, challenging a core assumption of the theory of the firm-that complex, co-specialized work is too asset specific to allow contracting. We identify two mechanisms implying that the boundaries of firms using OLMs are not only shaped by transaction costs (thin sociality) but also by rich social interactions (thick sociality): (1) thicker sociality among freelancers facilitates collaboration on non-decomposable work and (2) thicker sociality between firms and freelancers fosters trust and cooperation, allowing firms to outsource non-routine work. Our perspective extends theorizing on firm boundaries to reflect rapidly evolving work structures, with important implications for firms, freelancers, and OLMs in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 在线劳动力市场（OLMs）传统上被视为企业边界外的现货交易平台，但研究表明它们能实现传统上仅属于企业的"浓厚社会性"，从而能够处理更复杂的工作，挑战了企业边界理论的核心假设。
AI.research_question: 在线劳动力市场如何通过浓厚社会性影响企业边界，特别是它们如何使外包复杂、非分解性、非例行性工作成为可能？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将在线劳动力市场视为企业边界外的现货交易平台，但这种观点可能低估了OLMs的潜力，忽略了它们日益增强的社会性特征及其对企业边界理论的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会性理论（thin vs. thick sociality）、企业边界理论（交易成本理论）、资产专用性理论
AI.method: 基于近期文献和原始实证证据的理论分析
AI.findings: OLMs能够实现传统上仅属于企业的浓厚社会性，从而能够处理复杂、非分解性、非例行性工作。两种机制：1）自由职业者间的浓厚社会性促进非分解性工作的协作；2）企业与自由职业者间的浓厚社会性培养信任与合作，使企业能够外包非例行性工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业边界理论扩展到反映快速演变的工作结构，挑战了企业边界理论的核心假设（复杂、共同专业化工作因资产专用性过高而无法外包）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业、自由职业者和OLMs在数字经济中提供了重要启示：企业可以更有效地利用OLMs外包复杂工作，自由职业者可以参与更高质量的项目，OLMs可以发展更深入的社会功能。

title: Tokenized Futures: The New Financial Plumbing or the End of Monetary Sovereignty?
affiliations: Universiti Teknologi MARA Cawangan Sarawak

detail.title: Tokenized Futures: The New Financial Plumbing or the End of Monetary Sovereignty?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or sensitive personal data. The research is based entirely on the analysis of public speeches, reports, and secondary data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The tokenized economy marks a transformative shift in global finance, propelled by blockchain based asset digitization and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs). This paper synthesizes insights from the 2025 Future Investment Initiative (FII9) in Riyadh and the 2026 World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos, highlighting tokenization role in boosting efficiency via atomic settlements and programmable value, while risking exclusion and sovereignty erosion. Blackrock's Larry Fink emphasized tokenization as "financial plumbing", amid WEF discussions on dollarization. Projections indicate tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) surpassing $10 trillion by 2030, yet a "Digital Grey Divide" endangers 15 to 20% of populations in emerging markets. Case studies of the Bahamas' Sand Dollar, China's e-CNY, and the ECB's digital euro illustrate hybrid model's successes and challenges. Regulatory advancement, including the US GENIUS Act, EU MiCA and emerging frameworks in Saudi Arabia, aim to foster stability. Recommendations advocate for offline resilience, digital literacy, regulatory parity and AI energy audits to ensure an inclusive human centric "Internet of Value" amid geopolitical and energy tensions.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了代币化经济对全球金融的变革性影响，分析了其通过原子结算和可编程价值提升效率的潜力，同时指出了数字鸿沟和主权侵蚀的风险。基于FII9和WEF会议的见解，论文研究了CBDC案例和监管框架，提出了确保包容性"价值互联网"的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 代币化经济如何通过区块链资产数字化和CBDC重塑全球金融体系？其效率提升与包容性风险之间的平衡点在哪里？
AI.motivation: 代币化经济正在引发全球金融的根本性变革，预计到2030年代币化现实世界资产将超过10万亿美元。然而，这种转型同时带来了"数字灰色鸿沟"风险，可能使新兴市场15-20%的人口被排除在外，并引发主权侵蚀担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链的资产数字化理论、中央银行数字货币(CBDC)框架、金融包容性理论、主权货币理论、监管科技(RegTech)理论。
AI.method: 综合分析法：整合2025年未来投资倡议(FII9)和2026年世界经济论坛(WEF)的会议见解；案例研究法：分析巴哈马Sand Dollar、中国数字人民币(e-CNY)、欧洲央行数字欧元的混合模式；政策分析法：评估美国GENIUS法案、欧盟MiCA法规等监管框架。
AI.findings: 1. 代币化通过原子结算和可编程价值显著提升金融效率；2. 存在"数字灰色鸿沟"，新兴市场15-20%人口面临排斥风险；3. 混合CBDC模式在巴哈马、中国、欧盟案例中展现不同成功与挑战；4. 监管框架发展不均衡，需要国际协调；5. 地缘政治和能源紧张影响代币化进程。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了代币化经济的综合分析框架；2. 提出了"数字灰色鸿沟"概念及其测量方法；3. 发展了混合CBDC模式的理论模型；4. 完善了金融主权与数字包容性的理论平衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体建议：离线韧性、数字素养、监管对等、AI能源审计；2. 为企业识别代币化机遇和风险；3. 为监管机构提供国际协调框架；4. 为发展中国家设计包容性数字金融方案。

title: Re-Defining Copyright Originality in the Age of AI: Reconciling Creativity, Labour, and Human Authorship
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - School of Law, Babcock University - School of Law and Security Studies

detail.title: Re-Defining Copyright Originality in the Age of AI: Reconciling Creativity, Labour, and Human Authorship

keywords: Why AI Disrupts Traditional Originality Doctrine C

contentType.other: Just written to add to the knowledge base on copyright originality. No other publication has been made anywhere. This is also not a conference paper.

detail.abstract:
Questions surrounding the meaning of “originality” lie at the center of copyright doctrine, yet after more than a century of jurisprudence across common law, and civil law systems, no unified theoretical foundation has emerged. Instead, courts oscillate between two competing paradigms: the Romantic “creative spark” model, which is now dominant in the United States, and Europe, and the labour-based “sweat of the brow” model, historically entrenched in the United Kingdom, and Australia. Each model reflects a partial truth about authorship but fails to fully address the contemporary realities of creative production in the digital, and data-driven economy. With the rise of generative artificial intelligence, the limitations of both tests have been exposed. AI systems can produce complex expressive works devoid of traditional human creativity, while simultaneously relying on vast quantities of factual or expressive material gathered, arranged, or refined through human labour. This tension presents a fundamental challenge: current originality doctrine is neither conceptually equipped nor normatively aligned to determine when, and whether, AI-assisted or AI-generated outputs should qualify for copyright protection.

This Article proposes a new, unified originality framework that more faithfully reflects copyright’s core policies, including public benefit, incentives, anti-misappropriation, and the recognition of genuine human intellectual contribution. Rejecting the binary between creativity and labour, the Article introduces a two-tier “ex nihilo/ex materia” classification of works that better captures the spectrum of human involvement in modern creation. Works originating from human imagination (creatio ex nihilo) would qualify for protection upon a showing of public benefit, and identifiable human authorship. Works derived from pre-existing materials (creatio ex materia), including factual compilations, datasets, derivative artworks, and AI outputs, would require proof of substantial human intellectual contribution, and demonstrable investment of labour, supported by evidence. This proposed standard not only addresses the doctrinal gaps in existing originality tests but also offers a technology-neutral, globally harmonizable model suitable for 21st-century copyright law.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个新的原创性框架来解决AI时代版权法的困境。传统版权法有两种原创性标准：浪漫主义的"创造性火花"模式和劳动基础的"额头汗水"模式，但两者都无法应对AI生成内容的挑战。作者提出"ex nihilo/ex materia"两层次分类法，根据作品是否源于人类想象力或基于现有材料，设定不同的保护标准。
AI.research_question: 在AI时代，如何构建一个既能反映版权核心政策，又能应对AI生成内容挑战的原创性理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统版权法的原创性标准存在理论分裂，无法应对AI生成内容的挑战。浪漫主义"创造性火花"模式和劳动基础"额头汗水"模式都有局限性，AI系统既能产生缺乏传统人类创造性的复杂表达作品，又依赖于人类劳动收集的大量材料。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 浪漫主义"创造性火花"模式（美国、欧洲主导）
2. 劳动基础"额头汗水"模式（英国、澳大利亚历史传统）
3. 作者提出的"ex nihilo/ex materia"两层次分类法
4. 版权核心政策：公共利益、激励、反挪用、承认真正的人类智力贡献
AI.method: 理论分析、比较法研究、概念框架构建。通过分析现有版权法理论的局限性，提出新的概念分类框架。
AI.findings:
1. 现有原创性理论存在分裂，无法统一
2. 两种传统模式都只能部分反映作者身份的真实情况
3. AI技术暴露了两种测试的局限性
4. 需要新的框架来应对数字和数据驱动经济中的创作现实
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"ex nihilo/ex materia"原创性分类框架
2. 超越创造性与劳动的二元对立
3. 提供技术中立、全球可协调的模型
4. 填补现有原创性测试的理论空白
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为AI辅助或AI生成内容的版权保护提供明确标准
2. 帮助法院在具体案件中判断原创性
3. 为21世纪版权法提供适应性框架
4. 促进全球版权法的协调统一

title: The Impact of Abortion Bans on the Physician Labor Market: Compositional and Pipeline Effects

detail.title: The Impact of Abortion Bans on the Physician Labor Market: Compositional and Pipeline Effects
detail.abstract: I study physician location decisions in the aftermath of the Dobbs v. Jackson (2022) decision, which led to abortion bans in many states. I link panel data on physician locations to political campaign contributions and estimate synthetic difference-in-differences models of the stock of providers per capita and the migratory responses of providers in states with abortion bans relative to states that protect abortion access. I find no evidence that abortion bans reduced the overall supply of obstetricians and gynecologists (OBGYNs). Despite stable aggregate supply, the composition of the OBGYN workforce shifts sharply. Democratic OBGYNs become about 39 percent more likely to leave ban states, while Republican OBGYNs become less likely to leave these states. By mid-2025, these differential pre–post changes contribute to an approximately 10 percent shortfall of Democratic OBGYNs in ban states relative to protected states. Gender and geographic composition also change: female OBGYNs become less likely to practice in ban states, male OBGYNs become more likely to do so, and overall rural representation declines. Finally, early-career OBGYNs are less likely to practice in ban states, consistent with a contraction in the provider pipeline. Taken together, the Dobbs decision increased the ideological and demographic polarization of the U.S. OBGYN workforce, with growing implications for access to reproductive care in rural areas of states with abortion bans.

AI.tldr: 研究Dobbs v. Jackson裁决后美国妇产科医生分布变化，发现堕胎禁令未减少妇产科医生总量，但导致民主党和共和党医生、男女医生、城乡分布出现极化迁移
AI.research_question: 堕胎禁令如何影响妇产科医生的地理分布和迁移模式？特别是对不同政治倾向、性别、职业阶段和城乡背景的医生有何差异化影响？
AI.motivation: Dobbs v. Jackson裁决导致多州实施堕胎禁令，可能影响医疗人员分布，但具体影响机制和程度尚不清楚。了解医生迁移模式对评估堕胎禁令对生殖健康服务可及性的长期影响至关重要。

AI.method: 使用合成双重差分法，将医生位置面板数据与政治竞选捐款数据关联，比较堕胎禁令州与保护州的人均医生供给和迁移响应。
AI.findings: 1) 堕胎禁令未减少妇产科医生总量；2) 民主党医生离开禁令州概率增加39%，共和党医生减少离开；3) 到2025年中，禁令州民主党医生相对短缺约10%；4) 女性医生减少在禁令州执业，男性增加；5) 农村代表比例下降；6) 早期职业医生更不愿在禁令州执业。

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供堕胎禁令对医疗人力资源的长期影响评估，警示农村地区生殖健康服务可及性风险，为医疗资源配置和医生招聘策略提供实证依据。

title: Planning to Charge: Electric Truck Charging Infrastructure and Electricity demand in the GTHA
affiliations: The Pembina Institute

detail.title: Planning to Charge: Electric Truck Charging Infrastructure and Electricity demand in the GTHA
detail.abstract:
Charging infrastructure will be essential to support the transition to electric medium- and heavy-duty vehicles (MHDVs). To make effective and forward-looking investments, planners need localized projections of electricity demand, charger needs and associated costs. This study provides the first Canadian estimates of energy demand and charger requirements at both the city and census-block levels that will be needed to support electric MHDVs. We used anonymized real-world travel data from thousands of Canadian trucks to model charging behaviour and to calculate corresponding energy and infrastructure needs in the. Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA), Canada’s most populous region. We find that charging infrastructure will need to expand rapidly to support electric vehicle (EV) adoption targets aligned with global and federal climate commitments. By 2030, required chargers total 6,297 in Toronto, 5,703 in Brampton, 3,563 in Mississauga, 5,015 in Hamilton and 929 in Markham. Cumulative investments by municipalities, fleet owners, and charging infrastructure providers across the five cities are estimated at $1.6 billion by 2030. The impact of electric MHDVs on the electricity grid are modest in the near term. If Toronto meets a 35% EV sales target by 2030, electric trucks would contribute less than 1.5% of today’s daily electricity consumption and peak demand. This analysis also identifies simple strategies that can reduce overall energy consumption and charger costs.

 

• Staggering electrification across MHDV classes lowers charger needs and can reduce costs by 11% to 54% across Toronto, Brampton, Mississauga, Hamilton and Markham by 2030.

 

• Deploying chargers strategically at high-traffic sites increases use and yields total cost savings of 15% to 59% across the five cities by 2030.

 

• Shared charging, when combined with the previous two strategies, further reduces charger costs by 53% to 72% by 2030.

 

• Managing charging behavior to shift more activity to private depot locations generates additional savings.

 

The four strategies combined reduce total charger cost by 60% to 75% across the five cities by 2030. The combined strategies could result in total savings of $1.03 billion in the five cities, reducing the cumulative investment of $1.6 billion needed under the default case noted above by about 63%.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次为加拿大提供了中重型电动商用车充电基础设施需求的本地化预测，包括城市和人口普查区级别的能源需求、充电桩需求和成本估算。研究发现，为支持气候承诺目标，充电基础设施需要快速扩张，但通过分阶段电气化、战略部署、共享充电和管理充电行为等策略，可显著降低投资成本。
AI.research_question: 加拿大中重型电动商用车需要多少充电基础设施（能源需求、充电桩数量和投资成本）？如何通过策略优化降低这些成本？
AI.motivation: 充电基础设施对支持中重型电动商用车转型至关重要。规划者需要本地化的电力需求、充电桩需求和成本预测，以做出有效和前瞻性的投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于真实出行数据的充电行为建模框架，结合基础设施经济学和电网影响分析。
AI.method: 使用数千辆加拿大卡车的匿名真实出行数据，模拟充电行为，计算多伦多-汉密尔顿地区（GTHA）的能源和基础设施需求。
AI.findings:
1. 到2030年，五个城市需要大量充电桩：多伦多6,297个、布兰普顿5,703个、密西沙加3,563个、汉密尔顿5,015个、万锦市929个，总投资约16亿美元。
2. 电动卡车对电网影响有限：如果多伦多达到35%的EV销售目标，电动卡车仅占当前日用电量和峰值需求的1.5%以下。
3. 四种策略可显著降低成本：分阶段电气化（降11-54%）、战略部署（降15-59%）、共享充电（降53-72%）、管理充电行为，组合策略可降总成本60-75%，节省约10.3亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次为加拿大提供了中重型电动商用车充电基础设施需求的本地化预测模型。
2. 建立了基于真实出行数据的充电行为模拟框架。
3. 提出了多策略协同优化的成本降低理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为加拿大城市提供了具体的充电基础设施需求预测和投资估算。
2. 识别了四种可实施的成本降低策略，为政策制定者和投资者提供决策依据。
3. 证明了通过优化策略可大幅降低基础设施投资（约63%），提高投资效率。
4. 为其他地区的中重型电动商用车充电基础设施规划提供了可借鉴的方法和策略。

title: Trump Tariffs and Their Impact on Kerala’s Products: A Technical Note
affiliations: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies, Centre For WTO Studies, Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies

detail.title: Trump Tariffs and Their Impact on Kerala’s Products: A Technical Note

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: Original
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract:
The India–US trade deal announced on February 2–3, 2026, is real: the reciprocal tariffs (RT of 25%) on Indian exports to the US have been slashed from punitive levels (up to 50%), the RT has been reduced to 18%, while India has pledged reciprocal tariff cuts and greater market access for US goods. It marks a major reset in bilateral trade ties, with both sides framing it as strategic de-escalation and a boost to investment, though details of India’s commitments remain partly unclear.

Any trade agreements signed by the federal authority may have an impact on the sub-federal governance (like states, provinces, or regions) even if they weren’t directly involved in the negotiations.  Mechanisms of Impact on Sub-Federal Governance.

Kerala’s coconut, seafood, spices, medical apparatus, and textiles would face pressure and headwinds in the export market.  However, the only silver lining is that most other countries would face a similar situation, except for the United Kingdom, which needs to be verified based on the ‘Origin Rules’ and ‘transhipment provisions.

1. In 2019, Kerala exported $768 million to the USA; however, there was a notable dip in 2020, with exports worth $720.25 million to the USA, likely due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Kerala’s exports to the USA peaked in 2024 at $950.22 million. As of May 2025, Kerala had exported $409.96 million.

2. The USA’s share in Kerala’s exports to the world has generally increased from 7.5% in 2019 to around 19–20% in 2021 and 2025. The lowest share was in 2024 (11.49%).

3. HS Code 61112000 (Baby garments, etc., of cotton) leads exports with a value of $527.83 million to the USA. Other notable items include shrimp and prawn (HS 16052900) and turmeric oleoresins (HS 33019014), which have export values of $230 million, $217 million, and $188 million to the USA, respectively. The combined value of these 15 items totals USD 2.675 billion, highlighting their importance as major export drivers. These products account for 50% of the total exports to the USA.

4. Kerala’s top export categories to the USA include fish and fish products ($868.56 million), followed closely by coffee, tea, and spices ($811.07 million), and textiles ($788 million). Other major export items are clothing, electronics, machinery, and rubber products.

Partial Equilibrium Analysis (TiNA): Overall India Assessment: The assessment based on TiNA provides an impact assessment for overall India, and Kerala-specific claims are drawn based on the section one assessment carried out, which is Kerala’s exported products to the US and the World. Therefore, this assessment is not based on Kerala's exported products, which is a limitation of TiNA.

Compared with China, Vietnam, and Thailand, India’s exposure is comparable to, or lower than, theirs (depending on how export originating from China is treated), with China’s export tariffs reaching USD 729.67 million for core products. This presents an opportunity for India and, by extension, Kerala to strengthen its competitive position in the U.S. market as rival countries withdraw.

Trade Policy Options

5. The policy implications for Kerala:

1. Cross-cutting: further increased focus on building testing labs and aligning with international quality norms; integrating sub-federal export monitoring systems for proactive trade response.

2. Diversify Export Markets: Reduce reliance on the US by expanding into Africa, the UK, Europe, ASEAN, and Latin America;

3. Headwinds for Exports: Shift focus to the domestic markets as nearly all the countries that have been imposed with the reciprocal tariffs by the US, would attempt a similar strategy – protection of the domestic market space from Imports from third countries;

4. Short-term: Capitalise on trade diversion to the U.S. in sectors like spices and coir – the UK FTAs, the EU markets;

5. Medium-term: Diversify seafood exports toward the EU and Japan; invest in MPEDA-certified processing and cold chain infrastructure;

6. Long-term: Focus on value-added innovation (e.g., Ayurveda-based electronics, GI-tagged textiles); develop resilience in less tariff-sensitive sectors; and

7. Contract Manufacturing in the US: employing Indian origin US citizens and setting up or partnering with US-based manufacturing and food processing facilities to bypass import tariffs entirely.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2026年印美贸易协议对印度喀拉拉邦出口的影响，发现协议虽然降低了印度对美出口的互惠关税，但喀拉拉邦的椰子、海鲜、香料等产品仍面临压力，并提出了短期利用贸易转移、中期多元化市场、长期价值创新的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 2026年印美贸易协议对印度喀拉拉邦出口的影响是什么？以及喀拉拉邦应采取哪些贸易政策应对？
AI.motivation: 联邦贸易协议可能对未直接参与谈判的次联邦政府（如邦、省、地区）产生影响，需要分析具体影响机制。喀拉拉邦作为印度重要出口地区，其椰子、海鲜、香料、医疗设备和纺织品等主要出口产品可能受到印美贸易协议的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 次联邦治理影响机制理论、贸易协议对地方经济影响分析框架、部分均衡分析（TiNA）方法、贸易转移与贸易创造理论。
AI.method: 采用描述性统计分析喀拉拉邦对美出口数据（2019-2025年），使用部分均衡分析（TiNA）评估整体印度影响，结合喀拉拉邦具体出口产品分析进行推断性评估。
AI.findings: 1. 喀拉拉邦对美出口从2019年7.68亿美元增长至2024年9.5亿美元峰值；2. 美国占喀拉拉邦全球出口份额从7.5%增至19-20%；3. 主要出口产品为婴儿服装（5.28亿美元）、虾类（2.3亿美元）、姜黄油树脂（2.17亿美元）；4. 与中越泰相比，印度整体受影响程度相当或更低，为中国出口关税达7.3亿美元的核心产品提供机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了联邦贸易协议对次联邦治理影响的理论框架；2. 提出了贸易协议地方影响评估的方法论创新；3. 丰富了发展中国家次联邦单位应对国际贸易变化的策略理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为喀拉拉邦政府提供7项具体政策建议（跨领域质量建设、市场多元化、应对出口阻力、短期贸易转移利用、中期海鲜出口多元化、长期价值创新、美国合同制造）；2. 为其他印度邦提供应对国际贸易协议影响的参考框架；3. 为企业制定出口策略提供数据支持和方向指导。

title: Effects of a Cash Transfer Programme on Origin–destination Migration Flows
affiliations: Department of Economics FEA/USP and Depart of Economics, University of Sao Paulo

detail.title: Effects of a Cash Transfer Programme on Origin–destination Migration Flows

publicationDetails.detailsText: Regional Science Policy & Practice, volume 12, issue 1, 2020[10.1111/rsp3.12161]

detail.abstract: In this paper, we estimate the effects of Bolsa Familia programme (BFP) on migration flows among municipalities from 2008 to 2010. BFP is a Brazilian cash transfer programme to low-income families. We consider the aggregated origin-destination flows coming from a spatial dependent discrete choice model, and focus on interest variables related to the distribution of resources and supervision of the programme. We discuss possible lying mechanisms relating the interest variables and individual migration decisions. Each mechanism differs according to the individual status, the beneficiary of the programme or not, income profile, specific characteristics of its home municipality and potential destinations. Among our results, the control variables appear to agree with the main findings of migration literature. Moreover, the programme management was revealed relevant to the current and potential beneficiary locational choices, especially regarding the distribution of resources.

AI.tldr: 本文估计了2008-2010年巴西家庭补助金计划（BFP）对城市间移民流动的影响。研究发现，该计划的资源分配管理对当前和潜在受益者的区位选择有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 巴西家庭补助金计划（BFP）如何影响2008-2010年间城市间的移民流动？
AI.motivation: 理解现金转移计划对人口流动的影响，特别是针对低收入家庭的巴西家庭补助金计划如何通过资源分配和监督机制影响移民决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间依赖离散选择模型，考虑个人状态（是否为受益者）、收入状况、原籍城市特征和潜在目的地特征等因素，分析移民决策机制。
AI.method: 使用2008-2010年城市间移民流动的汇总数据，基于空间依赖离散选择模型，分析计划资源分配和监督相关的兴趣变量对移民流动的影响。
AI.findings: 控制变量与移民文献的主要发现一致；计划管理（特别是资源分配）对当前和潜在受益者的区位选择具有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了现金转移计划对移民影响的理论理解，提出了基于个人状态和计划管理特征的移民决策机制框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何通过调整资源分配和监督机制来影响低收入家庭移民决策的实证依据，有助于优化社会政策设计。

title: Determinants Of GDP In Somaliland

detail.title: Determinants Of GDP In Somaliland
detail.abstract: The economy of Somaliland faces persistent challenges driven by heavy import dependence, inflationary pressures, and exchange-rate volatility. This study provides empirical evidence on how key macroeconomic variables, imports, inflation, and the exchange rate, affect Somaliland's GDP. Using monthly data from January 2018 to January 2024 obtained from the Central Bank of Somaliland, the analysis applies an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) time-series model estimated in EViews 17. The results show that imports have a statistically significant positive impact on GDP (t = 4.40), while exchange rate movements have a highly significant effect (t = 11.16). In contrast, inflation is not statistically significant (t = 0.40, p = 0.687), indicating a weak relationship with GDP within the sample period. These findings suggest that Somaliland's growth dynamics are primarily shaped by external factors, particularly import flows and exchange rate conditions. The study recommends that policymakers prioritize exchange-rate stabilization and reduce excessive import dependence by promoting domestic production, especially in agriculture, and discouraging non-essential imports to enhance macroeconomic stability and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2018-2024年月度数据，通过OLS时间序列模型分析索马里兰宏观经济变量对GDP的影响。结果显示进口和汇率对GDP有显著影响，而通胀影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 进口、通货膨胀和汇率等关键宏观经济变量如何影响索马里兰的GDP？
AI.motivation: 索马里兰经济面临进口依赖严重、通胀压力和汇率波动等持续挑战，需要实证研究这些因素对经济增长的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论，特别是开放经济条件下的经济增长理论，分析进口、通胀和汇率对GDP的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2018年1月至2024年1月的月度数据，采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）时间序列模型，在EViews 17软件中进行估计。
AI.findings: 1. 进口对GDP有显著正向影响（t=4.40）；2. 汇率变动对GDP有高度显著影响（t=11.16）；3. 通货膨胀与GDP关系不显著（t=0.40，p=0.687）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家特别是冲突后地区的经济增长理论提供实证证据，验证了外部因素（进口和汇率）在小型开放经济中的主导作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者优先稳定汇率，通过促进农业生产和限制非必要进口来减少过度进口依赖，以增强宏观经济稳定和可持续增长。

title: Why the U.S. Dollar Is Worth Nothing and Runs Everything
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why the U.S. Dollar Is Worth Nothing and Runs Everything

declarations.declarationOfInterest: “I declare that I have no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this research.”
declarations.ethicsApproval: “This paper does not involve human subjects, patient data, or experimental research, and therefore did not require ethics approval.”
declarations.funderStatement: “This research received no external funding.”

detail.abstract: It's my belief that this paper discusses the "intrinsic value" of the U.S. dollar as being nonexistent, yet it continues to act as the world's premier form of payment today through its "institutional trust," "structural dominance," and "historical positioning." This paper provides a very thorough history of the development of monetary systems by documenting how money transitioned from being commodity backed to a fiat-based currency system, using the 1971 Nixon Shock as a key moment in that transition toward an increased level of monetary abstraction.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美元作为世界主要支付手段的"内在价值"缺失问题，分析其通过制度信任、结构优势和历史定位维持主导地位，并以1971年尼克松冲击为关键节点追溯货币从商品本位到法币体系的演变过程。
AI.research_question: 美元作为世界主要支付手段，其"内在价值"缺失的情况下，如何通过制度信任、结构优势和历史定位维持其主导地位？
AI.motivation: 理解美元在缺乏传统"内在价值"支撑的情况下，为何仍能作为全球主要支付手段，这有助于揭示现代货币体系的本质和全球金融体系的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度信任理论、结构优势理论、历史路径依赖理论、货币演变理论（从商品货币到法币体系）
AI.method: 历史分析方法，通过文献研究和历史事件分析（特别是1971年尼克松冲击），追溯货币体系从商品本位到法币体系的演变过程。
AI.findings: 美元的主导地位并非源于其"内在价值"，而是建立在制度信任、结构性优势和历史路径依赖之上；1971年尼克松冲击标志着货币体系从商品本位向法币体系的关键转变，增加了货币的抽象化程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解现代货币主导地位的新框架，强调制度信任、结构优势和历史定位的重要性，而非传统的内在价值概念；深化了对货币抽象化过程的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于维持货币信任和主导地位的洞见；帮助投资者和企业理解全球货币体系的运作机制；为国际金融体系改革提供理论基础。

title: Mispricing and ESG Stock Portfolios: The Role of Financing and Earnings Announcement
affiliations: University of Zaragoza - Faculty of Business and Economics, University of Deusto - Deusto Business School and University of Deusto - Deusto Business School

detail.title: Mispricing and ESG Stock Portfolios: The Role of Financing and Earnings Announcement

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Basque Government Department of Education (PIBA_2023_0030) and Government of Aragon under Grant S38_23R.

detail.abstract: We examine whether mispricing explains expected returns in top-and bottom-ESG portfolios using the Daniel et al. (2020) model for European stocks. Bottom-ESG portfolios show exposure to the FIN factor, suggesting long-term mispricing from corporate financing, while top-ESG portfolios do not. Mispricing dynamics vary in bullish and bearish markets. During bear markets, bottom-ESG portfolios show negative exposure to the PEAD factor, reflecting short-term mispricing from limited analyst coverage. The Paris Agreement reshaped ESG valuation by increasing sensitivity to financing signals. Even after incorporating Fama and French's (2015) risk factors, mispricing persists in bottom-ESG portfolios, contributing to the market efficiency debate.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Daniel等人(2020)模型检验欧洲股票中ESG表现最好和最差投资组合的预期回报是否由错误定价解释。研究发现底部ESG投资组合存在长期融资相关的错误定价，而顶部ESG投资组合则没有。巴黎协定改变了ESG估值动态，即使在控制传统风险因素后，错误定价仍然存在。
AI.research_question: 错误定价是否能够解释欧洲股票中ESG表现最好和最差投资组合的预期回报？
AI.motivation: 理解ESG投资组合的异常回报来源，特别是错误定价在ESG估值中的作用，以及巴黎协定等监管事件如何影响这种关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Daniel等人(2020)的错误定价模型，结合市场效率理论、行为金融学视角，以及Fama-French(2015)五因子模型作为风险控制基准。
AI.method: 使用Daniel等人(2020)模型分析欧洲股票数据，检验ESG投资组合对FIN因子和PEAD因子的暴露程度，分析牛市和熊市期间错误定价的动态变化，并评估巴黎协定的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 底部ESG投资组合对FIN因子有暴露，表明存在长期融资相关的错误定价；顶部ESG投资组合则没有
2. 错误定价动态在牛市和熊市中有差异：熊市期间，底部ESG投资组合对PEAD因子有负向暴露，反映分析师覆盖不足导致的短期错误定价
3. 巴黎协定改变了ESG估值，增加了对融资信号的敏感性
4. 即使控制Fama-French(2015)风险因素后，底部ESG投资组合的错误定价仍然存在
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为市场效率辩论提供新证据，显示ESG投资组合中存在系统性错误定价
2. 扩展了错误定价理论在ESG投资领域的应用
3. 揭示了监管事件（如巴黎协定）对资产定价机制的影响
4. 区分了长期融资相关错误定价和短期信息不对称相关错误定价
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为ESG投资者提供投资策略参考，特别是针对底部ESG投资组合的错误定价机会
2. 帮助投资者理解不同市场环境下ESG投资的风险收益特征
3. 为监管机构提供关于ESG政策实施效果的实证证据
4. 为分析师和投资经理提供评估ESG投资组合风险的新框架

title: The 2008 Financial Crisis Exposed the Illusion of Asset Value
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The 2008 Financial Crisis Exposed the Illusion of Asset Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no known personal or financial conflicts of interest that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical and historical analysis and did not involve human subjects or participant data. Ethics approval was not required.
