title: Why has Decreasing Schooling Inequality Not Led to Decreasing Earnings Inequality in South Africa?
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, University of Cape Town (UCT) - Faculty of Commerce, Southern Africa Labour and Development Research Unit, The World Bank and University of Cape Town

detail.title: Why has Decreasing Schooling Inequality Not Led to Decreasing Earnings Inequality in South Africa?
detail.abstract:
Inequality in education has declined substantially in South Africa since the end of apartheid, with inequality in years of completed education declining by all standard measures of inequality. At the same time, inequality in earnings has not shown significant declines, and has increased by some measures. Given the strong positive relationship between earnings and years of education, why hasn’t the decline in education inequality led to declines in earnings inequality? This paper explores this puzzle from both a theoretical and empirical perspective. We analyse how earnings inequality is affected by changes in returns to schooling when returns increase at some levels of schooling and decrease at other levels. We show that changes in the distribution of education over the 1994-2019 period would have significantly reduced earnings inequality in and of themselves. This was offset by disequalizing changes in the earnings-education gradient, including an increase in relative earnings for those with post-secondary education and a decrease in relative earnings for those with incomplete secondary education. The net result is a combination of decreasing schooling inequality and persistently high earnings inequality,

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 南非教育不平等在种族隔离结束后显著下降，但收入不平等并未相应减少。研究发现，教育分布的变化本应降低收入不平等，但教育回报率的变化（高等教育回报率上升、不完全中等教育回报率下降）抵消了这一效应，导致教育不平等下降而收入不平等持续高企。
AI.research_question: 为什么南非教育不平等的显著下降没有导致收入不平等的相应减少？
AI.motivation: 南非在种族隔离结束后教育不平等大幅下降，但收入不平等并未相应减少，这与教育对收入的强正相关关系形成矛盾，需要解释这一谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育回报率变化理论，分析当不同教育水平的回报率发生不同方向变化时（某些水平上升、某些水平下降）对收入不平等的影响。
AI.method: 理论与实证分析相结合，使用1994-2019年期间的数据，分析教育分布变化和教育回报率变化对收入不平等的各自影响。
AI.findings: 1. 教育分布的变化本身会显著降低收入不平等；2. 但教育回报率的变化（高等教育相对收入上升、不完全中等教育相对收入下降）抵消了这一效应；3. 净结果是教育不平等下降而收入不平等持续高企。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了理解教育不平等与收入不平等关系的理论框架，特别关注教育回报率在不同教育水平上的异质性变化如何影响总体收入不平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供洞见：单纯扩大教育机会可能不足以减少收入不平等，需要同时关注教育回报率的结构性变化，特别是高等教育与中等教育之间的回报率差距。

title: Range Anxiety
affiliations: Cornell University - Department of Economics, Stanford University and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Range Anxiety
detail.abstract:
Range anxiety, the fear of depleting battery before reaching a charging station, is often cited as a major barrier to electric vehicle (EV) adoption, yet there has been limited formal economic analysis to quantify its magnitude and examine the policy implications. We develop a continuous-time dynamic model of EV usage and charging decisions to micro-found range anxiety as the utility loss from feasible yet unrealized trips due to perceived range constraints. Using high-frequency data of 188,000 EV trips and 26,000 charging events among 8,000 EVs in Shanghai, we recover model parameters governing consumer driving and charging decisions. The estimates imply that, across EV models with varying driving ranges, average range anxiety was about $1,900 in 2021 but declined to $1,200 in 2024, driven by improvements in charging infrastructure and, especially, increases in driving range. Policy simulations underscore the importance of coordinating investments in driving range and charging infrastructure to address range anxiety. Relative to socially optimal levels, Shanghai’s EV market has under-invested in driving range but over-invested in charging infrastructure.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过连续时间动态模型量化了电动汽车用户的"里程焦虑"成本，发现2021年平均焦虑成本为1900美元，2024年降至1200美元，主要原因是充电基础设施改善和续航里程提升。政策模拟显示上海市场在续航里程上投资不足，但在充电基础设施上过度投资。
AI.research_question: 如何量化电动汽车用户的里程焦虑成本？充电基础设施和续航里程如何影响里程焦虑？政策应如何协调这两方面的投资以缓解里程焦虑？
AI.motivation: 里程焦虑被认为是阻碍电动汽车普及的主要障碍，但缺乏正式的经济分析来量化其影响并探讨政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间动态模型，将里程焦虑定义为由于感知的续航限制而无法实现的可行行程所带来的效用损失。
AI.method: 使用上海8,000辆电动汽车的188,000次行程和26,000次充电事件的高频数据，恢复消费者驾驶和充电决策的模型参数。
AI.findings: 不同续航里程的电动汽车平均里程焦虑成本从2021年的1900美元降至2024年的1200美元；充电基础设施改善和续航里程提升是主要原因；上海市场在续航里程上投资不足，但在充电基础设施上过度投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为里程焦虑提供了正式的微观经济基础，将其量化为效用损失；开发了连续时间动态模型来分析电动汽车使用和充电决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化里程焦虑的方法；强调了协调续航里程和充电基础设施投资的重要性；指出当前投资配置存在偏差，需要调整。

title: Job Loss and Health Insurance Coverage Before and After the Affordable Care Act
affiliations: Claremont McKenna College and

detail.title: Job Loss and Health Insurance Coverage Before and After the Affordable Care Act
detail.abstract:
We examine how the Affordable Care Act (ACA) altered the insurance consequences of involuntary job loss. Using matched event-study models with longitudinal survey data, we estimate the causal effects of displacement on insurance coverage before and after implementation of the ACA’s main provisions. Prior to 2014, job loss reduced coverage by approximately 16 percentage points, with losses persisting for more than a year. After the ACA, declines are smaller—about 10 percentage points—and recovery is faster. Gains reflect higher baseline public coverage and reduced post-displacement losses, with the largest improvements among middle income workers previously most exposed to coverage disruptions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了《平价医疗法案》(ACA)如何改变了非自愿失业对医疗保险覆盖的影响。研究发现，ACA实施前，失业导致医保覆盖率下降约16个百分点，且影响持续一年以上；ACA实施后，降幅缩小至约10个百分点，恢复速度加快。改善主要来自公共医保覆盖率的提高和失业后损失的减少，中等收入工人受益最大。
AI.research_question: 《平价医疗法案》(ACA)如何改变了非自愿失业对医疗保险覆盖的影响？
AI.motivation: 在美国，医疗保险通常与就业挂钩，失业可能导致保险中断。ACA旨在扩大医保覆盖范围，但其对失业人群保险后果的具体影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康保险获取与就业关系的理论，以及政策干预对劳动力市场结果影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用匹配事件研究模型和纵向调查数据，估计ACA主要条款实施前后失业对医保覆盖的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 2014年ACA实施前，失业导致医保覆盖率下降约16个百分点，影响持续一年以上；2. ACA实施后，降幅缩小至约10个百分点，恢复速度加快；3. 改善主要源于公共医保覆盖率的提高和失业后损失的减少；4. 中等收入工人受益最大，他们之前最易受保险中断影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策干预如何缓冲劳动力市场冲击对社会保障的影响提供了实证证据，丰富了关于就业与医保关联性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 证明ACA有效减轻了失业对医保覆盖的负面影响；2. 为政策制定者提供了评估医保改革效果的经验依据；3. 识别了中等收入工人作为政策最大受益群体，有助于未来政策优化。

title: Good Neighborhoods, Good Neighbors, Good Jobs?
affiliations: University of Colorado - Boulder, University of Texas at Austin and VIVE - The Danish Center for Social Science Research

detail.title: Good Neighborhoods, Good Neighbors, Good Jobs?
detail.abstract:
While a growing literature has documented the effect of neighborhoods on children, there is little evidence on how neighborhoods impact adults. This study examines the impact of neighborhoods on high-needs families in Denmark who are quasi-randomly assigned to social housing in different neighborhoods. Results indicate a one standard deviation improvement in nearby neighborhood quality causes a 0.08 standard deviation improvement in labor market outcomes, and a 2.8 percent reduction in the likelihood of criminal conviction. Additional results indicate the labor market effects are most consistent with additional job referrals from nearby neighbors, rather than differences in local job availability.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 丹麦研究发现，社区质量对高需求家庭有显著影响：社区质量每提升一个标准差，劳动力市场表现改善0.08个标准差，犯罪定罪率降低2.8%。效应主要来自邻居的工作推荐而非当地就业机会差异。
AI.research_question: 社区环境如何影响高需求家庭成年人的劳动力市场表现和犯罪行为？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注社区对儿童的影响，但对成年人影响的研究证据不足，特别是对高需求家庭成年人的影响机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 邻里效应理论、社会网络理论、劳动力市场匹配理论
AI.method: 准随机实验设计，利用丹麦高需求家庭被分配到不同社区社会住房的自然实验，采用工具变量方法分析社区质量对成年人的影响
AI.findings: 1. 社区质量每提升一个标准差，劳动力市场表现改善0.08个标准差；2. 犯罪定罪率降低2.8%；3. 劳动力市场效应主要来自邻居的工作推荐，而非当地就业机会差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展邻里效应理论到成年人群体；2. 揭示社会网络机制（工作推荐）在邻里效应中的重要作用；3. 区分了邻里效应的不同作用渠道
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为住房政策提供实证依据；2. 强调社区社会资本建设的重要性；3. 为弱势群体支持政策提供新视角

title: Household Responses to Private Risk Information
affiliations: University of Basel and Columbia University

detail.title: Household Responses to Private Risk Information
detail.abstract:
We study how private information affects household responses to environmental risk. Using data from residential air quality monitors, we exploit the timing of monitor installation and high-frequency fine particulate matter (PM2.5) readings to identify responses to new information about indoor pollution risk. We find that indoor PM2.5 concentrations decline by 2.5 ug/m3 over the 12 weeks following installation, conditional on contemporaneous outdoor pollution, with effects significantly larger among households with high initial indoor pollution. The indoor–outdoor pollution gradient declines over time, indicating that households become increasingly effective at mitigating exposure when marginal health damages are highest. Using machine learning techniques to infer cooking activity and air purifier adoption, we show that households respond primarily through durable defensive investments rather than reductions in pollution-generating behavior, with back-of-the-envelope calculations implying positive net benefits. Our results suggest that personalized risk information increases the salience of indoor pollution as a controllable risk for households, in contrast to spatially coarse public information that frames pollution primarily as an outdoor threat requiring avoidance.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，家庭在获得室内空气质量监测器提供的个性化风险信息后，会通过购买空气净化器等防御性投资来降低室内PM2.5污染，而不是减少烹饪等活动，且净收益为正。
AI.research_question: 私人信息如何影响家庭对环境风险的反应？具体来说，获得室内空气质量监测器提供的个性化风险信息后，家庭会如何调整行为来应对室内污染风险？
AI.motivation: 现有公共空气质量信息通常关注室外污染，将污染视为需要避免的室外威胁，而忽视了室内污染作为可控制风险的重要性。需要了解个性化风险信息是否能提高家庭对室内污染风险的认知并促进行为改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和行为经济学理论，探讨个性化风险信息如何通过提高风险显著性来影响家庭决策，特别是防御性投资与行为调整之间的选择。
AI.method: 利用住宅空气质量监测器的安装时机和高频PM2.5读数作为准自然实验，采用机器学习技术推断烹饪活动和空气净化器采用情况，并进行粗略计算评估净收益。
AI.findings: 1. 监测器安装后12周内，室内PM2.5浓度下降2.5 ug/m³；2. 初始污染高的家庭效果更显著；3. 室内外污染梯度随时间下降；4. 家庭主要通过购买空气净化器等防御性投资而非减少污染行为来应对；5. 粗略计算显示净收益为正。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了个性化风险信息在环境风险应对中的重要作用；2. 区分了防御性投资与行为调整两种应对策略；3. 挑战了传统公共信息将污染主要视为室外威胁的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为推广室内空气质量监测提供实证支持；2. 为政策制定者设计更有效的环境风险沟通策略提供参考；3. 表明个性化信息干预可能比粗粒度的公共信息更有效。

title: Public Finance in the Age of AI: A Primer
affiliations: and University of Virginia - Department of Economics

detail.title: Public Finance in the Age of AI: A Primer
detail.abstract:
Transformative artificial intelligence (TAI) - machines capable of performing virtually all economically valuable work - may gradually erode the two main tax bases that underpin modern tax systems: labor income and human consumption. We examine optimal taxation across two stages of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven transformation. First, if AI displaces human labor, we find that consumption taxation may serve as a primary revenue instrument, with differential commodity taxation gaining renewed relevance as labor distortions lose their constraining role. In the second stage, as autonomous artificial general intelligence (AGI) systems both produce most economic value and absorb a growing share of resources, taxing human consumption may become an inadequate means of raising revenue. We show that the taxation of autonomous AGI systems can be framed as an optimal harvesting problem and find that the resulting tax rate on AGI depends on the rate at which humans discount the future. Our analysis provides a theoretically grounded approach to balancing efficiency and equity in the Age of AI. We also apply our insights to evaluate specific proposals such as taxes on robots, compute, and tokens, as well as sovereign wealth funds and windfall clauses.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在变革性人工智能（TAI）时代的最优税收政策，分析了AI如何侵蚀传统税基（劳动收入和人类消费），并提出了针对自主AGI系统的税收框架。
AI.research_question: 在变革性人工智能（TAI）逐步侵蚀传统税基（劳动收入和人类消费）的背景下，如何设计最优税收政策来平衡效率和公平？
AI.motivation: 变革性人工智能（TAI）可能能够执行几乎所有具有经济价值的工作，这将逐渐侵蚀现代税收体系的两大主要税基：劳动收入和人类消费，因此需要重新思考税收政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优税收理论、公共财政理论、人工智能经济学、变革性人工智能（TAI）理论、自主AGI系统税收框架（最优收获问题）
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过构建两阶段AI驱动转型模型：第一阶段AI替代人类劳动，第二阶段自主AGI系统主导经济生产和消费
AI.findings: 1. AI替代人类劳动阶段：消费税可能成为主要收入工具，差异化商品税重新获得重要性；2. 自主AGI主导阶段：对人类消费征税变得不足，需要直接对AGI系统征税；3. AGI税率取决于人类对未来贴现率；4. 机器人税、计算税、代币税等具体提案需要在此框架下评估
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了AI时代两阶段税收转型的理论框架；2. 将自主AGI系统税收问题形式化为最优收获问题；3. 建立了AGI税率与人类时间偏好之间的理论联系；4. 为AI时代平衡效率与公平提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了AI时代税收改革的路线图；2. 评估了机器人税、计算税、代币税等具体政策提案的合理性；3. 为主权财富基金和暴利条款等制度设计提供理论依据；4. 帮助政府应对AI对传统税收体系的冲击

title: A Unified Urban Model With Non-Homothetic Housing Demand
affiliations: University of Geneva, Sciences Po, University of Pennsylvania - Real Estate Department and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: A Unified Urban Model With Non-Homothetic Housing Demand
detail.abstract:
Canonical urban models fail to jointly account for flexible housing demand, nondegenerate city sizes, and observed urban systems. We introduce a unifying urban framework based on price-independent generalized linear (PIGL) preferences in which housing is a necessity. Non-homothetic housing demand generates income effects that cause urban costs to scale more strongly with population than wages, restoring a unique interior efficient city size under standard assumptions. The framework nests existing canonical models, remains tractable, and is consistent with key empirical regularities, including Zipf’s law and observed housing price elasticities. We also encapsulate a monocentric city model into our framework.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于价格独立广义线性（PIGL）偏好的统一城市框架，其中住房是必需品。非位似的住房需求产生收入效应，使城市成本随人口增长的速度超过工资增长，从而在标准假设下恢复唯一的内点有效城市规模。该框架包含了现有的经典模型，保持可处理性，并与关键经验规律一致。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的城市框架，能够同时考虑灵活的住房需求、非退化的城市规模和观察到的城市系统？
AI.motivation: 经典城市模型无法同时解释灵活的住房需求、非退化城市规模和观察到的城市系统，需要一个新的统一框架来解决这些局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格独立广义线性（PIGL）偏好的城市理论框架，其中住房被视为必需品，非位似的住房需求产生收入效应。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，将PIGL偏好纳入城市框架，分析住房需求、城市成本和工资之间的动态关系，并将单中心城市模型纳入该框架。
AI.findings: 非位似的住房需求产生的收入效应使城市成本随人口增长的速度超过工资增长，从而恢复唯一的内点有效城市规模；该框架能够嵌套现有经典模型，保持可处理性，并与Zipf定律和观察到的住房价格弹性等经验规律一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的城市理论框架，解决了经典模型无法同时处理灵活住房需求、非退化城市规模和城市系统的局限性；展示了非位似偏好如何影响城市规模的决定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划和政策制定提供了更符合现实的理论基础；有助于理解城市规模分布（如Zipf定律）和住房市场动态；为城市发展政策提供理论指导。

title: Settlement of Litigation May Increase or Decrease Deterrence and Social Welfare
affiliations: Harvard Law School

detail.title: Settlement of Litigation May Increase or Decrease Deterrence and Social Welfare
detail.abstract:
Although the obvious effect of settlement is to save litigants the costs of trial, settlement also influences deterrence—and for two reasons. First, because settlement is agreed upon by plaintiffs, it raises their expected return from litigation and thus the probability of suit. This augments deterrence. Second, because settlement is agreed upon by defendants, it lowers their expected costs of litigation and therefore dilutes deterrence. The primary objective of the article is to identify the net effect of settlement on deterrence and on social welfare in a model of accidents, liability, and litigation. The conditions for the bringing of suit in the model are not only that plaintiffs be willing to go to trial, but also that their anticipated settlements would exceed their pretrial costs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了和解对威慑效应和社会福利的影响。和解虽然节省了诉讼成本，但通过提高原告预期回报（增强威慑）和降低被告预期成本（削弱威慑）产生双重影响。文章建立了一个事故、责任和诉讼模型，分析和解对威慑的净效应。
AI.research_question: 和解对威慑效应和社会福利的净影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 和解虽然能节省诉讼成本，但其对威慑效应的影响存在矛盾：一方面提高原告预期回报从而增强威慑，另一方面降低被告预期成本从而削弱威慑。需要系统分析这种双重影响的净效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于事故、责任和诉讼的经济学模型，结合威慑理论、诉讼经济学和福利经济学框架。
AI.method: 构建理论模型分析和解对诉讼概率、威慑效应和社会福利的影响，考虑原告和被告的决策行为以及诉讼成本因素。
AI.findings: 和解对威慑效应产生双重影响：通过提高原告预期回报增加诉讼概率从而增强威慑，同时通过降低被告预期成本削弱威慑。净效应取决于具体条件，需要权衡这两种相反的力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统分析了和解对威慑效应的双重影响机制，建立了完整的理论框架来评估和解的净效应，丰富了诉讼经济学和威慑理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估和解制度设计的理论依据，帮助理解和解如何影响诉讼行为、威慑效果和社会福利，对司法改革有指导意义。

title: Job Search, Job Amenities and the Gender Pay Gap
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, University of Oslo, Department of Economics and Princeton University

detail.title: Job Search, Job Amenities and the Gender Pay Gap
detail.abstract:
This paper studies gender gaps in labor-market outcomes, with a focus on job ladder dynamics. We show that women experience substantially lower wage growth conditional on prior wages despite nearly identical job-to-job transition rates for men and women. To reconcile these observations, we document gender differences in the valuation of nonwage job amenities and in job search behavior, and develop a multi-dimensional job-ladder model with endogenous search effort where workers value both wages and amenities. The model allows for gender heterogeneity in separation rates, search effort, the value of nonemployment, amenity valuations, and bargaining power, enabling a joint analysis of gender wage and employment gaps. A quantitative decomposition shows that differences in preferences for nonwage amenities account for nearly 40 percent of the gender pay gap. Differences in the value of nonemployment and bargaining power explain most of the remainder, with only a limited role for differences in separation rates and search behavior. Finally, we show that increases in job amenities—such as the expansion of remote work—raise the gender wage gap while reducing gender differences in employment.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究劳动力市场结果的性别差异，重点关注职业阶梯动态。研究发现女性在相同工资条件下工资增长显著低于男性，尽管男女工作转换率几乎相同。通过建立多维职业阶梯模型，发现非工资福利偏好差异解释了约40%的性别薪酬差距。
AI.research_question: 性别在劳动力市场结果（特别是工资增长和就业动态）方面存在哪些差异？这些差异如何通过职业阶梯动态、非工资福利偏好和搜索行为来解释？
AI.motivation: 尽管男性和女性的工作转换率几乎相同，但女性在相同工资条件下的工资增长显著低于男性。这一观察结果需要解释，以理解性别薪酬差距的根源和动态机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维职业阶梯模型，包含内生搜索努力，工人同时重视工资和非工资福利。模型允许性别在离职率、搜索努力、非就业价值、福利估值和议价能力方面的异质性。
AI.method: 建立理论模型并进行定量分解分析。使用实证数据记录性别在非工资福利估值和求职行为方面的差异，然后通过模型进行反事实模拟和分解。
AI.findings: 1. 女性在相同工资条件下工资增长显著低于男性；2. 非工资福利偏好差异解释了约40%的性别薪酬差距；3. 非就业价值和议价能力差异解释了大部分剩余差距；4. 离职率和搜索行为差异作用有限；5. 工作福利增加（如远程工作扩张）会扩大性别工资差距但减少就业差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了包含内生搜索努力和多维偏好的职业阶梯模型；2. 提供了性别薪酬差距和就业差距的联合分析框架；3. 将非工资福利偏好纳入性别差异分析的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了非工资福利偏好是性别薪酬差距的重要驱动因素；2. 揭示了政策干预（如远程工作）对性别差距的复杂影响；3. 为企业设计和政策制定提供了关于如何平衡工资和非工资福利的见解。

title: Bank Runs and Interest Rates: A Revolving Lines Perspective
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Harvard University

detail.title: Bank Runs and Interest Rates: A Revolving Lines Perspective
detail.abstract:
Revolving credit is at the core of the banking business. Corporate revolving lines are demandable claims; thus, similar to a traditional run on deposits, sudden and widespread drawdowns can destabilize banks. However, unlike deposits, credit line utilization exhibits substantial interest rate sensitivity. As a result, a run on revolving credit lines is less likely in a high-interest-rate environment but can introduce vulnerabilities when policy rates are lowered. Using an interest rate discontinuity commonly embedded in commercial credit contracts, we propose a methodology to estimate the elasticity of credit demand and apply it to measure the sensitivity of precautionary drawdowns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业循环信贷额度在利率变化下的提取行为，发现与存款挤兑不同，信贷额度提取对利率高度敏感，高利率环境下挤兑风险较低，但低利率政策可能引发信贷挤兑风险。
AI.research_question: 企业循环信贷额度提取行为如何受利率变化影响？利率敏感性如何影响银行体系的稳定性？
AI.motivation: 循环信贷是银行业务核心，企业循环信贷额度类似于可随时提取的存款，大规模突然提取可能引发银行不稳定。但与存款不同，信贷额度使用对利率高度敏感，这可能在低利率环境下引入新的金融脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行挤兑理论，但扩展至信贷额度领域；结合利率敏感性理论，分析信贷需求弹性；运用预防性提取理论解释企业信贷行为。
AI.method: 利用商业信贷合同中常见的利率不连续性作为识别策略，提出估计信贷需求弹性的方法，并应用于衡量预防性提取的敏感性。
AI.findings: 信贷额度提取对利率高度敏感；高利率环境下信贷挤兑风险较低；低利率政策可能引发信贷挤兑风险；预防性提取行为受利率变化显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了银行挤兑理论至信贷额度领域；建立了利率敏感性与信贷挤兑风险的理论联系；提出了信贷需求弹性的新估计方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行风险管理提供新视角；为货币政策制定者提供关于低利率环境下金融稳定性的警示；为企业信贷管理提供参考。

title: Intangible Intensity
affiliations: UCLA Anderson School of Management, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and

detail.title: Intangible Intensity
detail.abstract:
We develop a text-based measure of intangible investment intensity derived from firms’ 10-K filings, and offer a general methodology for semantic theme scoring (STS). Our approach further classifies disclosure text into knowledge, customer, and organization capital. Firms with high intangible intensity are smaller, younger, and invest heavily in R&D and human capital. The three subcomponents map cleanly to distinct economic firm types: knowledge-intensive firms are R&D-driven with high valuations and skilled labor; customer-intensive firms are mature, profitable, and commercially oriented; and organization-intensive firms are large, asset-heavy incumbents. Managerial expenditure descriptions thus provide informative signals about intangible investment, complementing financial statements in capturing corporate capital stocks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于企业10-K文件文本的度量方法，用于衡量无形资产投资强度，并提出语义主题评分（STS）的通用方法。该方法将披露文本分为知识资本、客户资本和组织资本三类，发现不同无形资产类型对应不同的企业经济特征。
AI.research_question: 如何基于企业披露文本有效度量无形资产投资强度？不同类型的无形资产（知识、客户、组织资本）如何反映企业的经济特征？
AI.motivation: 传统财务报表难以充分捕捉无形资产投资，而无形资产在现代经济中日益重要。需要开发新的度量方法来补充财务信息，更好地理解企业资本结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无形资产理论，包括知识资本、客户资本和组织资本的概念框架；文本分析在财务研究中的应用理论。
AI.method: 开发语义主题评分（STS）方法，基于企业10-K文件文本分析，构建无形资产投资强度度量，并将文本分类为知识、客户和组织资本三类。
AI.findings: 1. 高无形资产强度的企业通常规模较小、较年轻，在研发和人力资本上投资较多。2. 三类无形资产对应不同的企业类型：知识密集型企业是研发驱动、估值高、技术劳动力密集；客户密集型企业成熟、盈利、商业导向；组织密集型企业规模大、资产重、行业在位者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了语义主题评分（STS）的通用方法论。2. 建立了基于文本的无形资产度量框架。3. 深化了对不同类型无形资产经济含义的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和分析师提供了补充财务信息的工具。2. 帮助企业更好地理解和披露无形资产。3. 为政策制定者提供了衡量无形资产投资的新视角。

title: Do Informal Social Markets and Online Sellers Help Youths to Avoid E-Cigarette Taxation?
affiliations: Michigan State University, Bentley University - Department of Economics, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) - NY Office, San Diego State University, Wake Forest University and San Diego State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Do Informal Social Markets and Online Sellers Help Youths to Avoid E-Cigarette Taxation?
detail.abstract:
Youths who vape nicotine rarely make in-person purchases of e-cigarettes from a vendor but instead rely on alternative methods to obtain electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) products. This study is the first to explore whether the informal social market and online purchasing options help to insulate youths from e-cigarette taxation. Using data from the State Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance Surveys, we find that ENDS taxation reduces both the likelihood of teens obtaining ENDS products through direct in-person retail purchases as well as the likelihood of relying on informal social sources for e-cigarettes such as borrowing vaping devices from friends or third-party purchases. Auxiliary analyses from the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health are generally consistent with these findings and suggest that impacts are concentrated on the initiation margin; higher ENDS taxes deter youths initiating through direct retail purchases as well as through the social market. For older teens ages 18 and older, however, we find that informal social sources may attenuate the impacts of e-cigarette taxes. Finally, we detect some evidence that ENDS taxes increases the likelihood that teenagers shift to online sources to obtain e-cigarettes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 电子烟税收能减少青少年通过零售和社交渠道获取电子烟，但可能促使他们转向线上购买。对于18岁以上青少年，社交渠道会减弱税收效果。
AI.research_question: 非正式社交市场和在线购买渠道是否帮助青少年规避电子烟税收的影响？
AI.motivation: 青少年很少通过实体店购买电子烟，而是依赖其他渠道获取。需要研究这些替代渠道是否削弱了电子烟税收政策的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收政策对消费者行为的影响理论；青少年获取烟草产品的替代渠道理论；价格弹性与替代效应理论。
AI.method: 使用州青少年风险行为监测调查数据；辅助分析使用烟草与健康人口评估数据；分析电子烟税收对青少年获取渠道的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 电子烟税收减少青少年通过零售和社交渠道获取电子烟；2. 影响主要集中在初次尝试阶段；3. 对于18岁以上青少年，社交渠道会减弱税收效果；4. 税收可能促使青少年转向线上购买。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究电子烟税收对青少年获取渠道的影响；揭示了税收政策通过不同渠道对青少年行为的复杂影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：电子烟税收能有效减少青少年获取，但需关注线上购买渠道的监管；针对不同年龄群体需要差异化政策。

title: Industrial Policies for Multi-Stage Production: The Battle for Battery-Powered Vehicles
affiliations: University of British Columbia (UBC) - Division of Strategy and Business Economics, Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po), Harvard University and Singapore Management University

detail.title: Industrial Policies for Multi-Stage Production: The Battle for Battery-Powered Vehicles
detail.abstract:
We model a multi-stage supply chain for EVs from battery production to vehicle distribution. Given industrial policies, firms select where to open facilities at each stage. This is a difficult combinatorial choice problem that we solve with a fast mixed integer linear programming formulation. We estimate the variable and fixed costs parameters using SMM. Counterfactual simulations reveal a tension between boosting EV adoption and promoting domestic supply chains. Due to increasing returns, even unconditional subsidies raise the number of factories in the subsidizing region—by about 16% for EVs and 7% for cells in North America, and even more in Europe. Theoretically, local assembly requirements can push down delivered marginal costs relative to unconditional subsidies. Empirically, local content requirements quadruple the expansion of cell factories in America, but they drive up costs and reduce subsidy uptake, undoing more than half of the EV adoption stimulus coming from pure buyer subsidies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多阶段供应链模型分析电动汽车产业政策，发现无条件补贴能促进区域工厂扩张，但本地组装要求虽能扩大电池工厂规模，却会推高成本并削弱补贴效果。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车产业政策（如补贴和本地含量要求）如何影响多阶段供应链中的设施选址决策、成本结构和电动汽车采用率？
AI.motivation: 各国政府推行电动汽车产业政策以促进国内供应链和电动汽车采用，但这些政策在复杂的多阶段供应链中的实际效果尚不明确，需要量化分析政策对设施选址、成本和采用率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多阶段供应链选址理论，结合规模报酬递增效应，分析产业政策在复杂供应链网络中的传导机制。
AI.method: 建立电动汽车从电池生产到车辆分销的多阶段供应链模型，采用混合整数线性规划求解设施选址问题，使用模拟矩估计法（SMM）估计可变成本和固定成本参数，进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 无条件补贴能显著增加补贴区域的工厂数量（北美电动汽车工厂约16%，电池工厂约7%，欧洲增幅更大）；2. 理论上，本地组装要求相比无条件补贴能降低边际交付成本；3. 实践中，本地含量要求使美国电池工厂扩张四倍，但推高成本并降低补贴使用率，抵消了超过一半的纯购买补贴带来的电动汽车采用刺激效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了产业政策在复杂多阶段供应链中的传导机制；2. 阐明了规模报酬递增如何放大政策效果；3. 理论证明了本地组装要求相比无条件补贴在降低边际成本方面的潜在优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了量化评估工具；2. 揭示了无条件补贴和本地含量要求之间的权衡：前者促进采用但可能削弱国内供应链，后者强化供应链但可能推高成本并削弱补贴效果；3. 为电动汽车产业政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: The Local Origins of Business Formation: Entry as a Two-Stage Process
affiliations: Center for Economic Studies - US Census Bureau, University of Notre Dame, Department of Economics and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: The Local Origins of Business Formation: Entry as a Two-Stage Process
detail.abstract:
The business entry literature typically observes firms only at the first hire. We provide a new perspective using linked administrative microdata tracking the universe of U.S. business applications and their transition into employer firms. We model entry as a two-stage process: pursuit of a business idea (proxied by a business application) and implementation (transition). Results show these margins are distinct and associate differently with local conditions. While both margins matter, high-startup locations are characterized by high application intensity, whereas low-startup locations exhibit low transition rates, suggesting geographic disparities in entry arise from different dynamics at each stage of the entrepreneurial process.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国企业申请数据，将创业过程建模为两个阶段：商业想法追求（企业申请）和实施（过渡为雇主企业）。研究发现这两个阶段是独立的，且受不同地方条件影响。高创业率地区主要源于高申请强度，而低创业率地区则因低过渡率导致。
AI.research_question: 企业进入过程如何分阶段进行？不同地理区域的创业差异是由创业过程的哪个阶段造成的？
AI.motivation: 传统创业文献仅观察企业首次雇佣时点，缺乏对创业过程的全面理解。需要更细致地分析创业过程的不同阶段及其地理差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业过程两阶段理论：1) 商业想法追求阶段（企业申请）；2) 实施阶段（过渡为雇主企业）。
AI.method: 使用美国行政微观数据，追踪全美企业申请及其向雇主企业的过渡过程，建立两阶段模型分析。
AI.findings: 创业过程的两个阶段是独立的，受不同地方条件影响。高创业率地区主要源于高申请强度，低创业率地区则因低过渡率导致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创业过程的两阶段模型，扩展了传统创业文献的视角，揭示了地理差异在不同创业阶段的不同表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精准的创业支持方向：高创业率地区应关注申请质量，低创业率地区应提高过渡成功率。

title: Shielding Women from Violence: The Effects of Violence Prevention and Monitoring Centers on Intimate Partner Violence in Türkiye
affiliations: Middle East Technical University, Northeastern University (USA), American University, TED University and Anadolu University

detail.title: Shielding Women from Violence: The Effects of Violence Prevention and Monitoring Centers on Intimate Partner Violence in Türkiye
detail.abstract:
Intimate partner violence remains one of the most serious threats to women's safety worldwide, yet existing evidence on the effectiveness of large-scale institutional protection systems is limited and mixed. This paper evaluates the impact of Violence Prevention and Monitoring Centers on intimate partner violence (IPV) against women in Türkiye. Exploiting the staggered rollout of centers across provinces, we find that the opening of a center reduces female homicides, particularly those perpetrated by intimate partners, by approximately 20 percent. Complementary survey evidence shows that the opening of a center also reduces women's self-reported exposure to physical IPV by 20 percent, with larger effects among younger and less-educated women. Exploring potential mechanisms, we find that centers primarily reduce violence by lowering barriers to help-seeking and improving coordination across police, legal, and social services: following the opening of a center, women become more likely to seek support from women's organizations and social services, while direct applications to prosecutors decline. We find no evidence of effects on gender attitudes, labor market outcomes, relationship status, marriage market outcomes, or mental health, suggesting violence reductions operate through improved access to protection rather than changes in norms or economic independence. The estimated effects are stronger in provinces with more gender-progressive norms and stronger institutional capacity, highlighting the importance of complementary social and institutional environments.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了土耳其暴力预防与监测中心对亲密伴侣暴力的影响，发现中心设立使女性凶杀案减少约20%，特别是亲密伴侣实施的凶杀，同时使女性自我报告的身体暴力减少20%。效果主要通过降低求助障碍和改善机构协调实现，而非改变社会规范或经济独立。
AI.research_question: 暴力预防与监测中心对土耳其亲密伴侣暴力（特别是针对女性的暴力）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 亲密伴侣暴力是全球女性安全最严重的威胁之一，但现有关于大规模制度保护体系有效性的证据有限且结果不一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度保护体系理论，探讨机构协调、求助障碍降低等机制如何影响暴力预防效果。
AI.method: 利用土耳其各省暴力预防与监测中心交错设立的自然实验，采用双重差分法评估影响，并辅以调查证据分析机制。
AI.findings: 1. 中心设立使女性凶杀案减少约20%，特别是亲密伴侣实施的凶杀；2. 女性自我报告的身体暴力减少20%，年轻和低教育程度女性效果更大；3. 机制主要是降低求助障碍和改善警察、法律、社会服务协调；4. 对性别态度、劳动力市场、婚姻市场等无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为制度保护体系有效性提供了实证证据；2. 明确了暴力预防机制主要是通过改善机构协调而非改变社会规范；3. 揭示了社会环境和制度能力的互补作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了暴力预防中心的实证效果；2. 强调了机构协调和降低求助障碍的重要性；3. 建议在性别进步规范和制度能力强的地区优先实施；4. 为其他国家设计类似保护体系提供参考。

title: A Theory of Subsidy Harvesting in Livestock Price Insurance
affiliations: University of Georgia - Department of Agricultural & Applied Economics and University of Georgia

detail.title: A Theory of Subsidy Harvesting in Livestock Price Insurance
detail.abstract:
USDA designed the Livestock Risk Protection (LRP) program to help producers insure against declining prices for fed cattle, feeder cattle, and swine. Prices in derivatives markets determine program indemnities, making LRP policies similar to put options. Beginning in 2019, USDA made several changes to the program to encourage producer takeup, including increased premium subsidies. We introduce a theoretical model to show that subsidizing LRP premiums invites producers to “subsidy harvest,” i.e. extract the subsidy as an arbitrage by simultaneously taking an offsetting position in the options market—potentially removing the downside protection the program was intended to provide. The subsidy harvest is a pure rent and costlier than a direct payment because it requires administrative oversight and federally-subsidized delivery through approved insurance providers. According to the model, the government’s premium subsidy leads producers to favor LRP-oriented strategies over market options alone, while their choice to offset actual risk protection using options depends on individual risk tolerance and wealth objectives.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国农业部设计的牲畜风险保护(LRP)项目通过补贴保费鼓励生产者参保，但研究发现这可能导致生产者进行"补贴收割"套利，即同时在场外期权市场建立对冲头寸来获取补贴收益，从而削弱项目的风险保护效果。
AI.research_question: 美国农业部对牲畜风险保护(LRP)项目的保费补贴政策是否会导致生产者进行"补贴收割"套利行为，从而削弱项目的风险保护效果？
AI.motivation: 美国农业部在2019年对LRP项目进行了多项改革，包括提高保费补贴，以鼓励生产者参与。然而，这种补贴政策可能引发意想不到的行为反应，需要研究其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期权定价理论和风险管理理论，构建理论模型分析补贴政策对生产者决策的影响，特别是"补贴收割"套利行为的形成机制。
AI.method: 引入理论模型进行分析，通过模型推导展示保费补贴如何激励生产者进行套利行为，并分析不同风险偏好和财富目标下的决策差异。
AI.findings: 保费补贴会激励生产者进行"补贴收割"套利，即通过在场外期权市场建立对冲头寸来获取补贴收益，这可能使LRP失去原有的风险保护功能。这种套利是纯粹的租金转移，比直接支付成本更高，因为需要行政监管和联邦补贴的保险提供商参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"补贴收割"概念，揭示了农业保险补贴政策可能引发的套利行为，丰富了农业风险管理政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：保费补贴政策需要谨慎设计，避免引发套利行为而削弱政策效果。建议考虑更直接的风险管理支持方式，减少行政成本和租金转移。

title: Shopping From Home
affiliations: , Stanford University - Department of Economics, Rice University - Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business and Northwestern University

detail.title: Shopping From Home
detail.abstract:
Conducting a new survey on the Nielsen Consumer panel we examine the impact of working from home (WFH) on shopping, finding three key results. First, WFH changed shopping modes, increasing online shopping and the fraction of trips to stores on weekdays. Second, WFH increased total spending through increased product quantity and range, tilting expenditure towards food and general merchandise and away from health and beauty products. Finally, WFH increased prices paid by shoppers and lowered price elasticities due to a move towards higher-cost products and lower deal usage. The change in prices paid is concentrated among married households, driven by a redistribution of shopping responsibility within the household, especially when the new remote worker is male. We find that remote workers engage in more shopping trips but fewer minutes of shopping. Our results suggest that shifting to remote work increases prices paid for groceries by about 1%, highlighting how WFH is impacting households, retail and inflation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Nielsen消费者面板调查发现，远程办公改变了购物模式：增加了网购、工作日实体店购物、总支出和支付价格，降低了价格弹性，且这些变化在已婚家庭中更明显，特别是当远程工作者为男性时。
AI.research_question: 远程办公（WFH）如何影响消费者的购物行为、支出模式和价格支付？
AI.motivation: 随着远程办公的普及，需要了解这种工作模式转变如何影响家庭消费行为、零售业和通胀，这对理解宏观经济影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论、家庭经济学（家庭内购物责任分配）和价格弹性理论，分析远程办公对购物模式的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用Nielsen消费者面板数据进行实证分析，考察远程办公对购物频率、渠道选择、支出结构、价格支付和价格弹性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 远程办公改变了购物模式：增加网购和工作日实体店购物；2. 增加了总支出，支出结构向食品和一般商品倾斜；3. 提高了支付价格并降低了价格弹性，这在已婚家庭中更明显，特别是当远程工作者为男性时。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了远程办公对消费者行为影响的理论框架，揭示了家庭内购物责任重新分配的作用机制，特别是性别角色在其中的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商调整营销策略（如工作日促销）、政策制定者理解通胀压力、家庭管理购物支出提供了实证依据，远程办公可能使食品杂货价格上涨约1%。

title: Drivers of Dollar Share in Foreign Exchange Reserves
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Drivers of Dollar Share in Foreign Exchange Reserves
detail.abstract:
The share of US dollar assets in the official foreign exchange reserve portfolios of central banks, at times, is taken as an indicator of the dollar's global status. We provide a decomposition that shows two distinct channels contributing to the changes in the dollar share of reserves aggregated across countries: shifts in preferences for dollar assets, and changes in reserve balances driven by countries whose portfolio allocations differ from the aggregate. We document how the concentrated nature of foreign exchange reserve holdings allows countries that contribute a large share of aggregated reserves to exert substantial influence on aggregate dollar shares over time, potentially dominating the narrative. In recent periods, the key contributors to changes in aggregate preference shifts for dollar assets are changes in bilateral country trade with the United States and dollar debt share, with geopolitics additionally working through the investment tranches of central bank portfolios. Diversification away from dollar assets is more prevalent conditional on official reserves of countries being large enough to satisfy country liquidity needs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了美元在全球外汇储备中份额变化的驱动因素，发现有两个主要渠道：各国对美元资产的偏好变化，以及储备规模不同的国家在总体储备中的权重变化。研究表明，少数持有大量外汇储备的国家对总体美元份额有显著影响，而近期影响美元偏好的关键因素包括与美国的双边贸易、美元债务份额以及地缘政治因素。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动了美元在全球外汇储备中份额的变化？这些变化如何受到各国储备规模差异和偏好变化的影响？
AI.motivation: 美元在全球外汇储备中的份额常被用作衡量美元全球地位的指标，但现有研究往往忽略了各国储备规模差异对总体份额的影响。需要更精确地分解美元份额变化的驱动因素，以理解美元国际地位的真正变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外汇储备组合理论、国际货币地位理论、资产组合选择理论、地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 采用分解分析方法，将美元储备份额变化分解为两个渠道：各国对美元资产的偏好变化，以及储备规模不同的国家在总体储备中的权重变化。使用多国数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 外汇储备持有高度集中，少数持有大量储备的国家对总体美元份额有不成比例的影响；2. 近期影响美元偏好的关键因素包括：与美国的双边贸易变化、美元债务份额、地缘政治因素（通过央行投资组合的投资部分发挥作用）；3. 只有当官方储备足够满足流动性需求时，各国才会更多地从美元资产中分散投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了新的分解框架，区分了偏好变化和储备规模变化对总体美元份额的影响；2. 揭示了外汇储备集中度如何扭曲对美元国际地位的解读；3. 识别了影响美元偏好的具体经济和政治因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的美元地位评估工具；2. 帮助央行管理者理解储备组合决策的影响因素；3. 为国际金融市场的参与者提供了分析美元趋势的新视角。

title: The Promise of Microbial Fertilizer for Affordable and Sustainable Food Production in Africa
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management,  and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: The Promise of Microbial Fertilizer for Affordable and Sustainable Food Production in Africa
detail.abstract:
Food insecurity is an existential threat for Africa (a continent facing rapid population growth and dire climate impacts) and addressing it a global imperative. Over 30% of caloric intake comes from maize, but crop yields are low partly because high costs make synthetic fertilizers uneconomical. A field experiment with Kenyan smallholder farmers explores the promise of genetically modified (microbial) biofertilizers to deliver nitrogen and increase yields at affordable costs. We see significant increases in yields (up to 110% for some farmers) and lower environmental impact than synthetic products. This suggests that biofertilizers could dramatically improve food security and child nutrition in Africa.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过肯尼亚小农户的田间实验，探索基因改良微生物生物肥料在提高玉米产量方面的潜力，结果显示产量显著提升（最高达110%），且比合成肥料更环保、成本更低，有望改善非洲粮食安全和儿童营养。
AI.research_question: 基因改良微生物生物肥料能否以可负担的成本为肯尼亚小农户提供氮肥并提高玉米产量，从而改善非洲的粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 非洲面临快速人口增长和严峻气候影响的生存威胁，粮食安全是当务之急。玉米占非洲热量摄入的30%以上，但产量低，部分原因是合成肥料成本过高，小农户难以负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业经济学、环境可持续性和发展经济学理论，探讨生物肥料作为合成肥料替代方案的经济和环境效益。
AI.method: 在肯尼亚小农户中进行田间实验，比较基因改良微生物生物肥料与传统合成肥料对玉米产量的影响。
AI.findings: 生物肥料显著提高了玉米产量（部分农户增产高达110%），且比合成肥料的环境影响更低，成本更可负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业技术创新在解决发展中国家粮食安全中的作用提供了实证证据，丰富了可持续农业和资源约束下农业生产力的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲小农户提供了一种经济可行的肥料替代方案，有助于提高粮食产量、改善儿童营养，并为政策制定者推广可持续农业技术提供了实践指导。

title: Demographics and Technology Diffusion: Evidence from Mobile Payments
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management, Indian Institute of Management (IIMB), Bangalore, Dartmouth College and Kellogg School of Management - Department of Finance

detail.title: Demographics and Technology Diffusion: Evidence from Mobile Payments
detail.abstract:
We show that the age composition of the population can shape the speed at which businesses adopt new technologies, using evidence from mobile payments in India. Consumers' propensity to use new payment technologies declines with age, creating stronger incentives for businesses serving younger customers to accept these technologies. We document this pattern in the rollout of a mobile payment option by a major fintech company. A model where consumer attitudes toward technology vary by age implies that business adoption is inefficiently low, with the young bearing disproportionate welfare losses from network externalities. Jointly subsidizing transaction and adoption costs restores efficiency.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究显示人口年龄结构影响企业采用新技术的速度，以印度移动支付为例。消费者使用新支付技术的倾向随年龄增长而下降，这促使服务年轻客户的企业更有动力接受新技术。研究发现企业采用率过低，年轻人因网络外部性承受不成比例的福利损失，而联合补贴交易和采用成本可恢复效率。
AI.research_question: 人口年龄结构如何影响企业采用新技术的速度？以印度移动支付为例，年龄相关的消费者技术态度如何影响企业采纳决策和福利分配？
AI.motivation: 理解新技术扩散的驱动因素，特别是人口结构特征如何通过消费者偏好影响企业采纳决策，以及由此产生的福利分配和效率问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络外部性理论、技术采纳理论、人口经济学、消费者行为理论（年龄相关的技术态度差异）
AI.method: 实证分析：利用印度一家主要金融科技公司移动支付选项推出的数据，结合理论模型分析。模型假设消费者对技术的态度随年龄变化。
AI.findings: 1. 消费者使用新支付技术的倾向随年龄增长而下降；2. 服务年轻客户的企业更有动力接受新技术；3. 企业采纳率低于社会最优水平；4. 年轻人因网络外部性承受不成比例的福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将人口年龄结构纳入技术扩散分析框架；2. 揭示年龄相关的消费者技术态度如何通过企业决策影响技术采纳；3. 识别网络外部性下的福利分配不均问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供干预依据：联合补贴交易和采用成本可提高效率；2. 帮助企业理解客户年龄结构对技术采纳决策的影响；3. 为金融科技公司市场扩张策略提供参考。

title: Firm's Accounting Choice and Performance Sensitive Debt Covenants
affiliations: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz - Gutenberg School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Firm's Accounting Choice and Performance Sensitive Debt Covenants
detail.abstract: Performance covenants in debt contracts are contracting features that lead to changes in the interest rate over the life of the debt contract. I use a theoretical model to show that performance sensitive debt covenants can be valuable, given the information asymmetry between the firm and the lender. They can be used as a mechanism for firms with better loan repayment prospects to signal their type to the lender. Additionally, accounting conservatism in debt contracting is often perceived as beneficial. Conservatism in performance sensitive debt contracts influences the termination decision as well as the interest rate. Even though accounting conservatism can lower the interest rate, it is detrimental to the firm value when the firm's ex ante NPV is not too small. Finally, I show that accounting conservatism discourages good firms from separating via performance sensitive debt contract and facilitates information asymmetry on the debt market.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了绩效敏感债务契约在信息不对称环境下的信号价值，以及会计稳健性如何影响这些契约的有效性和企业价值。
AI.research_question: 绩效敏感债务契约如何在信息不对称环境下作为信号机制？会计稳健性如何影响绩效敏感债务契约的有效性和企业价值？
AI.motivation: 债务合同中的绩效条款会导致利率变化，但现有研究对绩效敏感债务契约在信息不对称环境下的作用机制，以及会计稳健性如何影响这些契约的有效性缺乏深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信号理论、债务契约理论、会计稳健性理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析
AI.findings: 1. 绩效敏感债务契约可作为还款前景良好的企业向贷款人传递类型信号的机制；2. 会计稳健性会影响债务合同的终止决策和利率；3. 会计稳健性虽然能降低利率，但当企业事前净现值不太小时会损害企业价值；4. 会计稳健性阻碍优质企业通过绩效敏感债务契约实现分离，加剧债务市场信息不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了绩效敏感债务契约在信息不对称环境下的信号作用机制；2. 阐明了会计稳健性对债务契约设计的复杂影响；3. 提出了会计稳健性可能加剧而非缓解债务市场信息不对称的新观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业设计债务契约提供了理论指导；2. 帮助贷款人理解不同契约条款的信息含义；3. 提醒政策制定者注意会计稳健性在债务市场可能产生的意外后果。

title: Energy Mix, Diversification and Electricity Price Stability in the European Union
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics, Centre for Security Studies and Cracow Univeristy of Economics

detail.title: Energy Mix, Diversification and Electricity Price Stability in the European Union
detail.abstract: EUA allowance prices carry the largest and most precisely estimated pass-through coefficient among all structural variables examined in this study. This result is stable across all specifications and is the central empirical contribution of this paper. Using an unbalanced panel of 27 EU member states over 2015-2024, we estimate panel fixed-effects models with standard errors clustered by country to identify the drivers of wholesale price levels and within-year price volatility. A one-percent increase in EUA allowance prices raises wholesale prices by 0.19-0.39 percent depending on specification and increases within-year volatility by 3-25 EUR/MWh. The 2021-2022 energy crisis independently added approximately 50 percent to wholesale prices net of carbon and storage effects (exp(0.409) - 1 = 0.505). EU gas storage fill rates are large and precisely estimated stabilisers: a 10-percentage-point increase in fill rate is associated with approximately 25 percent lower wholesale prices. The merit-order effect of renewable energy share is not robustly identified in annual panel data; after controlling for low-carbon dispatchable capacity (nuclear and hydro), higher intermittent RES share is associated with higher prices and volatility, consistent with integration-cost arguments. Portfolio concentration (HHI) is a significant negative predictor of wholesale prices in two-way fixed-effects specifications. The direct share of dispatchable zero-marginal-cost capacity is a more reliable predictor of lower prices than aggregate renewable share. Robustness checks include dynamic FE with lagged dependent variable, alternative log-volatility measure, Pesaran (2004) cross-sectional dependence test (CD = 45.7), and country-level gas storage sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2015-2024年欧盟27国面板数据，发现EUA碳配额价格对批发电价有最显著影响，能源危机使电价上涨约50%，而天然气储存填充率是重要稳定因素。间歇性可再生能源份额与更高电价和波动性相关，而非传统认为的降价效应。
AI.research_question: 欧盟电力批发价格水平和年内价格波动的主要驱动因素是什么？特别是碳配额价格、能源危机、天然气储存、可再生能源份额等因素如何影响电价？
AI.motivation: 理解欧盟电力市场批发价格的决定因素对于能源政策制定、市场设计和能源转型至关重要。随着碳定价机制的实施、可再生能源渗透率提高以及2021-2022年能源危机的发生，需要实证分析这些因素对电价的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电力市场经济学理论，包括碳成本传导机制、能源危机冲击理论、天然气储存的稳定作用、可再生能源的整合成本理论（与传统边际成本排序效应相对），以及市场集中度（HHI）对价格的影响。
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年欧盟27国不平衡面板数据，采用面板固定效应模型，标准误按国家聚类。进行稳健性检验包括动态固定效应模型（含滞后因变量）、替代波动性度量、Pesaran横截面依赖性检验和国家层面天然气储存敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1) EUA碳配额价格每上涨1%，批发电价上涨0.19-0.39%；2) 2021-2022能源危机使电价净增约50%；3) 天然气储存填充率每增加10个百分点，电价降低约25%；4) 间歇性可再生能源份额与更高电价和波动性相关；5) 市场集中度（HHI）与电价负相关；6) 零边际成本可调度容量比总可再生能源份额更能可靠预测低价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了EUA碳配额价格传导机制的实证证据；2) 挑战了可再生能源份额必然降低电价的传统边际成本排序效应，支持整合成本理论；3) 识别了天然气储存作为价格稳定器的重要作用；4) 区分了不同类型可再生能源（间歇性vs可调度）对电价的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为碳定价政策设计提供依据；2) 强调天然气储存基础设施对价格稳定的重要性；3) 建议政策应关注可调度零边际成本容量而非单纯可再生能源目标；4) 为能源危机应对提供量化参考；5) 为电力市场设计和监管提供实证支持。

title: Optimal Simple Ratings
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics and Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business

detail.title: Optimal Simple Ratings
detail.abstract:
We study optimal simple rating systems that partition sellers into a finite number of tiers. We show that optimal ratings must be threshold partitions, and that for linear supply and Cournot competition with constant marginal cost, optimal thresholds solve a k-means clustering problem requiring only the quality distribution. For convex (concave) supply functions, optimal thresholds are higher (lower) than the k-means solution. For log-concave distributions, two-tier certification captures at least 50 percent of maximum welfare gains from full disclosure, with five tiers typically achieving over 90 percent. Applications to eBay and Medicare Advantage data illustrate our method.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究最优简单评级系统，将卖家划分为有限层级。研究发现最优评级必须是阈值划分，对于线性供给和古诺竞争，最优阈值可通过k-means聚类求解；对于凸（凹）供给函数，最优阈值高于（低于）k-means解。对数凹分布下，两层认证可达到完全信息披露福利收益的50%以上，五层通常可达90%以上。
AI.research_question: 如何设计最优的简单评级系统，将卖家划分为有限层级以最大化社会福利？
AI.motivation: 现实中的评级系统（如eBay卖家评级、医疗保险计划评级）通常采用简单的层级划分，但如何设计最优的划分阈值以最大化社会福利缺乏理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和机制设计理论，结合市场结构（线性供给、古诺竞争）、供给函数特性（凸/凹）和质量分布特征（对数凹分布）。
AI.method: 理论建模分析最优评级系统的设计问题，推导数学条件，应用k-means聚类方法求解阈值，并用eBay和Medicare Advantage数据进行实证应用。
AI.findings: 1. 最优评级必须是阈值划分；2. 线性供给和古诺竞争下，最优阈值可通过k-means聚类求解；3. 凸（凹）供给函数下，最优阈值高于（低于）k-means解；4. 对数凹分布下，两层认证可达50%以上福利收益，五层可达90%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了最优简单评级系统的理论框架；2. 揭示了最优评级与k-means聚类问题的联系；3. 分析了供给函数特性对最优阈值的影响；4. 提供了层级数量与福利收益的量化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为eBay等平台设计卖家评级系统提供理论指导；2. 为Medicare Advantage等医疗保险计划评级提供优化方法；3. 提供了可操作的计算方法，仅需质量分布信息即可求解最优阈值。

title: Public Defender Workloads and the Promise of Gideon
affiliations: University of Nevada, Las Vegas, William S. Boyd School of Law

detail.title: Public Defender Workloads and the Promise of Gideon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as the Monitor for a consent judgment between the the class of indigent defendants in Nevada's rural counties and the State of Nevada.

detail.abstract:
Decided in 1963, Gideon v. Wainwright established that the Sixth Amendment guarantees the right to counsel for defendants in state criminal prosecutions who cannot afford to hire an attorney. Six decades later,  states struggle to fulfill Gideon’s promise amid growing caseloads, limited resources, and evolving standards of professional practice. At the same time, the Supreme Court’s jurisprudence has made clear that the constitutional right to counsel entails not merely representation, but the effective assistance of counsel, assessed by reference to prevailing professional norms such as the ABA Criminal Justice Standards for the Defense Function. Excessive defender workloads implicate both ethical and constitutional concerns, forcing attorneys to triage cases in ways that undermine essential lawyering tasks,

This article traces the evolution of public defender workload reform as a mechanism for ensuring effective assistance of counsel. Current debates about workload too often take as a starting point outdated caseload limits derived from a 1973 National Advisory Commission (NAC) report. Long criticized, the NAC report's caseload limits fail to account for the current reality of criminal defense work, which involves time-consuming review of digital discovery, mastery of complex forensic evidence, and the obligation to understand and protect clients from the collateral consequences of conviction. 

Against this backdrop, this article examines the 2023 publication of the National Public Defender Workload Study (NPDWS) by the RAND Corporation--the first national effort in fifty years to reassess defender workloads. Using a robust application of the Delphi method, the NPDWS convened a panel of experienced public defenders to reach consensus on the time required to provide reasonably effective representation across a range of case types and lawyering tasks. The resulting time estimates far exceed historical benchmarks. Put simply, to provide effective assistance of counsel, public defenders need fewer cases. While current public defender caseloads far exceed its recommendations, the NPDWS study provides an important starting point for understanding the work that criminal defense attorneys actually do, how long it takes, and what resources are necessary to ensure equal justice for the accused.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了公设辩护人工作量改革作为确保有效辩护权机制的演变，分析了过时的1973年NAC案件数量限制的缺陷，并重点研究了2023年RAND公司发布的NPDWS研究，该研究通过德尔菲法确定了提供有效辩护所需的时间，发现远超过历史基准，表明公设辩护人需要减少案件量才能提供有效辩护。
AI.research_question: 公设辩护人工作量改革如何作为确保有效辩护权的机制？当前过时的案件数量限制存在哪些问题？2023年NPDWS研究提供了哪些关于有效辩护所需时间和资源的新见解？
AI.motivation: 1963年吉迪恩诉温赖特案确立了贫困被告获得律师辩护的权利，但六十年后各州仍难以履行这一承诺。过度的辩护人工作量既涉及伦理问题也涉及宪法问题，迫使律师在案件间进行权衡，损害了基本的法律工作质量。当前辩论仍基于1973年NAC报告中过时的案件数量限制，这些限制未能反映现代刑事辩护工作的现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第六修正案保障的律师辩护权及有效辩护权理论；美国律师协会刑事司法辩护职能标准等专业规范；宪法权利与专业实践标准的交叉理论；工作量与有效辩护之间的关联理论。
AI.method: 文献分析：追溯公设辩护人工作量改革的演变；批判性分析：评估1973年NAC报告案件数量限制的缺陷；案例研究：分析2023年RAND公司发布的NPDWS研究，该研究采用德尔菲法召集经验丰富的公设辩护人小组，就各类案件类型和法律任务所需时间达成共识。
AI.findings: NPDWS研究通过德尔菲法得出的时间估计远超过历史基准；现代刑事辩护工作涉及耗时的数字证据审查、复杂法医证据掌握以及保护客户免受定罪附带后果的义务；当前公设辩护人案件量远超NPDWS建议；提供有效辩护需要减少案件量；NPDWS为理解刑事辩护律师实际工作、所需时间及确保平等司法所需资源提供了重要起点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将工作量改革理论化为确保有效辩护权的关键机制；挑战了基于过时标准的传统案件数量限制理论；建立了现代刑事辩护实践与宪法有效辩护权要求之间的理论联系；为基于实证的工作量标准制定提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公设辩护机构提供了基于实证的工作量标准；为政策制定者改革公设辩护人系统提供了具体建议；为法院评估有效辩护权主张提供了参考框架；为资源分配决策提供了数据支持；为刑事司法系统实现平等司法目标提供了实践路径。

title: From Shadow to Light The Case for Wholesale Dual-Track Reform in Electricity Markets
affiliations: University of Burgundy Franche-Comté - L.I.B.R.E., affiliation not provided to SSRN and SITE-Stockholm School of Economics

detail.title: From Shadow to Light The Case for Wholesale Dual-Track Reform in Electricity Markets
detail.abstract: In many developing countries, regulated electricity tariffs are set below cost, leaving public utilities with chronic losses and restricted subsidies. As a result, supply at the regulated price is limited and rationed consumers turn to informal suppliers at high markups. We analyze a wholesale dual-track reform in which the utility sells electricity to informal suppliers at a market-based wholesale price, who then resell it alongside their own generation. Unlike the classic dual-track framework, which introduces a second track downstream, the second track here operates upstream. We show that the reform raises total production and increases consumer welfare. The key channel operates through the utility’s budget constraint: the wholesale price-cost margin generates revenues that relax the budget constraint, enabling expanded provision at the regulated retail price. Whether informal suppliers lose depends on the wholesale price. We characterize the set of wholesale prices for which the reform is Pareto improving. The reform requires neither tariff increases nor new infrastructure, relying instead on institutional design that redirects rents from informal provision toward expanded public supply.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了发展中国家电力市场的双轨制批发改革，其中公共电力公司以市场批发价向非正式供应商售电，这些供应商再转售电力。改革通过放松电力公司的预算约束，增加总产量和消费者福利，无需提高电价或新建基础设施。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家电力市场，当公共电力公司以低于成本的管制电价运营时，引入上游批发双轨制改革（允许电力公司以市场价向非正式供应商批发电力）如何影响总产量、消费者福利和各利益相关方？
AI.motivation: 许多发展中国家的管制电价低于成本，导致公共电力公司持续亏损，补贴受限。供应受限使得消费者转向高价非正式供应商。需要找到不提高管制电价、不新建基础设施的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双轨制改革理论，但创新性地将第二轨道置于上游（批发层面）而非下游（零售层面）。分析框架考虑电力公司的预算约束、非正式供应商的市场力量以及消费者福利。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，考察电力公司、非正式供应商和消费者的行为。分析改革前后均衡，比较总产量、消费者福利和各利益相关方收益。
AI.findings: 1. 改革增加总电力产量；2. 提高消费者福利；3. 关键机制：批发价-成本差额产生的收入放松电力公司预算约束，使其能扩大管制零售价供应；4. 非正式供应商是否受损取决于批发价格；5. 存在使改革帕累托改进的批发价格区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将经典双轨制框架从下游扩展到上游批发层面；2. 阐明预算约束放松在改革中的核心作用；3. 识别帕累托改进的批发价格条件；4. 为制度设计提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供不提高电价、不新建基础设施的改革方案；2. 通过制度设计将非正式供应的租金重新导向扩大公共供应；3. 为政策制定者提供可操作的批发价格设定指导；4. 实现多方共赢的改革路径。

title: Vision–Language Foundation Models and Multimodal Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges

detail.title: Vision–Language Foundation Models and Multimodal Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
detail.abstract: Vision-based multimodal learning has experienced rapid advancement through the integration of large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). In this review, we adopt a historical and task-oriented perspective to systematically examine the evolution of multimodal vision models from early visual-semantic embedding frameworks to modern instruction-tuned MLLMs. We categorize model developments across major architectural paradigms, including dual-encoder contrastive frameworks, transformer-based fusion architectures, and unified generative models. Further, we analyze their practical implementations across key vision-centric tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering (VQA), visual grounding, and cross-modal generation. Comparative insights are drawn between traditional multimodal fusion strategies and the emerging trend of large-scale multimodal pretraining. We also provide a detailed overview of benchmark datasets, evaluating their representativeness, scalability, and limitations in real-world multimodal scenarios. Building upon this analysis, we identify open challenges in the field, including fine-grained cross-modal alignment, computational efficiency, generalization across modalities, and multimodal reasoning under limited supervision. Finally, we discuss potential research directions such as self-supervised multimodal pretraining, dynamic fusion via adaptive attention mechanisms, and the integration of multimodal reasoning with ethical and human-centered AI principles. Through this comprehensive synthesis of past and present multimodal vision research, we aim to establish a unified reference framework for advancing future developments in visual-language understanding and cross-modal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于视觉多模态学习发展的综述论文，系统回顾了从早期视觉语义嵌入框架到现代指令调优多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的演进历程，分析了主要架构范式、关键任务应用、基准数据集以及当前面临的挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 视觉多模态学习如何从早期视觉语义嵌入框架演进到现代多模态大语言模型？不同架构范式在关键视觉任务上的表现如何？当前领域面临哪些挑战以及未来发展方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着大规模视觉语言模型（VLMs）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，视觉多模态学习领域取得了显著进展。然而，缺乏对演进历程、架构范式、任务应用和挑战的系统性梳理，需要建立一个统一的参考框架来指导未来研究。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 双编码器对比学习框架（Dual-encoder contrastive frameworks）
2. 基于Transformer的融合架构（Transformer-based fusion architectures）
3. 统一生成模型（Unified generative models）
4. 大规模多模态预训练理论
5. 视觉语言理解与跨模态智能理论
AI.method: 采用历史和任务导向的视角进行系统性文献综述，通过分类分析、比较研究和综合评估的方法，考察模型演进、架构范式、任务应用、数据集评估和挑战识别。
AI.findings:
1. 视觉多模态模型经历了从早期视觉语义嵌入到现代指令调优MLLMs的演进
2. 主要架构范式包括双编码器对比框架、Transformer融合架构和统一生成模型
3. 在图像描述、视觉问答、视觉定位和跨模态生成等关键任务上取得显著进展
4. 传统多模态融合策略与大规模多模态预训练存在显著差异
5. 基准数据集在代表性、可扩展性和现实场景适用性方面存在局限性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了视觉多模态学习演进的历史框架
2. 系统分类了主要架构范式及其理论基础
3. 提出了多模态模型评估的统一参考框架
4. 识别了跨模态对齐、计算效率、泛化能力和推理能力等理论挑战
5. 为未来多模态智能研究提供了理论指导方向
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为研究人员提供了视觉多模态学习的全面技术路线图
2. 指导实际应用中模型选择和任务适配
3. 帮助识别数据集选择和评估的最佳实践
4. 为工业界开发多模态应用提供参考框架
5. 促进跨模态智能系统的实际部署和优化

title: Sanctions and Domestic Tourism in Russia: Short-Term benefits and Long-Term Risks for the Tourism Industry
affiliations: The Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration, North-West Institute of Management

detail.title: Sanctions and Domestic Tourism in Russia: Short-Term benefits and Long-Term Risks for the Tourism Industry
detail.abstract: The article examines the impact of the 2022 sanctions on Russia's tourism industry, with an emphasis on the development of domestic tourism. The author notes that in 2023-2024, in the short term, restrictions on outbound tourism led to a surge in domestic tourist flows, and the number of tourist trips within Russia reached record levels, as did revenue growth in the industry. Russians who faced the inability to travel abroad redirected demand toward domestic destinations, which supported tourism businesses within the country. At the same time, long-term risks and negative consequences were identified: a reduction in inbound tourism, disruptions in transport accessibility for certain regions, and a decline in industry productivity due to sanctions-related constraints. For the sustainable development of the tourism industry under sanctions, adaptation to new conditions, government support, and the introduction of innovations are required. The study is based on an analysis of academic publications from 2023-2025, as well as current statistical data from Rosstat and relevant sectoral reports.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2022年制裁对俄罗斯旅游业的影响，重点关注国内旅游发展。研究发现短期内出境限制推动了国内旅游繁荣，但长期面临入境旅游减少、交通可达性下降和行业生产力下滑等风险。研究建议通过政府支持、创新和适应新条件来实现可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 2022年制裁对俄罗斯旅游业产生了什么影响？特别是对国内旅游发展的影响如何？制裁带来的短期机遇和长期风险分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究制裁对特定国家旅游业的冲击具有重要现实意义。俄罗斯旅游业在2022年制裁后面临重大转型，需要理解制裁如何重塑旅游市场格局，特别是国内旅游如何成为替代选择，以及行业面临的长期挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于旅游需求替代理论、制裁经济学和旅游危机管理理论。研究探讨了外部冲击下旅游需求从国际向国内的转移机制，以及制裁环境下旅游业的适应策略。
AI.method: 采用文献分析法和数据分析法。分析2023-2025年的学术出版物，结合俄罗斯联邦国家统计局（Rosstat）的当前统计数据及相关行业报告进行综合研究。
AI.findings:
1. 短期内（2023-2024年）：出境旅游限制导致国内旅游需求激增，俄罗斯境内旅游出行达到创纪录水平，行业收入增长显著
2. 俄罗斯游客将无法出国旅游的需求转向国内目的地，支持了国内旅游企业
3. 长期风险：入境旅游减少、部分地区交通可达性中断、制裁相关限制导致行业生产力下降
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 丰富了制裁环境下旅游业转型的理论框架
2. 提出了旅游需求替代在外部冲击下的作用机制
3. 扩展了危机管理理论在制裁背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为俄罗斯旅游业在制裁条件下的可持续发展提供政策建议
2. 强调政府支持、创新引入和适应新条件的重要性
3. 为其他面临类似制裁的国家提供旅游业应对策略参考

title: Self-employed Women and the Motherhood Penalty

detail.title: Self-employed Women and the Motherhood Penalty
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of childbirth on the careers of skilled, self-employed women. Using panel data from the Ladies Professional Golf Association Tour, I find that childbirth is followed by sharp declines in tournament earnings, participation, and objective performance measures that persist in the long run. I use an event-study difference-in-differences design around first birth to test whether the scheduling and work-intensity flexibility inherent in self-employment attenuates the motherhood penalty documented for wage and salary workers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用职业高尔夫巡回赛数据发现，自雇女性的生育会导致收入、参与度和表现长期显著下降，自雇的灵活性并未减轻生育对职业的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 自雇女性的生育是否会对她们的职业生涯产生负面影响？自雇工作固有的灵活性能否减轻这种"母亲惩罚"？
AI.motivation: 先前研究主要关注工资雇员中的"母亲惩罚"现象，但缺乏对自雇女性生育影响的研究。自雇工作具有时间安排和工作强度上的灵活性，理论上可能减轻生育对职业的负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 母亲惩罚理论、自雇工作灵活性理论、职业中断理论
AI.method: 使用LPGA巡回赛的面板数据，采用事件研究双重差分法，围绕首次生育事件进行分析，比较生育前后的比赛收入、参与度和客观表现指标变化。
AI.findings: 生育后，自雇女性的比赛收入、参与度和客观表现指标均出现急剧下降，且这种负面影响长期持续存在。自雇的灵活性并未减轻生育对职业的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"母亲惩罚"理论到自雇领域，挑战了自雇灵活性能够减轻生育负面影响的假设，为职业中断理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自雇女性提供生育规划参考，为政策制定者设计支持自雇母亲的政策提供依据，帮助组织理解女性运动员生育后的职业挑战。

title: The Impact of Non-Competes on Wages and Job Tenure: New Evidence from NLSY Data
affiliations: Drexel University, Drexel University and Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: The Impact of Non-Competes on Wages and Job Tenure: New Evidence from NLSY Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Financial support for this research came entirely from the authors' employers, Drexel University (Kurmann and Potter) and the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (Hobijn). Hobijn is also a co-PI on NSF grant SES-2048713.

detail.abstract: Non-compete agreements (NCAs) are pervasive even in low-wage labor markets, yet most evidence relies on variation in enforceability rather than NCA incidence. Using longitudinal data from the NLSY97, we study how signing an NCA affects wage trajectories and job tenure. Exploiting complete work histories and applying a clean-controls local projections difference-in-difference design, we find a striking divergence: NCAs are associated with significantly slower wage growth for low-education workers over four years, but faster wage growth for high-education workers. Effects on job tenure are imprecisely estimated for both groups.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：竞业禁止协议对低学历和高学历工人的工资增长轨迹产生相反影响。低学历工人签署竞业协议后四年内工资增长显著放缓，而高学历工人工资增长反而加快。对工作任期的影响不明确。
AI.research_question: 签署竞业禁止协议如何影响工人的工资增长轨迹和工作任期？这种影响是否因教育水平而异？
AI.motivation: 竞业禁止协议在低工资劳动力市场普遍存在，但现有研究主要关注协议的可执行性差异，而非实际签署情况的影响。需要了解竞业协议对工人职业发展的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞业禁止协议理论、人力资本理论、劳动力市场分割理论、工资增长动态理论
AI.method: 使用NLSY97纵向数据，利用完整工作历史，采用干净对照组局部投影双重差分设计
AI.findings: 发现显著分歧：竞业协议与低学历工人四年内显著较慢的工资增长相关，但与高学历工人较快的工资增长相关。对工作任期的影响估计不精确。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究竞业协议签署对工资轨迹的异质性影响；2. 揭示竞业协议对不同教育水平工人的相反作用机制；3. 补充了竞业协议可执行性研究之外的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为低学历工人提供竞业协议签署的警示；2. 为企业制定差异化竞业政策提供依据；3. 为政策制定者监管竞业协议提供实证支持；4. 帮助工人做出更明智的职业决策

title: The AI Frenemy: Investor Reliance and Welfare
affiliations: Hunan University and Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics

detail.title: The AI Frenemy: Investor Reliance and Welfare
detail.abstract: We develop a noisy rational expectations model to study how generative AI affects investors' information choices and welfare. Investors endogenously choose between self-directed research, in which signal precision is determined by research skill, and AI reliance, which provides information contaminated by correlated misinformation (hallucinations). AI adoption rises with AI signal precision and is higher among low-skill investors. The welfare effect of improving AI precision is non-monotonic: better information reduces fundamental uncertainty but also increases price informativeness and weakens speculative opportunities. Finally, equilibrium AI adoption is generally socially inefficient because correlated AI misinformation generates informational externalities that investors do not internalize, leading to under-reliance relative to the social optimum.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个有噪声的理性预期模型，分析生成式AI如何影响投资者的信息选择与福利。投资者内生选择自主研究（精度取决于研究技能）或依赖AI（信息受相关错误信息污染）。AI采用率随AI信号精度提高而上升，低技能投资者更依赖AI。提高AI精度的福利效应是非单调的：更好信息减少基础不确定性，但也增加价格信息性并削弱投机机会。均衡AI采用通常社会低效，因为相关AI错误信息产生投资者未内部化的信息外部性，导致相对于社会最优的AI依赖不足。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响投资者的信息选择决策和福利？均衡AI采用是否社会有效？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在金融信息处理中日益普及，但其信息可能包含相关错误信息（幻觉），这会影响投资者的信息获取策略和市场效率，需要系统分析其福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有噪声的理性预期模型，投资者内生选择信息获取方式：自主研究（精度取决于个人技能）或依赖AI（信号受相关错误信息污染）。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含异质技能投资者的理性预期均衡模型，分析AI精度、投资者技能分布等参数对信息选择、价格形成和福利的影响。
AI.findings: 1. AI采用率随AI信号精度提高而增加，低技能投资者更依赖AI；2. 提高AI精度的福利效应非单调：减少基础不确定性但增加价格信息性并削弱投机机会；3. 均衡AI采用通常社会低效，相关AI错误信息产生负外部性，导致AI依赖不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将生成式AI的信息特征（相关错误信息）纳入理性预期框架；2. 揭示了AI精度改善的非单调福利效应；3. 识别了AI采用中的信息外部性及其对市场效率的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构设计AI信息质量标准和披露要求提供理论依据；2. 帮助投资者理解AI依赖的权衡；3. 为金融科技公司优化AI系统设计提供指导。

title: Local Credit Market Restructuring and Social Spillovers: Evidence from Workplace Safety
affiliations: University of Washington, Bothell, University College Dublin (UCD), California State University Long Beach, Department of Finance, Kennesaw State University and California State University, Long Beach

detail.title: Local Credit Market Restructuring and Social Spillovers: Evidence from Workplace Safety
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine how mergers and acquisitions (M&As) among large banks—and the resulting structural changes in local credit market conditions—generate social spillovers beyond their economic effects, focusing on worker protection and human well-being in local businesses as reflected in workplace safety outcomes. We find that in counties experiencing post-bank-M&A credit market restructuring, zip-code-level average workplace safety at business establishments tends to deteriorate, as evidenced by increased occupational injury and illness rates relative to nearby counties unaffected by such M&As. This decline is primarily driven by improved local credit availability from small banks following large bank M&As, combined with intensified competition among small businesses, which facilitates the entry of firms relying more heavily on low-skilled labor, and shifts managerial focus toward short-term performance at the expense of workplace safety. However, this deterioration is significantly mitigated in counties with higher levels of social capital, in industries more sensitive to environmental, social, and governance issues, and in more politically liberal states, suggesting that local norms and stakeholder-oriented institutions help protect workers even amid substantial restructuring of local credit markets and changes in local competitive environments.

AI.tldr: 大型银行并购通过改变地方信贷市场结构，对小企业信贷可得性产生影响，进而导致工作场所安全状况恶化，但社会资本、ESG敏感行业和政治自由主义环境能够缓解这种负面影响。
AI.research_question: 大型银行并购如何通过改变地方信贷市场结构，对当地企业的工作场所安全产生社会溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注银行并购的经济效应，但缺乏对其社会溢出效应的探讨，特别是对工人保护和人类福祉的影响。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究银行并购如何通过信贷市场结构变化影响工作场所安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合金融经济学（信贷市场结构变化）、组织理论（企业战略选择）和社会学（社会资本、制度环境）的多学科理论框架，分析银行并购对工作场所安全的传导机制。
AI.method: 采用准自然实验设计，比较经历大型银行并购的县和未受影响的邻近县，使用邮政编码层面的工作场所安全数据（职业伤害和疾病率）进行差异分析。
AI.findings:
1. 经历银行并购后信贷市场重组的县，工作场所安全状况恶化（职业伤害和疾病率上升）
2. 主要机制：大型银行并购后小银行信贷可得性改善，加剧小企业竞争，导致更多依赖低技能劳动力的企业进入，管理层更关注短期绩效而忽视工作场所安全
3. 缓解因素：社会资本水平较高的县、ESG敏感行业、政治自由主义倾向较强的州能够显著减轻这种负面影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将银行并购的研究从经济效应扩展到社会溢出效应
2. 揭示了信贷市场结构变化通过企业竞争和战略选择影响工作场所安全的传导机制
3. 强调了社会资本和制度环境在调节金融冲击社会影响中的重要作用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供证据，需要在银行并购审批中考虑社会影响
2. 建议通过加强社会资本建设和ESG监管来保护工人权益
3. 为企业管理者提供警示，避免在信贷环境变化时过度追求短期绩效而忽视工作场所安全

title: When Rules Talk to Code: Why Financial Regulation Should Speak to Machines, and Humans
affiliations: Central Bank of Bahrain

detail.title: When Rules Talk to Code: Why Financial Regulation Should Speak to Machines, and Humans
detail.abstract:
Modern financial regulation confronts a fundamental paradox: while financial markets operate through algorithmic systems executing millions of transactions per second, the rules governing these markets remain written primarily in natural language for human readers. 
This article argues that regulators should adopt machine-readable and machine-executable regulations as the primary mode of rule promulgation. Drawing on examples from algorithmic trading, anti-money laundering monitoring, and automated regulatory reporting, I demonstrate how executable regulation can reduce interpretive ambiguity, enable real-time compliance, lower implementation costs, and enhance supervisory capacity. 
The paper proposes a layered regulatory architecture combining canonical legal text with formal computable representations and standardized validation schemas. While acknowledging risks of over-formalization, embedded bias, and reduced flexibility, the paper argues that continuing to write exclusively for human readers effectively delegates lawmaking authority to private coders within regulated institutions. Reclaiming public control over how rules are operationalized requires regulators to publish their own authoritative machine-executable implementations. The process will ensure smooth percolation of regulatory guidance into financial system compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文主张金融监管应采用机器可读、机器可执行的法规作为主要规则制定模式，以解决算法金融市场与自然语言法规之间的根本矛盾。
AI.research_question: 金融监管机构应如何采用机器可读和机器可执行的法规作为主要规则制定模式，以应对算法金融市场与自然语言法规之间的根本矛盾？
AI.motivation: 现代金融监管面临根本性悖论：金融市场通过算法系统每秒执行数百万笔交易，但监管规则仍主要用自然语言为人类读者编写，导致执行效率低下、解释模糊和合规成本高昂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管技术（RegTech）理论、计算法学和形式化法律表示理论，提出分层监管架构理论，将法规分为规范法律文本、形式化可计算表示和标准化验证模式三个层次。
AI.method: 采用案例分析方法，通过算法交易、反洗钱监控和自动化监管报告等具体领域的实例，论证可执行法规的实际应用和效果。
AI.findings: 可执行法规能够减少解释模糊性、实现实时合规、降低实施成本并增强监管能力；继续仅为人编写法规实际上将立法权委托给受监管机构的私人程序员。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分层监管架构理论框架，为机器可执行法规提供了理论基础；发展了计算法学在金融监管中的应用理论；提出了"公共控制权回收"理论，强调监管机构需要发布权威的机器可执行实施方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了实施机器可执行法规的具体路径；提出了减少合规成本、增强监管效率的实用方案；为金融科技公司和技术开发者提供了标准化框架；有助于实现监管指导在金融系统合规中的顺畅渗透。

title: The Junior Partner's Dilemma: Endogenous Policy Homogenization and the Collapse of Diversity

detail.title: The Junior Partner's Dilemma: Endogenous Policy Homogenization and the Collapse of Diversity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; this study uses no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Why do junior coalition partners so often converge toward senior parties and suffer electoral collapse? This paper argues that policy homogenization is not a perceptual artifact but a rational response to asymmetric coalition bargaining. We develop a dynamic model in which junior partners choose policy platforms strategically while bargaining power evolves endogenously through electoral accountability. Convergence toward the senior partner increases short-term policy influence but weakens future bargaining power by alienating core supporters. The model identifies an Accountability Threshold: only when parties are sufficiently patient and electorates sufficiently intolerant of ideological deviation can policy distinctiveness be sustained. Below this threshold, optimal behavior induces a self-reinforcing "death spiral" of convergence and declining political influence. An empirical illustration from German politics shows that the Free Democratic Party's ideological convergence in government preceded its failure to re-enter parliament in 2013, while post-exit re-differentiation coincided with electoral recovery. The analysis demonstrates that the survival of policy diversity in coalition systems is not institutionally guaranteed but depends on dynamic electoral constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了联盟政治中为何小党会向大党趋同并导致选举崩溃。研究发现政策趋同不是感知偏差，而是对不对称联盟谈判的理性反应。当政党耐心不足且选民对意识形态偏离容忍度过高时，小党会陷入"死亡螺旋"：趋同削弱未来谈判能力，进一步导致选举失败。德国自民党的案例验证了这一理论。
AI.research_question: 为什么联盟政治中的小党经常向大党政策趋同并遭受选举崩溃？政策趋同是感知偏差还是理性战略选择？
AI.motivation: 观察联盟政治中小党经常在执政后向大党趋同并随后选举失败的现象，需要解释这种看似非理性的行为模式背后的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 不对称联盟谈判理论：小党在联盟中面临权力不对称；2. 动态博弈理论：政策选择影响未来谈判能力；3. 问责阈值理论：政党耐心和选民容忍度决定政策差异能否维持。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：构建动态模型，小党策略性选择政策平台，谈判能力通过选举问责内生化；2. 实证案例：分析德国自民党（FDP）在政府中的意识形态趋同与2013年议会选举失败的关系，以及退出后的重新差异化与选举复苏。
AI.findings: 1. 政策趋同是小党在不对称联盟谈判中的理性战略；2. 趋同增加短期政策影响力但削弱未来谈判能力；3. 存在"问责阈值"：只有当政党足够耐心且选民对意识形态偏离足够不容忍时，政策差异才能维持；4. 低于阈值时，最优行为导致"死亡螺旋"；5. 德国自民党案例验证了理论预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出联盟政治中政策趋同的动态理论；2. 引入"问责阈值"概念解释政策差异的可持续性；3. 揭示联盟系统中政策多样性不是制度保证，而是取决于动态选举约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为小党提供战略指导：避免短期趋同导致长期选举失败；2. 帮助理解联盟政治的稳定性；3. 为选民和政治观察者提供分析框架，理解政党行为模式。

title: The Meritocracy Myth: Supply-Demand Concentration And Economic Barriers In Elite Orchestral Pipelines
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Meritocracy Myth: Supply-Demand Concentration And Economic Barriers In Elite Orchestral Pipelines
detail.abstract: This study examines structural inequality in the U.S. orchestral labor market by linking the supply of specialized training credentials to demand-side hiring in professional orchestras. Using Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) completions data for six orchestral performance Classification of Instructional Programs codes (2011–2024; 127,876 degrees across 1,571 institutions) and original biographical data on musicians’ educational histories from 89 U.S. orchestras (n = 4,591), This study models orchestral careers as a prestige-stratified tournament. A demand-driven algorithm identifies a stable set of seven “elite feeder” institutions—Juilliard, Curtis, New England Conservatory, Cleveland Institute of Music, Rice University, Eastman School of Music (University of Rochester), and Indiana University Jacobs School of Music—that collectively award 11.9% of orchestral performance degrees but supply 57.9% of musicians in the eight most prestigious orchestras and 50.6% in the largest budget orchestras. Access to these gatekeeping institutions is sharply unequal: underrepresented minority students earn degrees at elite feeders at less than half the rate observed in non-feeder programs (5.7% versus 13.8%; risk ratio = 0.41). Concentration intensifies with employer prestige, consistent with tournament dynamics. Benchmarking indicates that persistent racial underrepresentation on stage is more strongly attributable to upstream institutional access than to audition-stage selection alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析美国管弦乐团劳动力市场的供需关系，揭示了精英音乐学院作为"精英输送机构"在职业晋升中的关键作用，这些机构虽然仅颁发11.9%的学位，却为顶级乐团输送了超过50%的音乐家，同时少数族裔学生在这些精英机构中的入学机会显著不足。
AI.research_question: 美国管弦乐团劳动力市场中，专业培训机构的供给与职业乐团的需求如何相互作用，形成结构性的不平等？精英音乐学院在管弦乐职业晋升中扮演什么角色？种族代表性不足主要源于哪个阶段？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国管弦乐团在招聘过程中努力实现多元化，但舞台上种族代表性不足的问题依然存在。研究者希望探究这种不平等的结构性根源，特别是教育机构作为职业晋升"守门人"的作用，以及供需两端如何共同塑造职业机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用"声望分层锦标赛"理论框架，将管弦乐职业生涯视为一个层级化的竞争过程，其中精英音乐学院作为关键的"守门人"机构，控制着通往顶级乐团的机会。
AI.method: 使用IPEDS学位完成数据（2011-2024年，127,876个学位，1,571所机构）和89个美国管弦乐团音乐家的教育背景传记数据（n=4,591）。通过需求驱动算法识别出7所"精英输送机构"，并分析学位授予与职业安置之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 七所精英音乐学院（茱莉亚、柯蒂斯等）仅颁发11.9%的管弦乐表演学位，却为八大最负盛名的乐团输送了57.9%的音乐家，为最大预算乐团输送了50.6%。2. 少数族裔学生在精英机构中获得学位的比例（5.7%）远低于非精英机构（13.8%），风险比为0.41。3. 随着雇主声望的提高，精英机构的集中效应更加明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将锦标赛理论应用于艺术劳动力市场分析。2. 提出了"精英输送机构"作为职业晋升守门人的概念框架。3. 揭示了教育机构在塑造职业机会中的结构性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出解决管弦乐团多样性问题需要关注上游教育机构的准入不平等，而不仅仅是招聘阶段的选拔过程。2. 为音乐教育机构提供了改进招生和培养政策的实证依据。3. 为文化政策制定者提供了解决艺术领域结构性不平等的具体方向。

title: Entrenched in Tradition: The Psychological Cost of Motherhood in Regions with High Son Preference

detail.title: Entrenched in Tradition: The Psychological Cost of Motherhood in Regions with High Son Preference
detail.abstract: Sociological frameworks emphasize the pervasive influence of the macro-environment on individual well-being, yet empirical research on son preference has predominantly focused on the specific outcomes of child gender. This study addresses this limitation by shifting the analytical lens from individual fertility rewards to the regional normative climate. Using longitudinal data from the China Family Panel Studies, we investigate whether regional son preference functions as a systemic environmental stressor for primiparous women. The results indicate that residence in a high-preference region is associated with elevated depression and reduced happiness. This association is not observed prior to childbirth, suggesting that environmental pressures are specifically activated by the transition to motherhood. Furthermore, the analysis demonstrates that this psychological cost is universal rather than conditional. Contrary to the expectation that bearing a son provides a protective buffer, the negative association with mental health extends to mothers of both sons and daughters. We further find that women in these regions exhibit stronger adherence to patriarchal norms and report lower marital quality. These findings highlight those patriarchal norms function as a pervasive environmental risk factor independent of individual fertility outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究将分析视角从个体生育结果转向区域规范环境，发现居住在高男孩偏好地区对初产妇女构成系统性环境压力，导致抑郁增加、幸福感降低，且这种心理成本是普遍的，不受子女性别影响。
AI.research_question: 区域男孩偏好是否作为系统性环境压力源影响初产妇女的心理健康？
AI.motivation: 现有关于男孩偏好的研究主要关注子女性别的具体结果，忽视了宏观环境对个体福祉的普遍影响，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会学框架强调宏观环境对个体福祉的普遍影响；区域规范气候理论；父权制规范作为环境风险因素的理论。
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的纵向数据，分析区域男孩偏好与初产妇女心理健康的关系。
