AI.findings: 1) 居住在高男孩偏好地区与抑郁水平升高和幸福感降低相关；2) 这种关联仅在生育后出现，表明环境压力由母亲角色转变激活；3) 心理成本是普遍的，生男孩并不能提供保护性缓冲；4) 这些地区的女性更遵守父权规范且婚姻质量较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分析焦点从个体生育结果转向区域规范环境；证明父权制规范作为独立于个体生育结果的环境风险因素；挑战了"生男孩作为保护性缓冲"的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了干预区域文化规范以改善妇女心理健康的依据；强调了关注环境压力源而非仅仅个体适应的重要性；为心理健康服务提供了新的干预方向。

title:
Reverse Piercing of the Corporate Veil 
Butcher Shop and Grill CC v Trustees for the time being of the Bymyam Trust 2023 (5) SA 68 (SCA)
affiliations: University of South Africa

detail.title:
Reverse Piercing of the Corporate Veil 
Butcher Shop and Grill CC v Trustees for the time being of the Bymyam Trust 2023 (5) SA 68 (SCA)

keywords: Reverse Piercing of the Corporate Veil

detail.abstract: In Butcher Shop and Grill CC v Trustees for the time being of the Bymyam Trust (2023 (5) SA 68 (SCA)), the Supreme Court of Appeal was faced with the question whether the doctrine of piercing the corporate veil was broad enough to permit a reverse piercing of the corporate veil. The case dealt with an application brought by a lessee to reverse pierce the corporate veil to enable it to claim remission of rent payable to the lessor in circumstances where vis major had interfered with the beneficial use and enjoyment of the leased property by a sublessee. The Supreme Court of Appeal held that there was no scope for the application of the remedy of reverse piercing the corporate veil under the existing principles of South African common law to the facts of this case. It also held that this was not a case where the development of the common law was warranted so as to allow a court to reverse pierce the corporate veil. This note critically analyses the judgment and evaluates whether the court came to the correct decision not to reverse pierce the corporate veil. It also examines the distinction between traditional veil piercing, insider and outsider reverse piercing, and lifting of the veil, and considers whether reverse piercing of the veil ought to be recognised in South African law.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了南非最高法院上诉庭在Butcher Shop and Grill CC v Trustees for the time being of the Bymyam Trust案中的判决，探讨了公司面纱反向刺穿是否应在南非法律中得到承认。
AI.research_question: 公司面纱反向刺穿原则是否应在南非普通法中得到承认？法院在Butcher Shop and Grill CC案中拒绝适用反向刺穿原则是否正确？
AI.motivation: 该案涉及承租人试图通过反向刺穿公司面纱来主张租金减免，但法院拒绝适用此原则，引发了关于南非法律是否应承认反向刺穿原则的讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司面纱刺穿理论，包括传统面纱刺穿、内部人反向刺穿、外部人反向刺穿以及面纱揭开等概念区分。
AI.method: 采用批判性法律分析方法，对最高法院上诉庭的判决进行深入分析，并比较不同司法管辖区对公司面纱反向刺穿的处理方式。
AI.findings: 法院认为现有南非普通法原则不支持反向刺穿公司面纱，且本案情况不足以证明需要发展普通法来承认此原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了公司面纱刺穿理论中的不同概念区分，为南非法律是否应承认反向刺穿原则提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者提供了关于公司面纱反向刺穿原则适用界限的指导，明确了在当前法律框架下此类主张的可行性。

title: Vloa Operating System: Sovereign Infrastructure for Mental Healthcare in Emerging Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Vloa Operating System: Sovereign Infrastructure for Mental Healthcare in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract:
The intersection of mental healthcare, digital sovereignty, and financial technology represents the most critical frontier in modern health infrastructure; a frontier where the Vloa Operating System (VloaOS) is uniquely positioned to serve as the foundational rail. In the wake of Kenya's Mental Health (Amendment) Act 2022 and the transition to the Social Health Authority (SHA), the legacy models of fragmented care delivery and delayed reimbursement are no longer merely inefficient; they are existential threats to providers and patients alike. This White Paper delineates the architectural, legal, and economic frameworks of VloaOS; a vertically integrated platform designed not as a passive software tool but as an active, licensed sovereign entity capable of bridging the chasm between legislative intent and clinical reality.

The central thesis of this paper is that the inefficiencies of the current system, characterized by a 40-90 day latency in insurance payouts, a lack of interoperable clinical data, and stigmatizing identity management, cannot be solved by disparate third-party applications. Instead, they require a unified operating system where Vloa Labs holds the Virtual Facility License directly from the Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council (KMPDC). This sovereignty allows VloaOS to enforce Zero-Knowledge Privacy (ZKP) via Circom circuits; standardize data exchange via HL7 FHIR and USCDI+ Behavioral Health protocols; and execute T+1 (Next Day) financial settlements using embedded crypto-fiat rails. By navigating the complex tax landscape of the Finance Act 2025, specifically the shift from Digital Asset Tax to Excise Duty, VloaOS transforms mental healthcare from a charitable afterthought into a liquid, viable, and scalable market sector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VloaOS作为肯尼亚精神医疗保健的数字主权操作系统，通过垂直整合平台解决当前系统效率低下、数据不互通和支付延迟等问题，将精神医疗从慈善事业转变为可扩展的市场部门。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数字主权操作系统（VloaOS）解决肯尼亚精神医疗保健系统中存在的支付延迟、数据互操作性差和身份管理污名化等系统性效率问题？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚《精神健康（修正）法案2022》和向社会健康管理局（SHA）的过渡暴露了传统医疗模式的缺陷：支付延迟40-90天、临床数据不互通、身份管理存在污名化，这些不仅是效率问题，更是对提供者和患者的生存威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字主权理论、零知识隐私（ZKP）、医疗数据互操作性标准（HL7 FHIR、USCDI+行为健康协议）、金融科技结算理论、监管合规框架。
AI.method: 架构分析、法律框架分析、经济模型设计。VloaOS作为持有肯尼亚医疗从业者和牙医委员会（KMPDC）虚拟设施许可证的主权实体，通过Circom电路实施ZKP隐私保护，标准化数据交换，并利用嵌入式加密法币通道实现T+1（次日）金融结算。
AI.findings: 分散的第三方应用无法解决当前系统的根本问题，需要统一的数字主权操作系统。VloaOS通过直接持有监管许可证，能够有效实施隐私保护、数据标准化和快速金融结算，同时应对《2025年金融法案》的税收变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"数字主权医疗操作系统"理论框架，将监管合规、隐私保护、数据互操作性和金融结算整合到单一平台中，为精神医疗保健数字化提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚精神医疗系统提供了可行的技术解决方案；展示了如何通过监管合规和金融科技创新将精神医疗从慈善事业转变为可扩展的市场部门；为其他发展中国家的医疗数字化提供了参考模型。

title: Counseling on Pest and Plant Disease Control in Pancawati Village, Kampung Pasir Tengah, Bogor
affiliations: , Djuanda University, Djuanda University, Djuanda University, Djuanda University and Djuanda University

detail.title: Counseling on Pest and Plant Disease Control in Pancawati Village, Kampung Pasir Tengah, Bogor
detail.abstract: Pest and plant disease control is one of the main factors in maintaining the sustainability of agricultural productivity. In Pancawati Village, Kampung Pasir Tengah, farmers face serious problems in the form of jaundice in legume crops caused by viral infections transmitted by vector insects, as well as plub disease in tubers due to soil-borne pathogens such as fungi and bacteria. The low level of farmers' understanding in recognizing the early symptoms of the disease and appropriate control techniques leads to high crop losses. Therefore, counseling activities were carried out with the aim of improving farmers' knowledge and skills in implementing integrated pest and disease control. Counseling activities are carried out through interactive lecture methods, participatory discussions, and field demonstrations regarding healthy cultivation techniques, early identification of attack symptoms, and the application of environmentally friendly controls. Control efforts involve the use of plant-based pesticides, land sanitation, and crop rotation as part of an integrated control strategy. The results of the activity showed an increase in farmers' understanding of the causes and control techniques of the disease, as well as an increase in the implementation of sustainable farming practices. It is hoped that the results of this counseling can support the increase in agricultural productivity and resilience of the Pancawati Village community in a sustainable manner.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Pancawati村开展病虫害防治培训活动，通过互动讲座、参与式讨论和田间示范，提高农民对豆类黄化病和块茎腐烂病的识别与防治能力，推广环境友好型综合防治技术。
AI.research_question: 如何通过培训活动提高农民对豆类黄化病和块茎腐烂病的识别能力，并推广环境友好型综合防治技术？
AI.motivation: Pancawati村农民面临豆类黄化病（病毒性）和块茎腐烂病（土传病原体）的严重问题，农民对早期症状识别和适当防治技术了解不足，导致作物损失严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合病虫害管理（IPM）理论，强调环境友好型防治策略，包括植物源农药、土地卫生和轮作等可持续农业实践。
AI.method: 采用互动讲座、参与式讨论和田间示范相结合的方法，培训内容包括健康栽培技术、早期症状识别和环境友好型防治应用。
AI.findings: 培训活动显著提高了农民对病害原因和防治技术的理解，促进了可持续农业实践的采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了参与式培训方法在推广综合病虫害管理技术中的有效性，为农村社区农业技术推广提供了实践案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Pancawati村农民提供了具体的病虫害防治技能，推广了环境友好型防治技术，有望提高农业生产力和社区抗逆能力。

title: Enforcing Safety and Accountability: A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 11058 on Occupational Safety and Health
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Enforcing Safety and Accountability: A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 11058 on Occupational Safety and Health

keywords: An Act Strengthening Compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Standards and Providing Penalties for Violations Thereof
A Critical Analysis of Republic Act No. 11058

detail.abstract: Republic Act No. 11058, titled "An Act Strengthening Compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Standards and Providing Penalties for Violations Thereof," aims to ensure safe and healthy workplaces across all private establishments in the Philippines. This analysis examines the law’s provisions, strengths, weaknesses, and impacts on workers, businesses, and society. RA 11058 requires employers to provide hazard-free workplaces, personal protective equipment, training, welfare facilities, and qualified safety personnel, while empowering workers to report risks, refuse unsafe work, and participate in occupational safety programs. The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) enforces compliance through inspections, fines, work stoppage orders, and agency coordination. Strengths include promoting accountability, reducing hazards, and fostering a safety culture, while weaknesses involve limited guidance for small businesses, inconsistent enforcement, and reliance on employer reporting. Recommendations include improving guidance, inspections, and worker participation. Effective implementation can protect workers, reduce workplace risks, and support social and economic development.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了菲律宾共和国第11058号法案（加强职业安全与健康标准合规性及违规处罚法），评估了该法律的规定、优势、弱点以及对工人、企业和社会的影响。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾共和国第11058号法案的规定、实施效果、优势与弱点是什么？该法律对工人、企业和社会产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 确保菲律宾所有私营企业的工作场所安全与健康，分析该法律的实施效果，为改进职业安全与健康标准提供建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业安全与健康法规分析框架、法律实施效果评估理论、工作场所安全管理理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、政策评估分析、比较分析法（优势与弱点分析）、影响评估。
AI.findings: RA 11058要求雇主提供无危险工作场所、个人防护设备、培训、福利设施和合格安全人员，同时赋予工人报告风险、拒绝不安全工作和参与安全计划的权利。优势包括促进问责制、减少危险和培养安全文化；弱点包括对小企业指导有限、执法不一致和依赖雇主报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家职业安全与健康法律实施效果评估提供了分析框架，丰富了工作场所安全管理理论在法规执行方面的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾政府改进RA 11058实施提供了具体建议（改进指导、加强检查、提高工人参与），为企业合规提供了参考，为工人权益保护提供了法律依据。

title: Cyber Risk Management for Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge Computing Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cyber Risk Management for Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge Computing Systems
detail.abstract: The fast pace of the Internet of Things (IoT), connected with the implementation of edge and fog computing paradigms, has drastically changed the way data is processed, the control of latency, and the provision of services in the most important infrastructures. Nevertheless, this development has also brought about intricate cyber dangers owing to the heterogeneity of devices, dispersed architectures, and poor security capacities at the periphery. The current centralized security models are becoming unsuitable in dealing with such emerging threats. This paper provides a systematic review of the issue of cyber risks in the IoT, edge, and fog computing settings, summarizing the existing body of security research and assessing the existing security measures. The study focuses on cyber vulnerabilities on the device, network, and edge layers, the flaws of which include insecure device authentication, loss of data integrity, privacy, and lack of trust control (Al-Fuqaha et al., 2015; Singh et al., 2015). Moreover, the research points to some key lapses in the existing security frameworks, specifically, their inability to scale, absence of contextual risk awareness, and excessive dependence on centralized control paradigms (Yi, Qin, and Li, 2015; Salman et al., 2015a). The paper is founded on these results and builds a perspective on cyber risk management specific to a decentralized computing environment with an emphasis on adaptive threat mitigation and layered security controls. The research paper concludes that the most effective security legislation of the IoT-edge-fog ecosystem is a layered, risk-based, and decentralized protection strategy that incorporates protection at the device-level, safe communication protocols, and local decision-making. This is a critical way of increasing resiliency, trust, and long-term sustainability of next-generation distributed systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了物联网、边缘和雾计算环境中的网络安全风险，分析了现有安全措施的不足，并提出了一种分层、基于风险、去中心化的安全策略，强调设备级保护、安全通信协议和本地决策的重要性。
AI.research_question: 物联网、边缘和雾计算环境中的网络安全风险是什么？现有安全措施存在哪些不足？如何构建有效的去中心化网络安全风险管理框架？
AI.motivation: 物联网、边缘和雾计算的快速发展改变了数据处理和服务提供方式，但设备异构性、分布式架构和边缘安全能力薄弱带来了复杂的网络安全威胁，现有集中式安全模型已无法应对这些新兴威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物联网安全理论、边缘计算安全框架、去中心化安全模型和风险管理的理论基础，特别关注设备认证、数据完整性、隐私保护和信任控制等核心安全维度。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献回顾方法，总结现有安全研究成果，评估现有安全措施，分析设备层、网络层和边缘层的网络漏洞。
AI.findings: 发现物联网-边缘-雾计算环境存在设备认证不安全、数据完整性丧失、隐私泄露和信任控制缺失等漏洞；现有安全框架存在可扩展性不足、缺乏情境风险意识、过度依赖集中控制模式等关键缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对去中心化计算环境的网络风险管理视角，强调自适应威胁缓解和分层安全控制，为分布式系统安全理论提供了新的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用分层、基于风险、去中心化的保护策略，包括设备级保护、安全通信协议和本地决策，这能增强下一代分布式系统的韧性、信任和长期可持续性。

title:
Global Platform Regulation 
A Framework for Analysing Platform Regulation
affiliations: Tilburg University - TILT

detail.title:
Global Platform Regulation 
A Framework for Analysing Platform Regulation
detail.abstract: This chapter provides a framework to analyse platform regulation. The framework is founded in traditional regulatory theory, but updated and specified for the economic, political and institutional reality of digital platforms. It starts by framing the origins of platform regulation, going over public-private interest and power of ideas theories, while also accounting for the international regulatory environment. Next, the framework untangles platform regulation's purposes, from acting as a competition law shortcut, over mitigating business user dependence and promoting platform competition, to serving industrial policy goals. It then explains how regulation is shaped via a regulatory object and model. While there are many ways to tailor the regulatory object, it tends to centre on a definition or list of platform services paired with a qualitative and/or quantitative threshold of significance. The regulatory model consists of substantive obligations and, importantly, the institutional arrangement of their enforcement. In determining the regulatory object and model, the trade-off between accuracy and administrability is fundamental. Finally, the framework provides a way to think about convergence and divergence at different levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个分析平台监管的框架，该框架基于传统监管理论，但针对数字平台的经济、政治和制度现实进行了更新和具体化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个适用于数字平台监管的分析框架？
AI.motivation: 数字平台的崛起带来了新的监管挑战，需要更新传统监管理论以适应平台经济、政治和制度的现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统监管理论，结合公共-私人利益理论、思想力量理论，并考虑国际监管环境。
AI.method: 概念框架构建方法，通过理论整合和现实适应来发展分析框架。
AI.findings: 提出了一个包含监管起源、目的、监管对象与模型、权衡考量以及趋同/分歧分析的多层次平台监管分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统监管理论更新并具体化到数字平台领域，提供了系统化的分析工具和概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构和研究人员提供了实用的平台监管分析工具，帮助理解监管设计中的权衡和选择。

title: Who's on FIRE? Household Characteristics and the Formation of Inflation Expectations
affiliations: BI Norwegian Business School, De Nederlandsche Bank, Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and De Nederlandsche Bank

detail.title: Who's on FIRE? Household Characteristics and the Formation of Inflation Expectations

publicationDetails.detailsText: De Nederlandsche Bank Working Paper No. 852
publicationDetails.journalName: De Nederlandsche Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how consumers form and revise inflation expectations using a unique, highly balanced monthly panel of Dutch households. We develop a Bayesian frame-work that nests Full-Information Rational Expectations (FIRE) alongside common forecasting heuristics and test it by recovering person-specific belief-updating rules from individual time-series regressions. Our novel individual-level design reveals sub-stantial heterogeneity in how households process information over time. On average, consumers systematically overreact to current inflation, echoing patterns found for pro-fessional forecasters. Only 2.5 percent, predominantly wealthier, more educated men, behave consistently with FIRE. Most consumers rely on simple heuristics, especially adaptive expectations. Our results show that heuristic learning, not FIRE, character-izes expectation formation for the vast majority of households. Crucially, heterogeneity in belief updating is both large and systematic.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用荷兰家庭月度面板数据，通过贝叶斯框架分析消费者通胀预期的形成与修正。研究发现大多数家庭依赖简单启发式（特别是适应性预期），而非完全信息理性预期（FIRE），且存在显著的系统性异质性。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何形成和修正通胀预期？不同家庭在信息处理方式上存在怎样的异质性？
AI.motivation: 理解消费者通胀预期的形成机制对货币政策和经济预测至关重要。现有研究多关注专业预测者，对普通家庭预期形成过程的微观机制了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯框架，嵌套完全信息理性预期（FIRE）与常见预测启发式（如适应性预期）。
AI.method: 使用荷兰家庭月度面板数据，通过个体时间序列回归恢复个人特定的信念更新规则。
AI.findings: 1. 消费者平均对当前通胀存在系统性过度反应；2. 仅2.5%（主要为更富有、受教育程度更高的男性）符合FIRE；3. 大多数家庭依赖简单启发式，特别是适应性预期；4. 信念更新的异质性既大又系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出个体层面的贝叶斯框架，统一FIRE与启发式预期；2. 揭示消费者预期形成的微观异质性；3. 证明启发式学习而非FIRE主导大多数家庭的预期形成。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策制定提供微观基础；2. 帮助理解通胀预期的传播机制；3. 为针对不同人群的经济教育提供依据。

title: Kuliah Kerja Nyata: Student Volunteerism as Developmentalist Social Reproduction in Indonesia

detail.title: Kuliah Kerja Nyata: Student Volunteerism as Developmentalist Social Reproduction in Indonesia
detail.abstract: In 1971, the Indonesian government institutionalized a mandatory student volunteer program in the Indonesian higher education system called Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN). By applying critical development and decolonial theory, this article aims at analyzing the instrumental effects that have been reproduced by the state and university students at performing KKN projects. The study explores how KKN, rather than serving its stated goals of rural development, reinforces state control and reproduces the hegemony of educated elites that has been instituted since the colonial era. The findings indicate that KKN is a tool of nation-building where it consolidates state’s power in rural areas through the entrenchment of bureaucratic structures and dissemination of developmentalism (pembangunanisme). This paper also demonstrates how KKN perpetuates colonial legacies by positioning students, as educated elites, as the ‘saviors’ and petite bureaucrats of rural populations. The study critiques the standardized, top-down nature of KKN projects, arguing that they reflect a broader New Order agenda to manage, pacify, and integrate rural communities into the modern nation-state that is developmental, all while sidestepping the actual problems and aspirations of rural communities. Therefore, the paper challenges the developmentalist discourse surrounding KKN.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性分析了印尼政府1971年实施的强制性学生志愿者项目KKN，发现该项目非但没有实现其宣称的农村发展目标，反而强化了国家对农村的控制，延续了殖民时期的精英霸权，成为国家建设和新秩序议程的工具。
AI.research_question: 印尼政府强制性的学生志愿者项目KKN如何通过国家与学生的实践，再生产出工具性效果，强化国家控制并延续殖民时期的精英霸权？
AI.motivation: KKN项目自1971年实施以来，一直被宣传为促进农村发展的学生志愿者项目，但其实际效果和潜在的政治功能需要批判性分析，特别是该项目如何延续殖民遗产和新秩序议程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判发展理论和去殖民理论，用于分析KKN项目如何再生产国家权力结构和精英霸权。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于批判发展理论和去殖民理论对KKN项目的制度设计和实践效果进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 1. KKN是国家建设的工具，通过巩固官僚结构和传播发展主义来强化国家对农村地区的控制；2. KKN延续殖民遗产，将学生定位为农村人口的"救世主"和小官僚；3. KKN项目标准化、自上而下的性质反映了新秩序议程，旨在管理、安抚并将农村社区整合到现代民族国家中，同时回避农村社区的实际问题和愿望。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将批判发展理论和去殖民理论应用于分析印尼高等教育中的强制性志愿者项目；2. 揭示了发展主义话语如何被国家用作权力巩固的工具；3. 提供了理解后殖民国家如何通过教育项目延续殖民统治模式的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 挑战了KKN项目的发展主义话语；2. 为政策制定者重新思考学生志愿者项目的设计和目标提供了批判性视角；3. 揭示了高等教育如何被用于政治目的，为教育改革提供参考。

title: Disaster Risk Reduction: Building Resilience Through Planning and Collaboration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Unaffiliated Authors, Unaffiliated Authors, Unaffiliated Authors and Unaffiliated Authors

detail.title: Disaster Risk Reduction: Building Resilience Through Planning and Collaboration
detail.abstract: Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) is a strategic approach that emphasizes prevention, mitigation, and capacity building in disaster management, as well as its integration into sustainable development processes. This article discusses the paradigm shift from a reactive to a proactive approach in disaster risk management, positioning DRR as a core component within planning and governance systems. Through a conceptual literature review and analysis of best practices from various regions such as the Kampung Siaga Bencana in Indonesia, Japan's early warning system, and Bangladesh's community cyclone shelter model the article demonstrates that the success of DRR is largely determined by the synergy among data-driven risk mapping, crosssectoral policies, community participation, and technological support. The integration of DRR not only reduces potential disaster losses but also enhances social, economic, and environmental resilience. This article asserts that disaster-resilient development requires a systemic, collaborative, and long-term approach across the entire disaster risk management cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了灾害风险减少（DRR）从被动应对到主动预防的范式转变，强调将DRR整合到规划与治理系统中的重要性。通过文献综述和最佳实践分析，文章指出DRR的成功取决于风险地图、跨部门政策、社区参与和技术支持之间的协同作用。
AI.research_question: 灾害风险减少（DRR）如何从被动应对范式转变为主动预防范式，并有效整合到规划与治理系统中？
AI.motivation: 传统灾害管理主要采取被动应对方式，而DRR强调预防、减缓和能力建设，需要将其整合到可持续发展进程中，实现从被动到主动的范式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害风险减少（DRR）理论框架，包括预防、减缓和能力建设；范式转变理论；系统协同理论；灾害风险管理周期理论。
AI.method: 概念性文献综述和最佳实践分析，案例包括印度尼西亚的Kampung Siaga Bencana、日本的早期预警系统和孟加拉国的社区气旋避难所模型。
AI.findings: DRR的成功主要取决于四个关键要素的协同作用：数据驱动的风险地图、跨部门政策、社区参与和技术支持。DRR的整合不仅能减少潜在灾害损失，还能增强社会、经济和环境的韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DRR范式转变的理论框架，强调了从被动应对到主动预防的系统性转变；发展了DRR成功要素的协同理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将DRR整合到规划与治理系统的具体路径；通过最佳实践案例展示了不同地区DRR实施的成功经验；提出了实现灾害韧性发展的系统性、协作性和长期性方法。

title: Is Hydrogen a Viable Energy Carrier for the Food Industry? Evidence from an Umbrella Review and Systematic Analysis
affiliations: Wroclaw University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Is Hydrogen a Viable Energy Carrier for the Food Industry? Evidence from an Umbrella Review and Systematic Analysis
detail.abstract: Hydrogen is increasingly framed in policy and industrial roadmaps as a cross-sectoral solution for manufacturing decarbonisation. However, industrial sectors differ fundamentally in temperature requirements, load profiles, infrastructure, and safety constraints-conditions that critically determine the feasibility of hydrogen deployment. The food industry, characterised by predominantly low-and medium-temperature processes, remains largely absent from hydrogen-focused assessments despite its substantial energy demand and emissions footprint. Here, we critically examine whether the expanding role of hydrogen in food-sector decarbonisation narratives is supported by empirical evidence. We combine an umbrella review of secondary hydrogen literature (2015-2025; n = 17 reviews) with a systematic review of primary empirical and application-oriented studies relevant to food processing and functionally linked systems (2020-2025). The umbrella review reveals a strong dominance of system-level techno-economic and life-cycle analyses that generalise hydrogen's potential across industrial sectors while largely overlooking process-specific conditions in low-temperature industries. In contrast, the systematic review shows that empirical evidence relevant to the food sector remains fragmented, concentrated at laboratory to pre-demonstration stages (typically TRL 4-6), and provides no documented cases of hydrogen operating as a primary process energy carrier in food processing plants. Across identified pathways, hydrogen's viable role is limited to secondary and system-integrative functions-primarily within circular configurations coupling organic waste and wastewater treatment, biogas production, cogeneration, and renewable electricity-rather than direct substitution of fossil fuels for process heat. These findings demonstrate a structural gap between dominant hydrogen narratives and sector-specific feasibility, indicating that food-industry decarbonisation strategies should prioritise electrification, heat recovery, and hybrid waste-based systems, while reserving hydrogen for contexts in which it delivers demonstrable net energy and emissions benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究批判性评估了氢能在食品行业脱碳叙事中的角色，发现现有证据与政策叙事存在结构性差距。氢能在食品加工中的直接应用缺乏实证支持，其可行角色主要限于废物处理、沼气生产等循环系统中的辅助功能，而非直接替代化石燃料作为主要工艺能源。
AI.research_question: 氢能在食品行业脱碳叙事中的扩张角色是否得到实证证据支持？氢能在食品加工中的实际可行角色是什么？
AI.motivation: 氢能在政策和工业路线图中被广泛视为跨行业制造脱碳解决方案，但不同工业部门在温度要求、负荷特性、基础设施和安全约束等方面存在根本差异。食品行业具有大量中低温工艺需求，但在氢能评估中却基本被忽视，尽管其能源需求和排放足迹巨大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术可行性理论、技术成熟度（TRL）框架、循环经济理论、系统集成理论、能源转型叙事与现实差距分析
AI.method: 结合两种文献综述方法：1）伞式综述（2015-2025年，n=17篇综述），分析二级氢能文献；2）系统综述（2020-2025年），分析与食品加工及相关系统相关的主要实证和应用导向研究。
AI.findings: 1）伞式综述显示现有研究以系统级技术经济和生命周期分析为主，普遍化氢能潜力而忽视低温行业的具体工艺条件；2）系统综述表明食品行业相关实证证据碎片化，集中在实验室到预示范阶段（TRL 4-6），无氢能作为主要工艺能源在食品加工厂运行的记录案例；3）氢能的可行角色限于循环配置中的辅助和系统集成功能（废物处理、沼气生产、热电联产等），而非直接替代化石燃料用于工艺加热。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了氢能叙事与行业特定可行性之间的结构性差距；2）提出了基于实证证据的氢能角色定位理论，区分直接替代与系统集成功能；3）为能源转型叙事与现实实施之间的脱节提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）建议食品行业脱碳策略应优先考虑电气化、热回收和混合废物基系统；2）氢能应仅用于能证明净能源和排放效益的特定场景；3）为政策制定者和行业决策者提供了基于证据的氢能部署指导，避免盲目跟随叙事而忽视实际可行性。

title: The Impact of Open Innovation on Educational Performance: The Mediating Role of External Knowledge Mobilisation and Innovative Governance
affiliations: Ibn Tofail University, Ibn Tofaîl university and Ibn Tofaîl university

detail.title: The Impact of Open Innovation on Educational Performance: The Mediating Role of External Knowledge Mobilisation and Innovative Governance
detail.abstract:
This study investigates how open innovation influences educational performance through the mediating roles of external knowledge mobilisation and innovative governance in the Moroccan education system. Drawing on data collected from 428 education professionals across public and private institutions and all regions of Morocco, the study applies Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) to test the proposed relationships.
The results show that open innovation has a strong and significant positive effect on both external knowledge mobilisation and innovative governance. While external knowledge mobilisation does not exert a significant direct effect on educational performance, innovative governance emerges as a key determinant of performance. Mediation analysis further reveals that innovative governance constitutes the primary transmission mechanism through which open innovation translates into performance improvements, whereas the mediating role of external knowledge mobilisation is not statistically supported.
These findings contribute to the literature by clarifying the organizational conditions under which open innovation generates value in educational institutions. They also provide practical insights for policymakers and educational leaders by highlighting the importance of governance reforms in leveraging openness and collaboration to achieve sustainable improvements in educational performance, particularly in developing country contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨开放创新如何通过外部知识动员和创新治理的中介作用影响教育绩效。基于摩洛哥428名教育专业人士的数据，研究发现开放创新对知识动员和治理有显著正向影响，但只有创新治理能直接提升教育绩效并作为主要中介机制。
AI.research_question: 开放创新如何通过外部知识动员和创新治理的中介作用影响摩洛哥教育系统的教育绩效？
AI.motivation: 探讨在发展中国家教育系统中，开放创新如何转化为实际绩效提升，特别关注组织条件（知识动员和治理）的中介作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放创新理论、知识管理理论、组织治理理论，以及这些理论在教育管理中的应用。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法收集摩洛哥428名教育专业人士的数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行假设检验和中介效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. 开放创新对外部知识动员和创新治理有显著正向影响；2. 创新治理对教育绩效有直接正向影响，而外部知识动员没有显著直接影响；3. 创新治理是开放创新影响教育绩效的主要中介机制，外部知识动员的中介作用不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了开放创新在教育机构中创造价值的组织条件，特别是治理机制的关键中介作用，拓展了开放创新理论在教育管理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育领导者提供实践启示：应优先推进治理改革，而非仅仅关注知识获取，才能有效利用开放创新实现教育绩效的可持续提升，特别是在发展中国家背景下。

title: Structural and Connectivity Drivers of Scientific Knowledge Production: A New Structural Economics Perspective on Upper-Middle-Income Countries
affiliations: and Beijing Normal University

detail.title: Structural and Connectivity Drivers of Scientific Knowledge Production: A New Structural Economics Perspective on Upper-Middle-Income Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not Applicable

detail.abstract: The upper-middle-income countries (UMICs) locate themselves in a challenging position, straddling two worlds within the global economy of knowledge. They have enough wealth to avoid relying on low-wage replication; however, most of them have structural barricades that cannot be overcome to influence innovation-led growth. Most countries have developed their education, opened up trade and adopted digital technologies, yet their paths towards scientific and technological progress are more than noticeably uneven. The question posed by this article is why, despite the similarity in the level of income, there is such a wide gap in the ability of countries to produce and maintain technological advancements. Uniting New Structural Economics (NSE) and the open-innovation paradigm, the article constructs a hybrid framework where the process of technological advancement is viewed as a result of interactions between the state structural factors and the knowledge flows mediated by the market. It does not consider 'technology' as a black box but instead conceptualises it as progress in terms of scientific and technical journal activity, in which publications are considered as a major space in which societies structure, codify and disseminate knowledge. The study empirically employs a macro-panel of 37 UMICs between the years 1996 and 2023 and involves both instrumental-variable estimation and robust standard errors and an error-correction model to identify both long-run relationships and short-run dynamics. The findings demonstrate that technological change is closely linked to the collective growth of R&D intensity, tertiary education, digital connectivity and financial richness; in contrast, a high degree of trade openness may not go hand in hand with the development of scientific knowledge within the country in case it supports import-reliant specialisation. Towards the long-run innovation path, the adjustment is slow but significant, with about one-third of the deviation from the long-run path absorbed each year. The article advances the Science and Technology Studies through redefining technological development in UMICs to be a structured and more networked and unequal event and through demonstrating that generic trade liberalisation and generous education expenditure are not necessarily or easily translated into lasting improvements in scientific and technical capabilities unless built into a structurally planned structural and financial space.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了中等偏上收入国家（UMICs）在科技创新能力上的巨大差异，尽管这些国家收入水平相似。研究结合新结构经济学和开放式创新理论，构建了一个混合框架，将技术进步视为国家结构因素与市场中介的知识流动相互作用的结果。通过对37个UMICs的宏观面板数据分析发现，研发强度、高等教育、数字连接和金融丰富度的集体增长与技术进步密切相关，而高度贸易开放可能不会促进国内科学知识发展，特别是当它支持进口依赖型专业化时。
AI.research_question: 为什么在收入水平相似的情况下，中等偏上收入国家在产生和维持技术进步能力方面存在如此大的差距？
AI.motivation: 中等偏上收入国家在全球知识经济中处于挑战性位置：它们有足够财富避免依赖低工资复制，但大多数存在结构性障碍，无法实现创新驱动增长。尽管这些国家发展了教育、开放贸易并采用数字技术，但它们的科技发展路径却明显不均衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合新结构经济学（NSE）和开放式创新范式，构建了一个混合框架，将技术进步视为国家结构因素与市场中介的知识流动相互作用的结果。该框架不将"技术"视为黑箱，而是将其概念化为科学和技术期刊活动的进展，其中出版物被视为社会结构化、编码和传播知识的主要空间。
AI.method: 实证研究采用1996-2023年间37个中等偏上收入国家的宏观面板数据，使用工具变量估计、稳健标准误差和误差修正模型，以识别长期关系和短期动态。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）技术变革与研发强度、高等教育、数字连接和金融丰富度的集体增长密切相关；2）高度贸易开放可能不会促进国内科学知识发展，特别是当它支持进口依赖型专业化时；3）向长期创新路径的调整缓慢但显著，每年吸收约三分之一偏离长期路径的偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将UMICs的技术发展重新定义为结构化、网络化和不平等的事件，推进了科学技术研究。研究表明，通用的贸易自由化和慷慨的教育支出不一定或不容易转化为科学和技术能力的持久改善，除非它们被纳入结构规划和金融空间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：单纯依靠贸易开放和教育投资不足以促进科技创新，需要构建结构化的研发强度、高等教育、数字连接和金融丰富度的协同发展体系，避免进口依赖型专业化模式。

title: Effectiveness of ChatGPT towards Mastery of Writing
affiliations: Education and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Effectiveness of ChatGPT towards Mastery of Writing

publicationDetails.detailsText: Has this paper appeared, or been accepted to appear, in a Paper Series, Journal or Book? If so, please enter the details below.

detail.abstract: The ability to write effectively is a fundamental skill essential for academic, professional, and personal success. However, many individuals face challenges in developing and mastering writing proficiency. In today’s digital landscape, ChatGPT has transformed technology and how we work. With the increasing integration of technology in education, there is a growing interest in exploring how ChatGPT can enhance learning outcomes, particularly in writing instruction. The aim of this study is to investigate how ChatGPT can effectively assist students in developing their writing skills. Therefore, the researchers employed a quasi-experimental design, utilizing pre-test, treatment, and post-test interventions to evaluate any significant differences in the mastery of writing before and after utilizing ChatGPT as a learning tool. The findings revealed a significant improvement in students' writing skills, particularly in coherence and grammar, attributed to the use of ChatGPT.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨ChatGPT如何有效帮助学生提升写作技能，通过准实验设计发现使用ChatGPT后学生在写作连贯性和语法方面有显著改善。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT如何有效帮助学生发展写作技能？
AI.motivation: 写作能力对学术、职业和个人成功至关重要，但许多人面临写作能力发展的挑战。随着技术在教育中的整合，探索ChatGPT如何提升写作教学成果的兴趣日益增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术增强学习理论、写作教学理论、人工智能辅助教育理论
AI.method: 准实验设计，采用前测、干预处理和后测来评估使用ChatGPT作为学习工具前后写作掌握程度的显著差异
AI.findings: 学生的写作技能有显著提升，特别是在连贯性和语法方面，这归因于ChatGPT的使用
AI.theory_contributions: 为人工智能辅助写作教学提供了实证支持，丰富了技术增强学习理论在写作领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供了使用ChatGPT提升学生写作技能的有效策略，为教育技术整合提供了实践指导

title: Effect of B. subtilis (BD233) and Bradyrhizobium Spp CB756 Co-Inoculation on Symbiotic Performance of Local Cowpea Genotypes Irrigated with Acid Mine Water
affiliations: University of South Africa, University of South Africa and Njala University

detail.title: Effect of B. subtilis (BD233) and Bradyrhizobium Spp CB756 Co-Inoculation on Symbiotic Performance of Local Cowpea Genotypes Irrigated with Acid Mine Water
detail.abstract: Heavy metal stress due to mine water is noted to affect the growth and development of plants. However, the synergistic effect of dual inoculation of legumes has been reported to supress environmental stress due to drought, heat and heavy metal. Effect of co-inoculating B. subtilis (BD233) with Bradyrhizobium spp CB756 on the symbiotic performance of three local cowpea genotypes exposed to mine water under glasshouse conditions was determined using a randomized complete block design with three replications. The four inoculation treatments included: i) No inoculation, ii) B. subtilis BD234 strain, iii) Bradyrhizobium spp CB756 strain, iv) B. subtilis BD234 and Bradyrhizobium spp CB756 strain co-inoculation. Three levels of acid mine (0%, 25%, and 75%) were applied at 200 mL per pot per day throughout the experiment. Cowpea irrigated with mine water and co-inoculated showed resistance to heavy metal stress with respect to their symbiotic performance and genotypic differences were noted. Pan 311 with the lowest δ15N and highest amount of N-fixed was found to be more dependent on nitrogen fixation compared to Glenda and Sudan, and it also had higher soil N uptake with heaviest dry shoot biomass. Cowpea co-inoculated with dual inoculation had more nodules per plant compared to control and Glenda exhibited the highest number of nodules compared to Pan 311 and Sudan. Similarly, there were significant differences in nutrient accumulation, cowpea with co-inoculation had lower C/N values compared to those inoculated with single or without inoculation. According to these findings, co-inoculation with B. subtilis (BD233) and Bradyrhizobium spp CB756 is a promising technology for bioremediation of AMD polluted water bodies and soils in mining communities in South Africa, especially for the cultivation of leguminous crops such as local cowpea genotypes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在酸性矿山废水胁迫下，B. subtilis BD234与Bradyrhizobium spp CB756双重接种对三种当地豇豆基因型共生性能的影响。研究发现双重接种能增强豇豆对重金属胁迫的抗性，改善固氮效率和养分积累，为南非矿区AMD污染水体和土壤的生物修复提供了有前景的技术方案。
AI.research_question: 在酸性矿山废水胁迫下，B. subtilis BD234与Bradyrhizobium spp CB756双重接种对三种当地豇豆基因型共生性能有何影响？
AI.motivation: 矿山废水中的重金属胁迫会影响植物生长发育，而豆科植物的双重接种已被证明能抑制干旱、高温和重金属等环境胁迫。本研究旨在探索双重接种技术在南非矿区酸性矿山废水污染修复中的应用潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于植物-微生物共生理论，特别是根瘤菌与豆科植物的固氮共生关系，以及植物促生菌（PGPR）如B. subtilis对植物抗逆性的增强作用。研究探讨了微生物协同作用对植物重金属胁迫耐受性的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用随机完全区组设计，设置四种接种处理（不接种、单接种B. subtilis、单接种Bradyrhizobium、双重接种）和三种酸性矿山废水浓度（0%、25%、75%），每天每盆200mL，在温室条件下评估三种当地豇豆基因型（Pan 311、Glenda、Sudan）的共生性能。
AI.findings: 双重接种的豇豆对重金属胁迫表现出更强的抗性，Pan 311基因型具有最低的δ15N和最高的固氮量，对固氮依赖度最高；双重接种植株的根瘤数量显著增加，Glenda基因型根瘤数最多；双重接种降低了C/N比值，改善了养分积累效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了植物-微生物共生理论在重金属胁迫环境下的应用，揭示了不同豆科植物基因型对微生物接种响应的差异，为理解微生物协同作用增强植物抗逆性提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非矿区酸性矿山废水污染水体和土壤的生物修复提供了可行的技术方案，特别是为当地豇豆等豆科作物的栽培提供了微生物接种策略，有助于改善矿区农业生产和生态环境修复。

title: The Compounding Effect: An Independent Analysis of the Long-Term Economic ROI of the "Shadow Curriculum"
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Compounding Effect: An Independent Analysis of the Long-Term Economic ROI of the "Shadow Curriculum"
detail.abstract: In this paper, I investigate the economic phenomenon I call the "Compounding Effect" of early education. While traditional education metrics focus on classroom hours and standardized test scores, I argue that the true driver of long-term wage premiums lies in specific extracurricular programs-what I term the "Shadow Curriculum." By analyzing longitudinal data on sports, forensics, music, and STEM clubs, I model how early non-cognitive skill acquisition creates a "force multiplier" for future human capital. Unlike previous studies that treat these activities as leisure, my research treats them as high-stakes capital investments. I examine the mechanisms of dynamic complementarity, signaling theory, and social capital formation. Furthermore, I address the widening inequality gap created by the "pay-to-play" nature of these high-ROI activities, arguing that the modern meritocracy is increasingly a measure of extracurricular investment rather than innate potential. Finally, I explore how these skills serve as a "moat" in an economy increasingly dominated by Artificial Intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"早期教育复合效应"概念，认为课外活动形成的"影子课程"比传统课堂教育更能驱动长期工资溢价，但加剧了教育不平等。
AI.research_question: 课外活动（体育、辩论、音乐、STEM俱乐部）如何通过非认知技能发展产生"复合效应"，从而影响长期人力资本积累和工资溢价？
AI.motivation: 传统教育指标（课堂时间和标准化考试成绩）无法充分解释长期工资差异，需要探索课外活动作为人力资本投资的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态互补性理论、信号理论、社会资本形成理论，以及将课外活动视为高风险资本投资而非休闲活动的视角。
AI.method: 分析体育、辩论、音乐和STEM俱乐部的纵向数据，建立模型研究早期非认知技能获取如何成为未来人力资本的"力量倍增器"。
AI.findings: 课外活动通过非认知技能发展产生复合效应，创造长期工资溢价；但这些高回报活动具有"付费参与"性质，加剧了不平等；现代精英制越来越衡量课外投资而非内在潜力；这些技能在AI主导的经济中形成"护城河"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"影子课程"概念，将课外活动重新定义为高风险的资本投资而非休闲；建立早期教育复合效应模型；整合动态互补性、信号理论和社会资本形成机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供课外活动投资重要性的证据；揭示教育不平等的新机制；为家长和学生提供课外活动选择的战略指导；为AI时代人力资本发展提供新视角。

title: From Responsible AI to Enforceable AI: Why AI Governance Requires New Institutions, AI Forensics, and Creates a Job Guarantee

detail.title: From Responsible AI to Enforceable AI: Why AI Governance Requires New Institutions, AI Forensics, and Creates a Job Guarantee
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance has largely remained normative, principle-driven, and voluntary, emphasizing fairness, transparency, and responsibility. However, as AI systems increasingly operate within healthcare, finance, defense, and public administration, ethical principles alone fail to address real-world operational conflicts, security threats, and post-incident accountability. This paper argues that Responsible AI must evolve into Enforceable AI through the creation of new institutions, legal frameworks, and technical disciplines-particularly AI Forensics. Contrary to widespread fears of job loss, this transition will generate a new class of governance, forensic, and oversight roles, effectively transforming AI risk into employment opportunities. The paper proposes a governance architecture, outlines institutional gaps, and introduces AI Forensics as a foundational discipline for post-incident investigation and prevention.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将负责任AI转变为可执行AI，通过建立新机构、法律框架和技术学科（特别是AI取证）来解决AI治理中的实际问题，并将AI风险转化为就业机会。
AI.research_question: 如何将当前以原则为导向的负责任AI治理转变为可执行、可问责的AI治理体系？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理主要停留在规范性、原则驱动和自愿性层面，强调公平、透明和负责任。但随着AI系统在医疗、金融、国防和公共管理等关键领域广泛应用，仅靠伦理原则无法解决实际运营冲突、安全威胁和事后问责问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从负责任AI到可执行AI的治理转型理论；AI取证作为新兴学科的理论基础；AI风险转化为就业机会的社会经济理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架；治理架构设计；制度缺口分析；AI取证学科构建。
AI.findings: 需要建立新的治理架构、法律框架和技术学科；AI取证应成为事后调查和预防的基础学科；AI治理转型将创造新的治理、取证和监督工作岗位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从负责任AI到可执行AI的治理转型理论；建立了AI取证作为新兴学科的理论框架；发展了AI风险转化为就业机会的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的治理架构建议；为教育机构提供了AI取证学科建设指南；为企业和社会展示了AI治理转型带来的就业机会。

title: Chaining Tasks, Redefining Work: A Theory of AI Automation
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Microsoft Research, Microsoft Research and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Chaining Tasks, Redefining Work: A Theory of AI Automation
detail.abstract:
Production is a sequence of steps that can be executed (1) manually, (2) augmented with AI, or (3) fully automated within contiguous AI-executed steps called “chains.” Firms optimally bundle steps into tasks and then jobs, trading off specialization gains against coordination costs. We characterize the optimal assignment of humans and AI to steps and the firm’s resulting job structure, showing that comparative advantage logic can fail with AI chaining. The model implies non-linear productivity gains from AI quality improvements and admits a CES representation at the macro level. Empirical evidence supports the model’s key predictions that (1) AI-executed steps co-occur in chains, (2) dispersion of AI-exposed steps lowers AI execution at the job level, and (3) adjacency to AI-executed steps increases the likelihood that a step is AI-executed.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI如何改变生产流程的组织结构。生产流程由多个步骤组成，每个步骤可以人工执行、AI辅助执行或完全自动化执行。作者建立模型分析企业如何将步骤组合成任务和工作岗位，权衡专业化收益与协调成本，并探讨AI链式执行对比较优势逻辑的颠覆性影响。
AI.research_question: 企业如何最优地将生产步骤分配给人类和AI？AI链式执行如何影响工作组织结构？AI质量改进如何非线性地影响生产率？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的发展，企业面临如何将AI整合到生产流程中的决策问题。传统比较优势理论在AI链式执行情境下可能失效，需要新的理论框架来理解AI如何改变工作组织和生产率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产流程分解理论、任务分配模型、比较优势理论、专业化与协调成本权衡框架，引入AI链式执行概念。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建生产流程优化模型，分析步骤分配、任务捆绑和工作结构的最优设计。实证检验：使用数据验证模型的关键预测。
AI.findings: 1. AI执行的步骤倾向于聚集在"链"中；2. AI暴露步骤的分散会降低工作层面的AI执行率；3. 邻近AI执行步骤的步骤更可能被AI执行；4. AI质量改进带来非线性生产率提升；5. 宏观层面可表示为CES生产函数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI链式执行概念；2. 证明比较优势逻辑在AI链式执行中可能失效；3. 建立AI整合的生产组织理论框架；4. 推导AI质量改进的非线性生产率效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业AI整合提供决策框架；2. 指导工作重新设计；3. 帮助政策制定者理解AI对劳动力市场的影响；4. 为AI投资决策提供理论依据。

title: Paraguay Before and After the War of the Triple Alliance: Demographic Devastation, Geopolitical Exclusion, and Economic Resilience

detail.title: Paraguay Before and After the War of the Triple Alliance: Demographic Devastation, Geopolitical Exclusion, and Economic Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the historical and economic evolution of Paraguay from the period preceding the War of the Triple Alliance (1864-1870) through its prolonged process of institutional reconstruction and macroeconomic stabilization. It argues that the demographic, productive, and state destruction suffered by the country represents an extreme and unprecedented case in South America, whose magnitude profoundly and durably altered Paraguay's social, economic, and institutional structure. Far from constituting a functional or desirable process, this historical rupture imposed severe structural constraints that conditioned economic policy decisions in the decades that followed. Within this context, the paper contends that the long-term fiscal prudence and monetary stability observed in Paraguay emerged as adaptive responses to a traumatic historical experience, differentiating its macroeconomic trajectory from that of other Southern Cone economies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了巴拉圭从三国同盟战争前到战后制度重建和宏观经济稳定的历史经济演变，认为该国遭受的人口、生产和国家破坏是南美洲前所未有的极端案例，这种历史断裂形成了长期的结构性约束，而巴拉圭的长期财政审慎和货币稳定是对这一创伤经历的适应性反应。
AI.research_question: 巴拉圭从三国同盟战争前到战后制度重建和宏观经济稳定的历史经济演变如何塑造了其独特的宏观经济轨迹？
AI.motivation: 巴拉圭在三国同盟战争中遭受了极端的人口、生产和国家破坏，这一历史断裂对其社会经济结构产生了深远影响，但现有研究对其长期宏观经济轨迹的形成机制关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义、路径依赖理论、创伤经济学、宏观经济政策适应性理论
AI.method: 历史分析方法、比较历史分析、宏观经济数据分析、制度演变研究
AI.findings: 巴拉圭遭受的破坏是南美洲前所未有的极端案例，深刻改变了其社会经济结构；这种历史断裂形成了长期的结构性约束；巴拉圭的长期财政审慎和货币稳定是对创伤经历的适应性反应；其宏观经济轨迹与南锥体其他国家存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"创伤经济学"框架来解释历史断裂对宏观经济政策的长期影响；发展了历史制度主义在极端破坏情境下的应用；为理解宏观经济政策的适应性反应提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解巴拉圭独特的宏观经济政策选择提供了历史解释；为其他经历过类似历史创伤的国家提供了政策参考；有助于政策制定者理解历史经验对当前经济决策的深远影响。

title: Great Expectations: Responses to Current and Future Transfers for Low-Income Individuals
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), HEC Montreal, Williams College and Northwestern University

detail.title: Great Expectations: Responses to Current and Future Transfers for Low-Income Individuals
detail.abstract:
How does the expectation of aid change behavior? We propose a simple approach to separate expectations effects from the direct effects of relaxing resource constraints: compare the promise of a program to the program itself. We test this approach in a four-arm randomized controlled trial of cash transfers in Uganda. Both those who received cash and those promised-to-receive cash increase their labor supply and investment. Immediate transfers also increase household expenditures and savings. Our results are not consistent with standard life-cycle models; they are better explained by a model in which the transfer increases individual labor productivity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较承诺援助与实际援助的效果，分离了期望效应与资源约束放松的直接效应。在乌干达的现金转移实验中，发现无论是实际收到现金还是被承诺将收到现金的人都会增加劳动供给和投资，但只有实际收到现金的人会增加家庭支出和储蓄。
AI.research_question: 援助预期如何改变行为？如何分离期望效应与资源约束放松的直接效应？
AI.motivation: 理解援助项目的影响机制，区分期望效应（心理预期）与资源约束放松的直接效应，这对于评估援助项目的真实效果和政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准生命周期模型（无法解释实验结果）；转移提高个人劳动生产率的模型（能更好解释实验结果）
AI.method: 四臂随机对照试验（RCT），在乌干达进行现金转移实验，比较四种情况：实际收到现金、被承诺将收到现金、以及相应的对照组。
AI.findings: 1. 实际收到现金和被承诺将收到现金的人都增加了劳动供给和投资；2. 只有实际收到现金的人增加了家庭支出和储蓄；3. 结果与标准生命周期模型不一致，但可以通过转移提高个人劳动生产率的模型解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一种分离期望效应与资源约束放松直接效应的简单方法；2. 挑战了标准生命周期模型的解释力；3. 支持了转移提高个人劳动生产率的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为援助项目评估提供了新的方法论；2. 揭示了援助的心理预期效应与资源效应的不同作用；3. 对援助政策设计有重要启示，需要考虑期望效应的影响。

title: Structural Liquidity Displacement, Exchange Rate Instability, and a KRW-Stablecoin-Based Policy Framework
affiliations: Independent Policy Researcher

detail.title: Structural Liquidity Displacement, Exchange Rate Instability, and a KRW-Stablecoin-Based Policy Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural origins of Korea's recent exchange rate volatility and the concurrent liquidity-driven rally in domestic asset markets. Departing from conventional explanations centered on interest rate differentials, the paper advances a Liquidity Displacement Hypothesis, arguing that the erosion of domestic real estate as a credible capital absorption mechanism has redirected excess liquidity toward foreign financial assets and domestic equities, generating a persistent combination of currency depreciation and asset price inflation. To address this dynamic, the paper proposes a market-compatible policy framework centered on a KRW-denominated stablecoin, hereafter referred to as a digital asset-linked macroprudential instrument, fully collateralized by Korean sovereign bonds. By employing asymmetric leverage authorization-permitting high-leverage trading exclusively for KRW-backed digital assets-the framework aims to rechannel speculative demand away from the foreign exchange market. This soft capital redirection preserves market mechanisms while enhancing bond market stability and protecting household real income from exchange-rate-induced inflation. This paper constitutes the second in a series examining the structural origins of Korea's exchange rate instability. Detailed empirical evidence and stylized facts motivating this framework are documented in the companion paper (Paper I).

AI.tldr: 本文提出流动性置换假说，解释韩国汇率波动与资产价格上涨并存的现象，并提出基于韩元稳定币的数字资产挂钩宏观审慎工具政策框架。
AI.research_question: 韩国近期汇率波动与国内资产市场流动性驱动上涨的结构性根源是什么？如何通过市场兼容的政策框架解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 传统利率差异解释无法充分解释韩国汇率贬值与资产价格通胀并存的异常现象，需要探索结构性根源并提出创新政策解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性置换假说：国内房地产作为资本吸收机制失效，导致过剩流动性转向外国金融资产和国内股票，造成货币贬值与资产价格通胀并存。
AI.method: 理论分析与政策框架设计，提出基于韩元稳定币的数字资产挂钩宏观审慎工具，采用非对称杠杆授权机制。
AI.findings: 房地产资本吸收功能弱化导致流动性重新配置，产生汇率波动与资产价格上涨的结构性矛盾，需要创新政策工具进行疏导。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出流动性置换假说，超越传统利率差异解释；建立汇率波动与资产价格关系的结构性分析框架；引入数字资产挂钩宏观审慎工具概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计基于韩元稳定币的政策框架，通过非对称杠杆机制将投机需求从外汇市场转移；保护家庭实际收入免受汇率通胀影响；增强债券市场稳定性。

title: Review of "Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference": Advances, Limitations, and Empirical Validation Strategies

detail.title: Review of "Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference": Advances, Limitations, and Empirical Validation Strategies
detail.abstract: The paper "Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference" by Kuditipudi et al. (2025) presents a groundbreaking method for detecting the provenance of large language models (LLMs) and their outputs in black-box scenarios, utilizing palimpsestic memorization effects-where later training data leaves stronger traces-to design independence tests that correlate model or text behavior with randomized training orders. This approach achieves statistical guarantees (e.g., low p-values) without requiring invasive modifications, demonstrating efficacy on models like Pythia and OLMo in query and observational settings. This review provides a detailed summary of the paper's framework, including problem formulation, test statistics, and empirical results; critically analyzes its limitations, such as assumptions on data shuffling, reduced effectiveness under fine-tuning, computational demands, and vulnerabilities to evasion strategies; and explores complementary watermarking techniques, expanding on their evasion methods like bias inversion and adaptive attacks. We propose an enhanced methodology for empirical validation, emphasizing reproducibility through detailed setups, controlled experiments on shuffling, fine-tuning, evasion, scalability, and watermark integration, using open-source tools with specified versions and seeds. While innovative, the method's practical deployment for intellectual property enforcement necessitates rigorous testing to address evolving LLM architectures and adversarial threats.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于"重写式记忆效应"的黑盒模型溯源方法，通过分析训练数据顺序对模型行为的影响来检测LLM及其输出的来源，无需模型内部访问权限。
AI.research_question: 如何在黑盒场景下检测大型语言模型及其输出的来源，特别是在无法访问模型内部参数的情况下？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM的广泛应用，模型知识产权保护和输出溯源成为重要问题。现有方法通常需要白盒访问或模型修改，而实际场景中模型往往是黑盒的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"重写式记忆效应"理论：后期训练数据在模型中留下更强的痕迹，通过分析训练数据随机顺序与模型行为的相关性来设计独立性检验。
AI.method: 利用训练数据随机排序设计统计检验，通过查询或观察模型输出来计算p值，在Pythia和OLMo等模型上进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 方法在查询和观察设置下有效，能够获得低p值的统计保证，但存在数据洗牌假设、微调后效果下降、计算需求大、易受规避策略攻击等限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于重写式记忆效应的黑盒模型溯源理论框架，为LLM知识产权保护提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无需模型修改的黑盒溯源方法，可与水印技术互补，为实际部署中的知识产权执法提供了工具。

title: Disability Insurance and Labor Supply: The Role of Health Insurance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Disability Insurance and Labor Supply: The Role of Health Insurance
detail.abstract: In this paper, I study the relative importance of the different types of benefits offered by a suite of social insurance programs. Particularly, I focus on the two major disability insurance programs in the United States-the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) program. Beneficiaries of these programs receive both cash and health insurance benefits via Medicare and Medicaid, respectively. Different from prior work which has predominantly focused on the role of cash benefits, I study how the health insurance benefits affect participation in these programs and in the labor market, in addition to and separately from the cash benefits. I estimate a conditional logit choice model of labor supply and program application decision using data from the Health and Retirement Study coupled with administrative F831 records which provide data on applications to the two programs. I find that individuals value the cash and the health insurance benefits differently for SSI and SSDI; further there is heterogeneity across education and gender. While the SSI benefits predict participation decisions for high school dropouts who are drawn to the program primarily by the cash benefits, the SSDI benefits predict participation decisions for high school graduates for whom the health insurance benefits drive participation. The magnitude of these results vary by gender. The relative disincentive effects of the two types of benefits on labor market participation is heterogeneous akin to their relative effects on program participation. Based on these findings, I suggest policies that reduce caseloads and costs while increasing work incentives, without depriving the needy of assistance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国两大残疾保险项目（SSDI和SSI）中现金福利与医疗保险福利的相对重要性，发现不同教育水平和性别的个体对这些福利的重视程度存在差异，并据此提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 残疾保险项目中的医疗保险福利如何影响项目参与和劳动力市场行为？与现金福利相比，医疗保险福利的相对重要性是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注残疾保险项目的现金福利，但忽略了医疗保险福利的作用。理解这两种福利的相对重要性对于制定有效政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于理性选择理论，个体在劳动力供给和项目申请决策中权衡现金福利和医疗保险福利的价值。
AI.method: 使用健康与退休研究数据结合行政F831记录，估计条件logit选择模型来分析劳动力供给和项目申请决策。
AI.findings:
1. 个体对SSI和SSDI的现金与医疗保险福利评价不同
2. 存在教育和性别异质性：高中辍学者主要受SSI现金福利吸引，高中毕业生则主要受SSDI医疗保险福利驱动
3. 两种福利对劳动力市场参与的抑制作用也存在类似异质性
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析残疾保险项目中医疗保险福利的相对重要性，揭示了福利类型、教育水平和性别之间的复杂交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出既能减少项目负担和成本，又能增强工作激励，同时不剥夺需要者援助的政策建议。

title: Supply-Driven Inflation: Anchored Expectations and Optimal Macroeconomic Policy Response

detail.title: Supply-Driven Inflation: Anchored Expectations and Optimal Macroeconomic Policy Response
detail.abstract: This paper investigates why U.S. inflation during 2021–2022 subsided without the expected rise in unemployment implied by the Phillips curve, advancing the question of whether supply-side factors and anchored expectations reshaped the inflation–employment relationship. Drawing on macroeconomic data from FRED, the study integrates empirical analysis of inflation, wage growth, energy prices, and unemployment to test the sensitivity of inflation to labor market conditions. The theoretical framework re-evaluates the Phillips curve in the context of supply-driven inflation and credible inflation-targeting regimes. Results indicate that supply shocks—mainly energy price and supply-chain disruptions—proved transitory, while the Federal Reserve’s communication effectively anchored expectations near its 2% target. Consequently, inflation declined without the employment sacrifices predicted by traditional models, implying a flatter Phillips curve and stronger role for expectations anchoring. The study concludes that macroeconomic policy must better distinguish supply- from demand-induced inflation, integrating expectations management and policy credibility into models of disinflation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了2021-2022年美国通胀下降但失业率未如菲利普斯曲线预期上升的原因，发现供给冲击是暂时的，美联储的预期锚定政策有效，使得通胀回落无需以就业为代价。
AI.research_question: 为什么2021-2022年美国通胀下降时，失业率没有像传统菲利普斯曲线预测的那样上升？供给因素和锚定的通胀预期是否重塑了通胀与就业的关系？
AI.motivation: 传统菲利普斯曲线预测通胀下降需要以失业率上升为代价，但2021-2022年美国通胀回落时失业率保持低位，这一现象挑战了传统理论，需要重新审视通胀与就业的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重新评估菲利普斯曲线在供给驱动型通胀和可信通胀目标制度下的适用性，强调供给冲击、预期锚定和政策可信度在通胀-就业关系中的作用。
AI.method: 基于FRED的宏观经济数据，对通胀、工资增长、能源价格和失业率进行实证分析，测试通胀对劳动力市场条件的敏感性。
AI.findings: 供给冲击（主要是能源价格和供应链中断）是暂时的；美联储的沟通策略有效将通胀预期锚定在2%目标附近；通胀下降没有伴随传统模型预测的就业牺牲，表明菲利普斯曲线变平，预期锚定作用增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化菲利普斯曲线，强调供给冲击与需求冲击的区别，将预期管理和政策可信度纳入通胀动态模型，为理解现代通胀-就业关系提供新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济政策制定者提供指导：需要更好地区分供给型和需求型通胀，加强预期管理和政策可信度建设，实现通胀控制的同时保护就业。

title: The Paradoxical Philosophical Foundation of AI Large Models: Structural Dimensional Differences in Process Ontology

detail.title: The Paradoxical Philosophical Foundation of AI Large Models: Structural Dimensional Differences in Process Ontology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently without any commercial or institutional affiliations that might create a conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects. As a theoretical and philosophical analysis of artificial intelligence, no ethics approval was required. All case analyses (GPT-4, AlphaGo) are based on publicly available information and do not involve proprietary or sensitive data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as independent academic research without external financial support.

detail.abstract: This paper reconstructs the philosophical foundation of AI large models from the dual perspectives of process philosophy and agnosticism. Through a systematic review of three main paradigms in contemporary AI philosophy (functionalism, phenomenology, and extended mind thesis), the paper proposes a fourth paradigm-the "process-paradox" approach. The core argument consists of two parts: first, through the paradoxical structure of "fang si fang sheng" (方死方生, simultaneously dying and living), it demonstrates AI's ontological boundary-AI, being "deathless," is therefore "lifeless," and must forever be "born into" human mortality to obtain value anchorage; second, based on Whitehead's event ontology, it reveals the fundamental difference between AI and humans at the metaphysical level-AI processes the static patterns of "things," while humans experience the dynamic flux of "events," constituting AI's structural characteristic of being "forever one dimension less" than humans. Through specific case analyses of GPT-4 and AlphaGo, the paper argues that this dimensional difference is not a technical deficiency but an ontological necessity. The paper engages in dialogue with contemporary AI philosophers including Chalmers, Floridi, and Dennett, responds to possible objections, and integrates wisdom resources from Chinese philosophy (Zhuangzi, Zhongyong), ultimately proposing "xin an li de de zhi neng" (心安理得的智能, intelligence at peace with itself)-a human-machine collaborative ethics established on the foundation of acknowledging agnosticism.

AI.tldr: 本文从过程哲学与不可知论的双重视角重构AI大模型的哲学基础，提出"过程-悖论"新范式，论证AI因"不死"而"无生"，必须"降生"于人类有限性中才能获得价值锚定，并揭示AI处理静态"物"模式而人类体验动态"事"流变的维度差异。
AI.research_question: 如何从哲学基础层面重构AI大模型的本质？AI与人类在本体论和形而上学层面存在何种根本差异？
AI.motivation: 现有AI哲学三大范式（功能主义、现象学、延展心灵论）未能充分解释AI大模型的本质特征，需要建立新的哲学框架来理解AI与人类的根本差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过程哲学（怀特海事件本体论）、不可知论、庄子哲学（方死方生）、中庸思想，以及当代AI哲学（查尔莫斯、弗洛里迪、丹尼特等）。
AI.method: 哲学重构与理论分析：系统回顾现有AI哲学范式，提出"过程-悖论"新范式，通过概念分析和案例研究（GPT-4、AlphaGo）验证理论框架，并与当代哲学家对话。
AI.findings: 1. AI具有"方死方生"的悖论结构：因"不死"而"无生"，必须"降生"于人类有限性中；2. AI与人类存在维度差异：AI处理静态"物"模式，人类体验动态"事"流变，AI"永远少一维"；3. 这种差异不是技术缺陷而是本体必然性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI哲学的第四范式"过程-悖论"方法；2. 建立AI本体论边界理论；3. 揭示AI与人类的形而上学维度差异；4. 整合中西哲学资源构建新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"心安理得的智能"伦理框架，为人机协作建立基于承认不可知论的伦理基础，为AI发展提供哲学指导。

title: Energy intensity, renewable energy, and CO2 emissions in Polish Regions: evidence from a dynamic system GMM approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Energy intensity, renewable energy, and CO2 emissions in Polish Regions: evidence from a dynamic system GMM approach
detail.abstract: In the context of the European Green Deal, Polish regions are facing growing pressure to accelerate the energy transition and significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The energy intensity of the economy and strong dependence on fossil fuels make reducing CO2 emissions at the provincial level a particular challenge. The aim of this study is to identify the key factors determining CO2 emissions in 16 Polish provinces between 2006 and 2019. A dynamic panel model estimated using the systemic GMM method was applied, allowing for control of the inertia of emission processes, endogeneity, and structural diversity between regions. The analysis covers two sets of determinants related to both the structure of the economy and direct energy mechanisms. The results indicate strong CO2 emission persistence and the dominant role of energy intensity, which increases emissions in the short and long term. At the same time, a higher share of renewable energy and investments in air protection lead to lasting reduction effects. Evidence for a nonlinear relationship between income and emissions, consistent with the EKC hypothesis, is weak and statistically ambiguous. The results obtained emphasize the need to strengthen energy efficiency, develop renewable energy sources, and modernize high-emission sectors as key elements of regional decarbonization strategies. The proposed methodological approach can also be applied in analyses for other countries with a stable emissions structure and a diverse energy profile. The findings provide insights relevant not only for Poland but also for other carbon-intensive and structurally heterogeneous economies undergoing energy transition.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用动态面板模型分析波兰16个省份2006-2019年CO2排放的决定因素，发现能源强度是主要驱动因素，可再生能源份额和环保投资能有效减排，但环境库兹涅茨曲线假设的证据较弱。
AI.research_question: 波兰各省份CO2排放的关键决定因素是什么？这些因素在短期和长期内如何影响排放水平？
AI.motivation: 在欧盟绿色协议背景下，波兰面临能源转型压力。波兰经济能源强度高且严重依赖化石燃料，省级层面的减排挑战尤为突出，需要识别关键影响因素以制定有效区域脱碳策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）假设、能源经济学理论、区域发展理论、动态面板数据分析框架。
AI.method: 使用系统GMM方法估计的动态面板模型，分析波兰16个省份2006-2019年的面板数据。该方法能控制排放过程的惯性、内生性和区域结构异质性，涵盖经济结构和直接能源机制两组决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. CO2排放具有强持续性（惯性效应）；2. 能源强度是主要驱动因素，在短期和长期都增加排放；3. 可再生能源份额提高和空气保护投资能带来持续减排效果；4. 收入与排放的非线性关系（EKC假设）证据较弱且统计上模糊。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了能源强度在区域排放中的核心作用；2. 对EKC假设在波兰区域层面的适用性提出质疑；3. 提供了考虑排放惯性和区域异质性的动态分析方法；4. 丰富了能源转型背景下区域减排的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为波兰区域脱碳策略提供政策建议：加强能源效率、发展可再生能源、改造高排放行业；2. 提出的方法论可应用于其他排放结构稳定且能源结构多样的国家；3. 对碳密集型、结构异质的经济体能源转型具有参考价值。

title: Disparate Impacts of Teacher Certification Exams
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, Cornell University, Department of Economics and Cornell University

detail.title: Disparate Impacts of Teacher Certification Exams
detail.abstract:
We use Texas administrative data to assess the long-standing claim that teacher certification exams discriminate against underrepresented minority (URM) candidates. In a regression discontinuity design, we find that failing a certification exam delays entry into teaching and costs the average candidate $10,000 in forgone earnings. These costs fall disproportionately on URM candidates both because they are more likely to fail and because their earnings losses from failing are 50 percent larger on average. To examine whether these disparities are justified by racial/ethnic differences in teaching quality, we develop a new measure of disparate impact and estimate it using a policy change that increased the difficulty of Texas' elementary certification exam. The harder exam reduced the URM share of new teachers but had no significant benefits for teaching quality or student achievement. Taken together, our findings show that certification exams have a disparate impact in the sense that they impose much larger economic costs on URM teaching candidates than on white candidates with similar potential teaching quality.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用德克萨斯州行政数据发现，教师资格认证考试对少数族裔候选人存在不公平影响：他们不仅更可能考试失败，而且失败带来的经济损失比白人候选人高出50%。提高考试难度减少了少数族裔新教师比例，但对教学质量或学生成绩没有显著改善。
AI.research_question: 教师资格认证考试是否对少数族裔候选人存在歧视性影响？这些差异是否通过教学质量的种族/民族差异得到合理证明？
AI.motivation: 长期存在关于教师资格认证考试对少数族裔候选人存在歧视的争议，但缺乏实证证据。需要评估这些考试是否公平，以及考试难度变化对教师多样性和教学质量的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于回归断点设计分析考试通过/失败对职业进入和经济成本的影响；开发新的差异影响测量方法来评估考试难度变化对少数族裔教师比例和教学质量的影响。
AI.method: 使用德克萨斯州行政数据，采用回归断点设计分析考试失败对教师职业进入和经济成本的影响；利用德克萨斯州小学教师资格考试难度提高的政策变化，评估考试难度对少数族裔教师比例和教学质量的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 考试失败平均延迟教师职业进入，造成约10,000美元的收入损失；2) 少数族裔候选人更可能考试失败，且失败带来的经济损失比白人候选人平均高出50%；3) 提高考试难度减少了少数族裔新教师比例，但对教学质量或学生成绩没有显著改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了新的差异影响测量方法，为评估认证考试公平性提供了理论框架；提供了实证证据支持认证考试对少数族裔候选人存在不公平经济成本的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了关于教师资格认证考试改革的实证依据；建议重新评估考试标准以确保公平性同时不损害教学质量；对促进教师队伍多样性有重要政策启示。

title: Ants and Ant Colonies as Time-Resilient Distributed Intelligence: Implications for Human Civilization, Artificial Intelligence, and Interstellar Survival
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Ants and Ant Colonies as Time-Resilient Distributed Intelligence: Implications for Human Civilization, Artificial Intelligence, and Interstellar Survival
detail.abstract: Ant colonies represent one of the most enduring biological systems on Earth, persisting for over 140 million years through extreme environmental change. This paper proposes that ant colonies function as an in-built evolutionary technology: a distributed, self-correcting, and time-resilient intelligence system. By synthesizing insights from evolutionary biology, swarm intelligence, systems engineering, and futures studies, this paper argues that decoding ant colony principles can inform the design of resilient human institutions, aligned artificial intelligence systems, and sustainable interstellar civilizations.

AI.tldr: 蚂蚁群落作为内置的进化技术：一种分布式、自校正、时间弹性的智能系统，可为人类机构、AI系统和星际文明设计提供启示
AI.research_question: 蚂蚁群落如何作为内置的进化技术运作，以及其原理如何应用于设计人类机构、AI系统和星际文明？
AI.motivation: 蚂蚁群落已在地球上持续存在超过1.4亿年，经历了极端环境变化，这种持久性为设计弹性和可持续系统提供了宝贵启示
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化生物学、群体智能、系统工程学和未来研究的多学科理论框架
AI.method: 理论综合与分析，通过跨学科视角解码蚂蚁群落原理
AI.findings: 蚂蚁群落具有分布式、自校正和时间弹性的智能特征，可作为内置的进化技术模型
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"内置进化技术"概念框架，将生物系统原理与工程设计和未来研究相结合
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计弹性人类机构、对齐AI系统和可持续星际文明提供了具体的设计原则和启示

title: Machine Learning Meets Markowitz
affiliations: Tongji University - School of Economics and Management, Tsinghua University - PBC School of Finance, Duke University - Fuqua School of Business,  and New Jersey Institute of Technology

detail.title: Machine Learning Meets Markowitz
detail.abstract:
The standard approach to portfolio selection involves two stages: forecast the asset returns and then plug them into an optimizer. We argue that this separation is deeply problematic. The first stage treats cross-sectional prediction errors as equally important across all securities. However, given that final portfolios might differ given distinct risk preferences and investment restrictions, the standard approach fails to recognize that the investor is not just concerned with the average forecast error - but the precision of the forecasts for the specific assets that are most important for their portfolio. Hence, it is crucial to integrate the two stages. We propose a novel implementation utilizing machine learning tools that unifies the expected return generation process and the final optimized portfolio. Our empirical example provides convincing evidence that our end-to-end method outperforms the traditional two-stage approach. In our framework, each investor has their own, endogenously determined, efficient frontier that depends on risk preferences, investor-specific constraints, as well as exposure to market frictions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种端到端的投资组合选择方法，将资产收益预测和投资组合优化两个阶段统一起来，克服了传统两阶段方法中预测误差对所有证券同等对待的问题，为不同投资者生成内生的有效前沿。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个端到端的投资组合选择框架，将资产收益预测和投资组合优化统一起来，以解决传统两阶段方法中预测误差对所有证券同等对待的问题？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合选择采用两阶段方法：先预测资产收益，再将预测结果输入优化器。这种方法存在根本问题，因为第一阶段将横截面预测误差视为对所有证券同等重要，而实际上不同投资者由于风险偏好和投资限制不同，其最终投资组合关注的资产也不同。投资者关心的不是平均预测误差，而是对其投资组合最重要的特定资产的预测精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合理论、资产定价理论、机器学习理论、优化理论。论文挑战了传统两阶段分离方法的理论基础，提出了端到端统一框架的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用机器学习工具实现端到端方法，将预期收益生成过程和最终优化投资组合统一起来。通过实证研究验证方法的有效性。
AI.findings: 实证证据表明，提出的端到端方法优于传统的两阶段方法。在该框架下，每个投资者都有自己内生的有效前沿，该前沿取决于风险偏好、投资者特定约束以及市场摩擦暴露。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统投资组合选择的两阶段分离范式；2. 提出了端到端统一框架的理论基础；3. 引入了内生有效前沿的概念，该前沿取决于投资者特定因素；4. 将机器学习工具整合到投资组合理论中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了更优的投资组合选择方法；2. 考虑了投资者特定的风险偏好和约束；3. 提高了对投资组合最重要资产的预测精度；4. 为机构投资者提供了更个性化的投资解决方案。

title: Spatial variation in gasoline and diesel demand Evidence from Sweden
affiliations: Norwegian University of Life Sciences, NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science and NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science

detail.title: Spatial variation in gasoline and diesel demand Evidence from Sweden
detail.abstract: Reliable fuel demand forecasts are increasingly important as energy markets face volatility, policy pressures, and spatial disparities. We develop a nonlinear stochastic model for medium-term gasoline and diesel demand that incorporates regional heterogeneity using station-level data from Sweden. The model combines polynomial and trigonometric components with a two-component normal mixture for residual variation. It delivers strong predictive performance and reveals substantial heterogeneity across regions and retail formats. Urban markets show stable gasoline demand, while rural and highway stations are more price- and season-sensitive. The framework supports retailers’ procurement decisions and highlights the need for policies that account for spatial demand differences.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个非线性随机模型，用于预测瑞典汽油和柴油的中期需求，该模型结合了多项式、三角函数和正态混合分布，能够捕捉区域异质性，为零售商采购决策提供支持。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够捕捉区域异质性的非线性随机模型来预测汽油和柴油的中期需求？
AI.motivation: 能源市场面临波动性、政策压力和空间差异，可靠的燃料需求预测变得越来越重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性随机模型框架，结合多项式分量、三角函数分量和两分量正态混合分布来处理残差变异。
AI.method: 使用瑞典站点级数据开发非线性随机模型，模型包含多项式、三角函数分量和两分量正态混合分布，分析区域异质性。
AI.findings: 模型具有强大的预测性能，揭示了区域和零售形式之间的显著异质性：城市市场汽油需求稳定，而农村和高速公路站点对价格和季节更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个能够捕捉空间异质性的非线性随机需求预测模型，为能源需求预测提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持零售商的采购决策，强调政策制定需要考虑空间需求差异。

title: Valuation of Regulatory Risk on Pharmaceutical R&D
affiliations: Universidad Pontificia Comillas, Comillas Pontifical University and Simon Fraser University (SFU), University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Finance Area

detail.title: Valuation of Regulatory Risk on Pharmaceutical R&D
detail.abstract:
Geopolitical tensions, supply-chain concerns and policy risk have moved to the forefront of the pharmaceutical industry. This paper develops a real options valuation model of drug R&D that captures sequential clinical investment with technical failure, stochastic costs, uncertain cash flows, and optimal abandonment. We incorporate two regulatory shocks: a reduction in effective exclusivity period and a price-control shock that reduces net cash flows. Calibrating to an incremental CNS program, we find that project value at initiation is highly right-skewed: the mean is USD 69.6m but the median is negative, so expected value is driven by rare high-upside outcomes. Regulatory risk mainly compresses this upside. Both reductions in effective exclusivity and price-based interventions substantially weaken investment incentives, even when they occur with moderate probability. Value is strongly convex in exclusivity length, with the final years carrying the highest marginal value. We introduce iso-value maps that summarize how time-based and price-based policies substitute in their impact on project valuation, to clarify the trade-offs inherent in regulatory design: losing two years of exclusivity is comparable to roughly a 30% cash-flow contraction. Using a standard revenue-to-R&D elasticity, these valuation effects imply a 10% to 25% long-run contraction in investment. The framework provides a transparent mapping from policy design to project value and investment incentives.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个药物研发的实物期权估值模型，分析了监管风险（专利保护期缩短和价格控制）对项目价值和投资激励的影响。研究发现项目价值高度右偏，均值6900万美元但中位数为负，监管风险主要压缩了上行空间。两种监管冲击都会显著削弱投资激励，专利保护期的最后几年边际价值最高。
AI.research_question: 监管风险（专利保护期缩短和价格控制）如何影响药物研发项目的价值和投资激励？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张、供应链问题和政策风险已成为制药行业面临的主要挑战，需要量化分析监管政策变化对药物研发投资的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论，特别是序列投资决策、技术失败、随机成本、不确定现金流和最优放弃的估值模型。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含监管冲击的药物研发实物期权估值模型，校准到中枢神经系统（CNS）增量项目，使用等值图分析时间政策和价格政策的替代关系。
AI.findings: 项目价值高度右偏（均值6900万美元，中位数为负）；监管风险主要压缩上行空间；专利保护期缩短和价格控制都会显著削弱投资激励；专利保护期最后几年边际价值最高；失去两年专利保护期相当于约30%现金流收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管冲击纳入药物研发实物期权模型，提供了政策设计到项目价值的透明映射框架，引入等值图分析时间政策和价格政策的替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化工具来评估监管政策对药物研发投资的影响，预测10%-25%的长期投资收缩，帮助理解专利保护期和价格控制之间的权衡关系。

title: An Analytical Study on the Financial Performance of Public Sector Undertakings in Kerala
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Analytical Study on the Financial Performance of Public Sector Undertakings in Kerala

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest among the authors
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human involvement in the study
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding

detail.abstract: Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) in Kerala play an important role in the state's economic development, but their financial results are mixed, with some units remaining profitable while many are losing money and contributing less to the economy. The purpose of this study is to assess the financial performance of PSUs in Kerala using secondary data from 2017-18 to 2023-24. It used ratio analysis (covering liquidity, solvency, activity, and profitability ratios) and trend analysis. The research design is both descriptive and analytical in nature. The secondary data is derived from the Review of Public Enterprises and annual reports, which contain data from 131 PSUs in consolidated form. According to the study, the majority of Kerala's PSUs have low profitability, high leverage, and consistent liquidity over a given time period. According to the study, Kerala's PSUs have poor overall financial performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了2017-18至2023-24年间喀拉拉邦公共部门企业（PSUs）的财务绩效，发现大多数企业盈利能力低、杠杆率高、流动性稳定但整体财务表现不佳。
AI.research_question: 喀拉拉邦公共部门企业（PSUs）的财务绩效如何？
AI.motivation: 喀拉拉邦的公共部门企业在州经济发展中扮演重要角色，但其财务结果参差不齐：一些单位保持盈利，而许多单位亏损且对经济贡献较少，因此需要系统评估其财务表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务比率分析理论，包括流动性比率、偿债能力比率、活动比率和盈利能力比率，以及趋势分析理论。
AI.method: 使用描述性和分析性研究设计，采用比率分析（涵盖流动性、偿债能力、活动性和盈利能力比率）和趋势分析，数据来源于《公共企业回顾》和年度报告中的131家PSUs的合并数据（2017-18至2023-24年）。
AI.findings: 研究发现，喀拉拉邦大多数PSUs具有低盈利能力、高杠杆率，以及在特定时间段内保持一致的流动性，整体财务表现不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共部门企业财务绩效评估提供了实证案例，验证了财务比率分析框架在评估PSUs绩效中的适用性，丰富了发展中国家公共企业治理的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喀拉拉邦政府提供了PSUs财务健康状况的全面评估，识别了盈利能力低和杠杆率高等关键问题，为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了改进财务管理的依据，有助于提升公共部门企业的经济贡献。

title: Expanding Paternity Leave: Effects on Beliefs, Norms, and Gender Gaps
affiliations: Princeton University - Princeton School of Public and International Affairs, London School of Economics, WZB Berlin Social Science Center, Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics, University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics, Copenhagen Business School and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Expanding Paternity Leave: Effects on Beliefs, Norms, and Gender Gaps
detail.abstract:
We study whether policy can shift gendered beliefs, norms, and labor market outcomes by exploiting a major expansion of earmarked paternity leave in Denmark. The reform generated large first-stage effects, substantially reallocating leave from mothers to fathers. Using a regression discontinuity design combined with new survey data linked to administrative records, we show that the reform makes parents more supportive of paternity leave, shifts gender-role beliefs in a progressive direction, and reduces perceived differences in childcare ability. The reform also narrows gender gaps in earnings and hours worked. The earnings gap falls by 33pp in the first year following childbirth (during leave) and by 2.8pp in the second year (after leave). These results demonstrate that policy can meaningfully influence beliefs, norms, and gender inequality. On the other hand, earmarking restricts families’ ability to allocate leave freely and lowers leave satisfaction, highlighting a central trade-off inherent in paternalistic policies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 丹麦一项专门陪产假政策改革显著改变了父母的性别观念、减少了性别收入差距，但同时也限制了家庭休假安排的灵活性并降低了满意度，揭示了家长式政策的权衡取舍。
AI.research_question: 政策能否改变性别观念、社会规范和劳动力市场结果？专门陪产假政策如何影响父母的性别角色信念、育儿能力认知以及性别收入差距？
AI.motivation: 理解政策干预在塑造性别观念和减少性别不平等方面的作用，特别是专门陪产假政策对家庭内部休假分配、性别角色认知和劳动力市场结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别角色理论、社会规范理论、政策干预理论、劳动力市场性别差距理论、家庭经济学理论。
AI.method: 利用丹麦专门陪产假扩张的自然实验，采用断点回归设计（RDD），结合新的调查数据与行政记录进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 改革使父母更支持陪产假，性别角色观念向进步方向转变，减少了育儿能力感知差异；2. 缩小了性别收入差距和工作时长差距：产后第一年（休假期间）收入差距减少33个百分点，第二年（休假后）减少2.8个百分点；3. 但专门休假限制了家庭自由分配休假的能力，降低了休假满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了政策能够显著影响性别观念和社会规范，为政策干预改变性别不平等提供了实证证据，揭示了家长式政策在促进平等与限制自由之间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计性别平等政策提供了实证依据，表明专门陪产假能有效促进性别平等，但需考虑家庭自主权与满意度之间的平衡。

title: Intellinomics and the Reconfiguration of Global Power Davos 2026 and the Rise of Strategic Economies A Geo-Economic Scenario Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Intellinomics and the Reconfiguration of Global Power Davos 2026 and the Rise of Strategic Economies A Geo-Economic Scenario Analysis
detail.abstract: The global economic system is undergoing a profound structural transformation driven by escalating geopolitical fragmentation, technological disruption, industrial re-shoring, and the rapid rise of artificial intelligence, generating unprecedented levels of volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity (VUCA). Davos 2026 marked a critical inflection point in this transformation, signaling a decisive shift away from the classical globalization paradigm toward a new strategic economic order grounded in sovereignty, resilience, industrial security, and technological dominance. This paper introduces Intellinomics as a foundational analytical framework that reconceptualises intelligence, data, and artificial intelligence as sovereign factors of production and core determinants of geopolitical power.
