By integrating geo-economic analysis with strategic scenario modeling, the study examines how economic statecraft, tariff weaponisation, and technological rivalry are reshaping global production networks, trade governance, and national development trajectories. Through a comparative scenario analysis of three representative middle economies-Oman, Jordan, and Morocco-the paper demonstrates how differentiated strategic choices under VUCA conditions generate sharply divergent pathways, ranging from structural dependency and strategic marginalization to geo-economic elevation and sovereign resilience. The study ultimately offers a comprehensive conceptual and policy framework for decision-makers seeking to navigate systemic uncertainty, technological competition, and geopolitical realignment while safeguarding economic sovereignty and long-term strategic positioning in the post-globalization era.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"智能经济学"框架，将智能、数据和AI重新概念化为主权生产要素和地缘政治权力的核心决定因素，分析后全球化时代经济国家主义、关税武器化和技术竞争如何重塑全球生产网络。
AI.research_question: 在VUCA（波动性、不确定性、复杂性、模糊性）环境下，中等经济体如何通过差异化战略选择应对地缘政治碎片化、技术颠覆和工业回流，实现从结构性依赖到主权韧性的不同发展路径？
AI.motivation: 全球经济体系正经历深刻结构性转型，地缘政治碎片化、技术颠覆、工业回流和AI崛起导致前所未有的VUCA环境，达沃斯2026标志着从经典全球化范式向基于主权、韧性、工业安全和技术主导的新战略经济秩序的决定性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能经济学（Intellinomics）作为基础分析框架，将智能、数据和人工智能重新概念化为主权生产要素和地缘政治权力的核心决定因素，整合地缘经济分析和战略情景建模。
AI.method: 通过比较情景分析，研究阿曼、约旦和摩洛哥三个代表性中等经济体在VUCA条件下的差异化战略选择及其发展路径。
AI.findings: 不同战略选择导致截然不同的发展路径：从结构性依赖和战略边缘化到地缘经济提升和主权韧性。研究展示了中等经济体如何在VUCA环境中通过差异化战略实现不同发展结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"智能经济学"作为新分析框架；2. 将智能、数据和AI重新概念化为主权生产要素；3. 整合地缘经济分析与战略情景建模；4. 为后全球化时代的经济战略提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供全面的概念和政策框架，帮助他们在系统性不确定性、技术竞争和地缘政治重组中导航，同时保障经济主权和长期战略定位，特别是在中等经济体的发展战略选择方面。

title: Why the Right is Wrong about Muslim Mayors
affiliations: Catholic Theological Union, Chicago

detail.title: Why the Right is Wrong about Muslim Mayors
detail.abstract:
This article examines the rise of Muslim-identified mayors in major Western cities not as a question of religion or identity politics, but as a structural transformation in urban governance. It challenges right-wing narratives that frame these leaders as symbols of cultural or religious “infiltration” and instead situates their popularity within a broader crisis of neoliberal urbanism. By contrasting the “CEO-mayor” model—where cities are treated as luxury products—with an emerging governance style rooted in presence, accessibility, and everyday problem-solving, the article argues that voters are responding to material dignity rather than symbolic identity.

Conceptually, the article develops the notion of moral urbanism, defined as an approach to city governance that prioritizes human dignity, public accessibility, and ethical responsibility over growth metrics and profit maximization. Through illustrative cases such as public transportation, housing, and environmental policy, it shows how technocratic efficiency can be mobilized for social justice rather than market extraction. The study contributes to debates on urban leadership, post-neoliberal governance, and religion in the public sphere by demonstrating that faith, when translated into an ethics of service rather than imposition, can coexist with—and even strengthen—rational, modern urban management.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了西方大城市穆斯林市长的崛起，认为这不是宗教或身份政治问题，而是城市治理的结构性转变。文章挑战了右翼叙事，将这些领导人置于新自由主义城市治理危机的背景下，提出了"道德城市主义"的概念，强调尊严、可及性和伦理责任而非增长指标。
AI.research_question: 为什么西方大城市的穆斯林市长越来越受欢迎？这是否反映了城市治理模式的根本转变？
AI.motivation: 挑战右翼将穆斯林市长视为文化或宗教"渗透"的叙事，揭示这些领导人受欢迎背后的结构性原因，特别是新自由主义城市治理危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义城市主义、CEO市长模式、道德城市主义、后新自由主义治理、城市领导力理论。
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究（公共交通、住房、环境政策等）、对比分析（CEO市长模式 vs 新兴治理风格）。
AI.findings: 选民支持穆斯林市长是基于物质尊严而非象征性身份；技术官僚效率可以服务于社会正义而非市场榨取；信仰转化为服务伦理而非强加时，可以与理性现代城市管理共存并加强。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了"道德城市主义"概念；挑战了宗教与城市治理的对立观点；为后新自由主义治理理论提供了新视角；重新定义了城市领导力的评价标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市治理者提供了基于尊严和可及性的治理模式；展示了技术官僚工具如何用于社会正义；为多元宗教背景下的城市管理提供了实践指导。

title: Loan Sharks and Illegal Money Lending in Social Media
affiliations: and Tartu University

detail.title: Loan Sharks and Illegal Money Lending in Social Media

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Consent was obtained from interviewed participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded by Estonian Ministry of Finance grant LSVJS21210 "Credit market research for the Ministry of Finance II"

detail.abstract: We uncover a novel, illegal credit market on social media where loan sharks offer digital loans. The study is based on semi-structured interviews with twelve lendees and five lenders from an Estonian social media loan market in Facebook, and five debt councillors experienced in assisting clients with such loans. We also include observations of post history in the loan groups. The results indicate that the market publicly and openly offers illegal, high-interest loans to otherwise financially excluded individuals. Consumers are unaware that they are not under a legal obligation to pay the exorbitant fees, but they do so due to the use of various punishment and intimidation methods applied by the lenders. The study informs national institutions and policymakers about new digital developments in lending and guides regulation efforts to protect vulnerable borrowers.

AI.tldr: 研究发现社交媒体上存在新型非法信贷市场，贷款鲨鱼通过Facebook等平台向被金融排斥的群体提供高利贷。借款人因不了解法律保护且受到威胁恐吓而支付高额费用。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体上的非法数字贷款市场如何运作？借款人为何会支付非法高额费用？这种市场对金融排斥群体有何影响？
AI.motivation: 揭示社交媒体上新兴的非法信贷市场现象，了解数字技术如何被用于非法高利贷活动，为保护弱势借款人提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融排斥理论、非法信贷市场理论、数字平台经济学、行为经济学中的威胁与恐吓机制
AI.method: 半结构化访谈（12名借款人+5名贷款人+5名债务顾问）+爱沙尼亚Facebook贷款群组的帖子历史观察
AI.findings: 1. 市场公开向金融排斥群体提供非法高息贷款；2. 借款人不知晓无需支付过高费用的法律权利；3. 贷款人使用惩罚和恐吓手段迫使还款；4. 社交媒体平台成为非法信贷的新渠道
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字时代非法信贷市场理论，揭示了社交媒体平台在金融排斥中的作用，丰富了威胁机制在非法信贷中的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国家机构和政策制定者提供数字借贷新发展的信息；2. 指导监管工作保护弱势借款人；3. 提高公众对非法数字贷款的认识；4. 为执法机构打击社交媒体非法信贷提供依据

title: How Do Macroprudential Measures Affect Mortgage Lending Standards? Evidence from the ECB’s Bank Lending Survey
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: How Do Macroprudential Measures Affect Mortgage Lending Standards? Evidence from the ECB’s Bank Lending Survey
detail.abstract: Using information from the ECB’s Bank Lending Survey, we examine how the implementation of borrower-based macroprudential measures (BBMs) between 2009-Q1 and 2023-Q3 affected mortgage lending standards in a sample of 15 euro area countries. We find that banks generally tightened credit standards around the implementation of BBMs, with the strongest effect occurring contemporaneously. Such tightening of credit standards is observed for different types of BBMs, including limits on loan-to-value or debt-service-to-income ratios and maturities. We also find mild evidence that legally binding measures imply a stronger tightening of credit standards than measures in the form of non-binding recommendations. Finally, this tightening is more pronounced in cases where mortgage loan growth or real estate price growth is high, consistent with BBMs effectively smoothing the credit cycle.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用欧洲央行银行贷款调查数据，分析了2009-2023年间欧元区15国实施的借款人宏观审慎措施对抵押贷款标准的影响，发现这些措施普遍导致银行收紧信贷标准，且效果在实施时最强。
AI.research_question: 借款人宏观审慎措施（BBMs）的实施如何影响欧元区银行的抵押贷款信贷标准？
AI.motivation: 理解宏观审慎政策工具（特别是针对借款人的措施）在实际操作中对银行信贷行为的影响，评估这些政策在平滑信贷周期方面的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎政策理论、信贷周期理论、银行信贷行为理论
AI.method: 使用欧洲央行银行贷款调查（BLS）的季度数据，覆盖2009年第一季度至2023年第三季度欧元区15个国家，采用计量经济学方法分析借款人宏观审慎措施实施与银行信贷标准变化之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 银行在借款人宏观审慎措施实施期间普遍收紧信贷标准，最强效应发生在实施当期；2. 不同类型措施（如贷款价值比、债务收入比、期限限制）都产生类似效果；3. 具有法律约束力的措施比非约束性建议产生更强的收紧效应；4. 在抵押贷款增长或房地产价格增长较高的情况下，收紧效应更加明显，符合平滑信贷周期的目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为宏观审慎政策有效性提供了实证证据，深化了对借款人导向措施作用机制的理解，验证了政策工具在信贷周期管理中的实际效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计有效的宏观审慎工具提供实证依据，帮助监管机构了解不同类型措施的实际影响，为实施时机和力度选择提供参考。

title: A least-squares filter for sequence-space models

detail.title: A least-squares filter for sequence-space models
detail.abstract: Sequence-space models are becoming increasingly popular in macroeconomics, especially in the heterogeneous-agent literature. However, the econometric toolkit for users of these models remains less developed than that available for traditional state-space methods. This note introduces an algorithm for efficiently filtering unobserved shocks in linear sequence-space models. The proposed filter solves a least-squares optimization problem in closed form and returns the expectation of unobserved shocks conditional on observed data. It handles heteroskedasticity, missing observations, measurement error, and non- Gaussian shock distributions. To illustrate its properties, I apply it to data simulated from a medium-scale heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model and show that it accurately recovers the underlying structural shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于线性序列空间模型的高效滤波算法，通过最小二乘优化闭式解来估计未观测冲击的条件期望，能够处理异方差、缺失观测、测量误差和非高斯冲击分布。
AI.research_question: 如何在序列空间模型中高效地滤波未观测的结构性冲击？
AI.motivation: 序列空间模型在宏观经济学中日益流行，特别是异质性主体文献中，但这些模型的计量工具包相比传统状态空间方法仍不够成熟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序列空间模型、线性滤波理论、最小二乘优化、条件期望估计
AI.method: 提出一种基于最小二乘优化的闭式解滤波算法，通过求解条件期望问题来估计未观测冲击
AI.findings: 算法能够准确恢复中规模异质性主体新凯恩斯模型模拟数据中的基础结构性冲击
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了序列空间模型的计量工具包，扩展了线性滤波理论在异质性主体模型中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济学研究者提供了处理异方差、缺失观测、测量误差和非高斯冲击的实用滤波工具

title: Slow Urbanism: Reclaiming the Landscape Erased by Speed
affiliations: Catholic Theological Union, Chicago

detail.title: Slow Urbanism: Reclaiming the Landscape Erased by Speed
detail.abstract: This article explores how speed reshapes not only our experience of cities, but also our relationship with memory, attention, and place. Drawing on Milan Kundera’s philosophy of slowness, the essay examines speed as a cultural and technological condition that erases landscape, compresses time, and transforms cities into mere corridors of movement rather than spaces of encounter. Through literary reflection, visual culture, and urban experience, the article argues that acceleration does not simply improve efficiency; it actively weakens our capacity to remember, dwell, and meaningfully inhabit urban life. Positioned within debates on slow urbanism and everyday urban ethics, the article proposes slowness as a mode of urban perception rather than a nostalgic retreat from modernity. It suggests that slowing down—walking, lingering, observing—allows cities to re-emerge as lived spaces where memory, social interaction, and moral responsibility can take root. By reframing speed as an existential and spatial issue, the article contributes to interdisciplinary discussions across urban studies, cultural theory, and philosophy, offering a reflective critique of contemporary urban life shaped by acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨速度如何重塑城市体验及我们与记忆、注意力和场所的关系，基于昆德拉的慢速哲学，分析速度作为文化技术条件如何抹去景观、压缩时间，将城市变为移动通道而非相遇空间，主张慢速作为城市感知模式而非对现代性的怀旧逃避。
AI.research_question: 速度如何重塑城市体验、记忆、注意力和场所关系？慢速作为城市感知模式能否对抗加速对城市生活的侵蚀？
AI.motivation: 当代城市生活被加速逻辑主导，速度不仅改变物理移动，更深刻影响我们的感知、记忆和城市体验方式，需要从文化哲学角度反思速度对城市生活的深层影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 米兰·昆德拉的慢速哲学、慢速城市主义理论、日常城市伦理学、文化理论和空间哲学。
AI.method: 文学反思、视觉文化分析和城市体验研究相结合的质性研究方法。
AI.findings: 速度作为文化技术条件会抹去景观、压缩时间，将城市转变为移动通道而非相遇空间，削弱记忆能力、居住能力和有意义地栖居城市生活的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将速度重新框架为存在主义和空间问题，为城市研究、文化理论和哲学提供跨学科对话；提出慢速作为城市感知模式而非怀旧逃避的理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慢速城市主义实践提供理论基础，倡导行走、停留、观察等慢速实践，帮助城市重新成为记忆、社会互动和道德责任扎根的生活空间。

title: Who Fails When Schools Fail? Practical Solutions To Nigeria's Public Education Crisis By Divine-Mercy Abioye

detail.title: Who Fails When Schools Fail? Practical Solutions To Nigeria's Public Education Crisis By Divine-Mercy Abioye
detail.abstract:
This essay examines the persistent crisis in Nigeria’s public education system, highlighting its implications for national development, social equality and human capital formation. Despite its recognized role as a driver of economic growth, civic responsibility and personal empowerment, Nigeria’s public schools face systemic challenges including chronic underfunding, inadequate infrastructure, teacher shortages, policy inconsistency, corruption and insecurity. These deficiencies have resulted in overcrowded classrooms, declining learning outcomes and over ten million out-of-school children, exacerbating inequality and limiting opportunities for social mobility. 

The study situates the failure of schools within a broader societal context, exploring how educational neglect reflects a collective failure of government, communities and stakeholders. With empirical reports and international benchmarks, the essay proposes practical solutions to address the crisis, including increased and transparent funding, curriculum modernization, teacher training and motivation, public-private partnerships and the integration of digital technologies. By outlining actionable reforms, this work underscores the urgent need for a coordinated, holistic approach to revitalize Nigeria’s public education sector and secure its developmental future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨尼日利亚公共教育系统的持续危机，分析其对国家发展、社会平等和人力资本形成的影响，并提出包括增加透明资金、课程现代化、教师培训、公私合作和数字技术整合在内的实际解决方案。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚公共教育系统面临哪些系统性挑战？这些挑战如何影响国家发展、社会平等和人力资本形成？如何通过协调、整体的改革方法解决这一危机？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚公共教育系统虽然被公认为经济增长、公民责任和个人赋能的驱动力，但面临严重的系统性挑战，导致教育质量下降、不平等加剧，阻碍了国家发展和社会流动机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究将教育系统失败置于更广泛的社会背景下，探讨教育忽视如何反映政府、社区和利益相关者的集体失败，强调教育作为社会流动和国家发展引擎的理论作用。
AI.method: 采用实证报告和国际基准分析，结合文献综述和现状评估，提出基于证据的实际解决方案。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚公共教育系统面临慢性资金不足、基础设施不足、教师短缺、政策不一致、腐败和不安全等系统性挑战，导致教室拥挤、学习成果下降、超过1000万儿童失学，加剧了不平等并限制了社会流动机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 将教育系统失败理论化为社会集体责任的反映，强调教育危机不仅是技术问题，更是治理和社会承诺的失败，为理解发展中国家教育系统崩溃提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体可行的改革方案：增加透明资金、课程现代化、教师培训与激励、公私合作伙伴关系、数字技术整合，为尼日利亚教育系统振兴提供了可操作的路线图。

title: Overcoming Judgment-Proofness: The Law & Economics of Insuring and Mitigating AI Risk
affiliations: Touro University - Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center

detail.title: Overcoming Judgment-Proofness: The Law & Economics of Insuring and Mitigating AI Risk
detail.abstract: Traditional tort liability struggles to discipline catastrophic risks: once losses exceed assets and insurance, judgment-proofness leaves deterrence empty. Yet strong ex ante regulation of frontier AI is equally elusive-too uncertain, fastmoving, and contested to design and implement in advance. In earlier work, I proposed a framework that combines strict liability, mandatory insurance, and novel punitive damages to bridge this divide. This paper shows how that framework can be translated into practice within existing legal doctrine. The design pairs risk-weighted insurance with calibrated punitive damages. Insurance is priced against clear metrics-compute, capability, and deploymentand reinforced with binding covenants. This structure positions insurers as private watchdogs, pressing developers toward safer practices without freezing technical standards. Punitive damages then address the risks insurers cannot. Awards mirror expected catastrophic loss and are shared according to responsibility, while judicial discretion is bounded by Daubert standards, a clear-and-convincing burden, and due-process limits under State Farm. This is the first account to show how the legal system can price catastrophic AI risk. And the stakes are existential-AI's gravest risks will remain ungoverned if they remain unpriced.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合严格责任、强制保险和惩罚性赔偿的法律框架，为灾难性AI风险定价，解决传统侵权责任和事前监管的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何将严格责任、强制保险和惩罚性赔偿的法律框架转化为实践，为灾难性AI风险定价？
AI.motivation: 传统侵权责任无法约束灾难性风险（当损失超过资产和保险时），而事前监管又因不确定性、快速变化和争议而难以实施，需要新的法律机制来管理前沿AI的灾难性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合严格责任、强制保险和惩罚性赔偿的法律框架；风险加权保险；惩罚性赔偿的校准机制；私人监督理论（保险公司作为监督者）。
AI.method: 法律分析框架：将理论框架转化为实践操作，包括保险定价基于明确指标（计算能力、能力和部署）、约束性契约、惩罚性赔偿计算（反映预期灾难性损失）、司法裁量限制（Daubert标准、明确且有说服力的举证责任、State Farm案的正当程序限制）。
AI.findings: 该框架可在现有法律原则内实施：风险加权保险让保险公司成为私人监督者，推动开发者采取更安全实践；惩罚性赔偿处理保险无法覆盖的风险；司法裁量可通过现有标准加以限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次展示了法律体系如何为灾难性AI风险定价；提出了将严格责任、强制保险和惩罚性赔偿结合的可操作框架；发展了保险公司作为私人监督者的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了实施灾难性AI风险管理的具体方案；为保险公司提供了定价和风险评估框架；为开发者提供了明确的安全实践激励；为司法系统提供了处理AI灾难性风险的判案标准。

title: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-009, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.009]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We examine prospective classification of crypto currencies risks within the ISDA Standardized Initial Margin Model (SIMM) framework for calculation of initial margin on trades sensitive to cryptocurrencies’ risk factors in the uncleared market. Consistent with the view that cryptocurrencies are digital assets that fundamentally rely on distributed ledger technology (DLT) and induce financial risks that are significantly different from those in traditional risk classes like commodities or FX, we find that cryptocurrencies are best classified into a distinct risk class within SIMM that is split into two buckets – pegged and floating (unpegged) crypto currencies as risk factors - and suggest risk weights’ calibration methodology within the cryptocurrencies risk class that is consistent with the existing approaches adopted in SIMM.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在ISDA标准化初始保证金模型(SIMM)框架下对加密货币风险进行前瞻性分类，建议将加密货币作为独立风险类别，并分为锚定币和浮动币两个子类别，同时提出与SIMM现有方法一致的风险权重校准方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在ISDA标准化初始保证金模型(SIMM)框架下对加密货币风险进行适当分类和校准？
AI.motivation: 加密货币作为依赖分布式账本技术的数字资产，其金融风险与传统商品或外汇等风险类别显著不同，需要在未清算市场的交易初始保证金计算中建立适当的风险分类框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISDA标准化初始保证金模型(SIMM)框架、加密货币作为数字资产的风险特性理论、分布式账本技术对金融风险的影响。
AI.method: 基于加密货币风险特性的分析框架，在SIMM框架内进行风险分类和校准方法设计。
AI.findings: 加密货币最适合在SIMM中划分为独立风险类别，并进一步分为锚定币和浮动币两个子类别，需要专门的风险权重校准方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了SIMM框架的风险分类理论，为加密货币这一新兴资产类别提供了系统的风险管理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构在未清算市场进行加密货币相关交易的初始保证金计算提供了实用的分类和校准方法，有助于规范加密货币风险管理实践。

title: Mechanism Design for Harm Reduction: Game Theory and Social Choice for Carceral MOUD and Recovery Housing
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title: Mechanism Design for Harm Reduction: Game Theory and Social Choice for Carceral MOUD and Recovery Housing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Individuals released from jails and prisons face extremely high risks of fatal overdose and reincarceration, yet many jurisdictions continue to underprovide medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD), recovery housing, and supervised consumption services. At the same time, recovery residences and diversion courts are expanding without a clear framework for institutional design. This paper develops a mechanism-design model of harm-reduction policy at the interface of criminal justice and community treatment. A public funder chooses a funding regime and certification rules, diversion judges set the stringency of supervision and treatment conditions, recovery residence providers decide whether to operate abstinence-only or MOUDinclusive housing, and high-risk individuals choose whether to comply or relapse. The model yields a punitive equilibrium, supported by abstinence-only funding and strict conditions, and a harm-reduction equilibrium under MOUD-inclusive funding and flexible conditions. Using effect sizes from Rhode Island's statewide corrections MOUD program, Massachusetts' jailbased MOUD pilots, and recent recovery housing evaluations, we show that the harm-reduction equilibrium is Pareto-superior for funders, judges, providers, and high-severity residents, yet the punitive equilibrium can remain risk-dominant because of political and informational frictions. We then embed the game in a computational social choice framework: stakeholders hold multidimensional preferences over policy bundles-combinations of funding rules, certification standards, diversion guidelines, and overdose prevention interventions such as supervised consumption sites-and social choice is constrained by justice-based requirements that rule out policies generating avoidable lethal risk or systematic exclusion of MOUD patients from housing and treatment. The analysis characterizes which harm-reduction mechanisms are implementable as equilibrium outcomes of the institutional game while respecting these constrained social preferences, and it identifies simple instruments-MOUD-inclusive funding commitments, performance-based transparency, and structured diversion defaults-that can move jurisdictions from punitive to harm-reduction equilibria within existing legal constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个机制设计模型，分析刑事司法与社区治疗交叉领域的减害政策。模型识别出惩罚性均衡（基于禁欲资助和严格条件）和减害均衡（基于MOUD包容性资助和灵活条件）。研究表明减害均衡对各方都是帕累托更优的，但由于政治和信息摩擦，惩罚性均衡可能保持风险主导。研究还确定了在现有法律约束下推动司法管辖区从惩罚性均衡转向减害均衡的简单工具。
AI.research_question: 在刑事司法与社区治疗交叉领域，如何设计减害政策机制，以平衡各方利益并实现帕累托更优的结果？具体而言，哪些政策组合（资助规则、认证标准、分流指南和过量预防干预措施）能够在尊重社会偏好的约束下，作为制度博弈的均衡结果实施？
AI.motivation: 从监狱和拘留所释放的个人面临极高的致命过量用药和再次监禁风险，但许多司法管辖区仍然不足量提供阿片类药物使用障碍（MOUD）药物、康复住房和监督消费服务。同时，康复住所和分流法庭在没有明确制度设计框架的情况下不断扩大。这种制度设计空白需要理论框架来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、博弈论、计算社会选择理论。论文构建了一个多主体博弈模型，包括公共资助者、分流法官、康复住房提供者和高风险个体，分析不同政策选择下的均衡结果。
AI.method: 机制设计模型构建与博弈分析，结合实证效应大小（来自罗德岛州全州矫正MOUD项目、马萨诸塞州拘留所MOUD试点和近期康复住房评估），并嵌入计算社会选择框架分析多维政策偏好。
AI.findings: 模型识别出两种均衡：惩罚性均衡（由禁欲资助和严格条件支持）和减害均衡（在MOUD包容性资助和灵活条件下）。减害均衡对资助者、法官、提供者和高严重程度居民都是帕累托更优的，但由于政治和信息摩擦，惩罚性均衡可能保持风险主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为刑事司法与社区治疗交叉领域的减害政策提供了首个机制设计框架；2）将制度博弈嵌入计算社会选择框架，分析多维政策偏好下的社会选择；3）识别了在尊重基于正义的约束条件下可实施的减害机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 确定了推动司法管辖区从惩罚性均衡转向减害均衡的简单工具：MOUD包容性资助承诺、基于绩效的透明度机制和结构化的分流默认设置。这些工具可在现有法律约束下实施，帮助政策制定者设计更有效的减害政策。

title: Financing the Imbalance: Capital Inflows and India's Currency Stability

detail.title: Financing the Imbalance: Capital Inflows and India's Currency Stability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required for this study, as it does not involve human participants or primary data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of capital inflows in sustaining India's external balance and currency stability over time. Building on a structural Balance of Payments perspective, it argues that while capital inflows such as foreign direct investment and portfolio flows help finance persistent current account imbalances, they do not necessarily resolve the underlying sources of external pressure. Periods of relative currency stability are often maintained through external financing rather than changes in export structure or foreign exchange generation. By analysing the composition and behaviour of capital inflows, this paper highlights how reliance on volatile external financing can support short-term stability while leaving longer-term vulnerabilities intact. The analysis is descriptive and analytical in nature, focusing on external financing dynamics rather than policy prescription.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了资本流入在维持印度外部平衡和汇率稳定中的作用，指出虽然资本流入（如FDI和证券投资）能够为持续的经常账户赤字融资，但并未解决外部压力的根本来源，短期稳定依赖外部融资而长期脆弱性依然存在。
AI.research_question: 资本流入在维持印度外部平衡和汇率稳定中扮演什么角色？资本流入如何影响印度的外部脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 印度长期面临经常账户赤字，依赖资本流入维持外部平衡，但资本流入的波动性和构成可能影响汇率稳定和外部脆弱性，需要深入分析这种依赖关系的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构性国际收支平衡理论，分析资本流入与经常账户失衡的关系，关注外部融资与汇率稳定的动态关系。
AI.method: 描述性和分析性方法，分析资本流入的构成和行为特征，关注外部融资动态而非政策建议。
AI.findings: 资本流入（如FDI和证券投资）能够为持续经常账户赤字融资，但并未解决外部压力的根本来源；汇率稳定期往往通过外部融资维持，而非出口结构变化或外汇创造；依赖波动性外部融资可支持短期稳定，但长期脆弱性依然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 从结构性国际收支视角深化了对资本流入作用的理解，区分了短期融资功能与长期结构调整需求，为理解新兴市场外部脆弱性提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了关于依赖资本流入维持外部平衡的风险警示，强调需要关注出口结构转型和外汇创造能力，而非仅仅依赖外部融资。

title: Robots and Migrants: Evidence from China's Industrial Policy
affiliations: South China Normal University, Zhejiang University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Economics and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Robots and Migrants: Evidence from China's Industrial Policy
detail.abstract: Many countries are aggressively pursuing automation, with governments playing a key role through industrial policy. We examine the labor market effects of governmentdriven automation by exploiting the staggered rollout of industrial robot promotion policies across Chinese cities. We show that the arrival of the policies accelerates inflows of migrant workers performing non-routine tasks, with little response among routine-task migrants. These effects are particularly pronounced for young and middle-aged workers and display minimal gender differences. To shed light on the underlying mechanisms, we show that labor reallocation is accompanied by increases in firm productivity and profitability, alongside greater entry in non-routineintensive industries. These results suggest that government-driven automation policies are reshaping the spatial distribution of labor through their effects on firms.

AI.tldr: 政府驱动的自动化政策加速了从事非例行任务移民工人的流入，但对从事例行任务的移民工人影响不大，这些政策通过提高企业生产力和盈利能力重塑了劳动力空间分布。
AI.research_question: 政府驱动的自动化政策对劳动力市场有何影响？特别是对中国城市工业机器人推广政策的劳动力市场效应进行研究。
AI.motivation: 许多国家积极追求自动化，政府在产业政策中发挥关键作用，但政府驱动的自动化政策对劳动力市场的具体影响尚不清楚，需要实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自动化与劳动力市场关系的理论框架，特别是关于例行任务与非例行任务的技术替代理论，以及政府产业政策对劳动力空间分布的影响理论。
AI.method: 利用中国城市工业机器人推广政策的交错推出作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID）等因果推断方法分析政策对劳动力市场的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 政策加速了从事非例行任务的移民工人流入，但对从事例行任务的移民工人影响不大；2. 效应在年轻和中龄工人中尤为明显，性别差异很小；3. 劳动力重新配置伴随着企业生产力和盈利能力的提高；4. 非例行密集型行业的进入增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为政府驱动的自动化政策对劳动力市场的因果效应提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了自动化政策对劳动力空间分布的重新配置机制；3. 丰富了产业政策与劳动力市场互动关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计自动化政策提供参考；2. 帮助企业理解自动化对劳动力需求的影响；3. 为工人职业规划和技能发展提供指导；4. 为城市劳动力市场政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Structural Immunity: How Platform Dominance and Mandatory Arbitration Create Corporate Impunity
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structural Immunity: How Platform Dominance and Mandatory Arbitration Create Corporate Impunity
detail.abstract: When platform market dominance combines with pre-dispute mandatory arbitration, the result is structural immunity: a collapse in conversion rates across the dispute pipeline such that systematic, low-dollar harms become non-justiciable regardless of merit. The primary mechanism is claim suppression-disputes eliminated before they become legal events. The secondary mechanism is outcome skew-for claims surviving to filing, repeat-player dynamics and procedural constraints tilt results. This paper develops the structural immunity framework by synthesizing legal doctrine, empirical arbitration research, and organizational selection theory. The framework predicts filing rates far below harm prevalence, repeat-player advantages persisting after controls for observed case characteristics, and systematic pattern-recognition failures. Available evidence is consistent with these predictions, subject to measurement limits created by arbitration confidentiality. In employment, the overwhelming majority of covered claims never reach any forum. In consumer finance, class settlements over five years made 160 million consumers eligible for $2.7 billion in relief; arbitration produced affirmative relief in 32 disputes totaling under $400,000. Yet structural immunity is not absolute. The Ninth Circuit's October 2024 decision in Heckman v. Live Nation-with certiorari denied October 2025-demonstrates that when corporate procedural engineering becomes sufficiently egregious, courts retain capacity to intervene.

AI.tldr: 平台市场主导地位与强制仲裁结合导致结构性豁免：争议转化率崩溃，小额系统性损害无法获得救济。主要机制是诉求抑制（争议在成为法律事件前被消除），次要机制是结果扭曲（幸存案件受重复参与者优势影响）。
AI.research_question: 当平台市场主导地位与强制仲裁条款结合时，如何形成结构性豁免机制，使系统性小额损害无法获得司法救济？
AI.motivation: 平台经济中强制仲裁条款的普及与市场主导地位结合，导致消费者和员工的小额争议无法获得有效救济，形成系统性不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性豁免框架，整合法律学说、实证仲裁研究和组织选择理论。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与实证证据分析，结合法律案例研究和仲裁数据。
AI.findings: 1. 申请率远低于损害发生率；2. 重复参与者优势持续存在；3. 系统性模式识别失败。就业领域绝大多数索赔从未进入任何程序；消费者金融领域仲裁救济金额极低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出结构性豁免理论框架，解释平台主导与强制仲裁结合如何系统性阻碍争议解决。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示强制仲裁在平台经济中的系统性缺陷，为司法干预提供理论依据（如Heckman v. Live Nation案例）。

title: Sell-Side Analysts in a Market with Effectively Mandated Management Forecasts: Field Evidence from Japan
affiliations: Waseda University - School of Commerce, Hitotsubashi University, The University of Kitakyushu and Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Commerce and Management

detail.title: Sell-Side Analysts in a Market with Effectively Mandated Management Forecasts: Field Evidence from Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was reviewed and approved by the research ethics committee at an author's university. The authors have no financial or other conflicts of interest with external collaborators. There are no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was reviewed and approved by the research ethics committee at an author's university. The authors have no financial or other conflicts of interest with external collaborators.

detail.abstract: We examine the practices, roles, and information use of sell-side financial analysts in Japan, a market characterized by effectively mandated management forecast disclosure. Using survey evidence supplemented by follow-up interviews, we document three major findings. First, despite the widespread availability of management forecasts, analysts do not view them as central analytical inputs; instead, forecasts serve primarily as reference benchmarks, while analysts' perceived value added lies in proprietary analysis based on firm fundamentals, industry conditions, and KPIs. Second, stock recommendations rely primarily on multiple-based valuation approaches, with limited use of cash flow-based models or explicit estimation of the cost of equity, reflecting communication efficiency and alignment with investors' shorter horizons. Third, although analysts consider human and intellectual capital, the use of ESG and nonfinancial information remains limited. Overall, our findings highlight how disclosure regimes and market practices shape analysts' value-adding roles in capital markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查和访谈发现，在日本强制管理层预测披露的市场环境下，卖方分析师并不将管理层预测作为核心分析输入，而是作为参考基准；分析师的价值体现在基于公司基本面、行业状况和关键绩效指标的专有分析。股票推荐主要采用基于倍数的估值方法，较少使用现金流模型或明确估算股权成本。尽管分析师考虑人力资本和智力资本，但ESG和非财务信息的使用仍然有限。
AI.research_question: 在日本强制管理层预测披露的市场环境下，卖方分析师的实践、角色和信息使用方式是什么？
AI.motivation: 日本市场具有强制管理层预测披露的独特制度特征，这为研究分析师在这种环境下的角色和实践提供了机会，有助于理解信息披露制度如何塑造分析师在资本市场中的价值增值作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、分析师角色理论、估值理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 问卷调查证据辅以后续访谈的混合研究方法
AI.findings: 1. 尽管管理层预测广泛可得，分析师并不将其作为核心分析输入，而是作为参考基准；分析师的价值增值体现在基于公司基本面、行业状况和KPIs的专有分析。2. 股票推荐主要依赖基于倍数的估值方法，较少使用现金流模型或明确估算股权成本，这反映了沟通效率和与投资者较短投资期限的一致性。3. 虽然分析师考虑人力资本和智力资本，但ESG和非财务信息的使用仍然有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在强制管理层预测披露制度下分析师的实际角色和实践，挑战了传统关于分析师依赖管理层预测的假设；深化了对信息披露制度如何塑造分析师行为和市场实践的理解；为分析师估值方法选择提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解分析师报告的价值和局限性提供指导；为公司管理层了解分析师如何评估其预测信息提供参考；为监管机构设计信息披露政策提供实证依据；为分析师培训和实践改进提供方向。

title: Updating Patents: The P Index and a Mechanism for Duration-Adjusting Intellectual Property Protection

detail.title: Updating Patents: The P Index and a Mechanism for Duration-Adjusting Intellectual Property Protection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The patent system treats duration as a fixed parameter: twenty years from filing, regardless of downstream impact. Budish, Roin, and Williams (2015) showed that this uniformity distorts R&D investment away from long-gestation research; Lanthier, Nardinelli, and Woodcock (2013) documented that roughly sixty percent of new drug approvals are addition-to-class. We propose a mechanism for making duration endogenous. We introduce P d , a patent importance index computed from weighted forward citations within filing-year and patent-class cohorts, with an adaptive weighting derived as the posterior mean of a Bayesian update on applicant disclosure quality. Extensions are triggered by standard-deviation separation from the cohort mean, not percentile rank: in cohorts where all patents are incremental, no extension is granted. Drawing on the quality ladder framework of Grossman and Helpman (1991) and Aghion and Howitt (1992), we develop a step-function theory of within-class pharmaceutical innovation that distinguishes vertical superiority (climbing to a higher rung) from horizontal branching (expanding indications from the same rung), and predicts which patents become citation nodes and which become terminal nodes. We validate the mechanism using six pharmaceutical drug classes spanning four decades of innovationstatins, ACE inhibitors, checkpoint inhibitors, GLP-1 receptor agonists, direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), and DPP-4 inhibitors-each representing a structurally distinct innovation architecture. In each class, four to five independent data sources (ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, FDA regulatory submissions, adverse event reports, WHO Essential Medicines List) converge on the same importance ranking. In the four classes containing a genuine step-change drug (atorvastatin, lisinopril, pembrolizumab, semaglutide), the predicted drug showsσ separation (z = +1.63 to +2.76). In the two classes without a step-change (DOACs, DPP-4 inhibitors), the mechanism correctly declines to fire-for structurally distinct reasons. The mechanism is blind to revenue by design: apixaban (Eliquis), the highest-revenue drug in the world at approximately $20 billion annually, ranks third in its class and would not qualify for extension. Six classes, six architectures, zero misidentifications. The proposed extension schedule is graduated (six months to three years), evaluated at year 18-19 of the patent term, and smaller than existing Hatch-Waxman patent term restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于专利重要性的专利期限内生机制，通过加权前向引用构建专利重要性指数Pd，根据与同类专利的统计显著性差异（而非百分位排名）决定是否延长专利期限。该机制在六个药物类别中得到验证，能准确识别真正的突破性药物。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于专利重要性的内生专利期限机制，使其能够准确识别并奖励真正具有突破性创新的药物专利？
AI.motivation: 现行专利系统采用固定20年期限，不考虑专利的下游影响，导致研发投资偏向短期项目，而约60%的新药批准属于同类药物增量改进。这种统一性扭曲了研发激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Grossman和Helpman（1991）以及Aghion和Howitt（1992）的质量阶梯框架，发展了阶梯函数理论，区分垂直优势（攀登到更高阶梯）和水平分支（从同一阶梯扩展适应症），预测哪些专利成为引用节点，哪些成为终端节点。
AI.method: 引入专利重要性指数Pd，基于申请年份和专利类别队列内的加权前向引用计算，采用贝叶斯更新的自适应权重反映申请人披露质量。扩展触发基于与队列平均值的标准差分离（而非百分位排名）。在六个药物类别（他汀类、ACE抑制剂、检查点抑制剂、GLP-1受体激动剂、直接口服抗凝剂、DPP-4抑制剂）中使用4-5个独立数据源进行验证。
AI.findings: 在包含真正突破性药物的四个类别中（阿托伐他汀、赖诺普利、帕博利珠单抗、司美格鲁肽），预测药物显示出显著的σ分离（z=+1.63至+2.76）。在没有突破性药物的两个类别中，机制正确拒绝延长。机制设计上不考虑收入因素，如全球收入最高的药物阿哌沙班（约200亿美元）在其类别中排名第三，不符合延长条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专利重要性指数Pd的计算方法，建立了基于标准差分离而非百分位排名的专利期限延长触发机制，发展了区分垂直创新和水平创新的阶梯函数理论，为专利系统改革提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可操作的专利期限延长机制，能够准确识别突破性创新药物，激励长期研发投资，同时避免对增量改进药物过度奖励。提出的延长计划为分级制（6个月至3年），在第18-19年评估，比现有的Hatch-Waxman专利期限恢复更小。

title: Estimating the Term Structure of Corporate Bond Risk Premia

detail.title: Estimating the Term Structure of Corporate Bond Risk Premia

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Understanding how short- and long-term assets are priced is one of the fundamental questions in finance. The term structure of risk premia allows us to perform net present value calculations, test asset pricing models, and potentially explain the sources of many cross-sectional asset pricing anomalies. In this post, I construct a forward-looking estimate of the term structure of risk premia in the corporate bond market following Jankauskas (2024). The U.S. corporate bond market is an ideal laboratory for studying the relationship between risk premia and maturity because of its large size (standing at roughly $16 trillion as of the end of 2024) and because the maturities are well defined (in contrast to equities).

To view post:https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/02/estimating-the-term-structure-of-corporate-bond-risk-premia/

AI.tldr: 该研究基于Jankauskas (2024)的方法，构建了美国公司债券市场风险溢价的期限结构前瞻性估计，利用公司债券市场的规模和明确期限特征来研究风险溢价与期限之间的关系。
AI.research_question: 如何估计公司债券市场风险溢价的期限结构？风险溢价如何随债券期限变化？
AI.motivation: 理解短期和长期资产的定价是金融学的基本问题。风险溢价的期限结构对于净现值计算、资产定价模型检验以及解释横截面资产定价异象的来源至关重要。美国公司债券市场因其规模庞大（约16万亿美元）且期限明确，是研究风险溢价与期限关系的理想实验室。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Jankauskas (2024)的期限结构理论框架，研究公司债券风险溢价随期限变化的模式。
AI.method: 采用前瞻性估计方法，构建公司债券市场风险溢价的期限结构估计，利用美国公司债券市场数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 从摘要中无法直接获取具体研究结果，但该研究提供了公司债券市场风险溢价期限结构的前瞻性估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解公司债券市场风险溢价的期限结构提供了新的估计方法，有助于深化对期限与风险溢价关系的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者进行净现值计算、资产配置决策提供实用工具，有助于金融机构更好地理解和定价不同期限的公司债券风险。

title: School's Out! Now What? Effects of School Closures on Parental Mental Health
affiliations: and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: School's Out! Now What? Effects of School Closures on Parental Mental Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests relevant to the research in this paper. Pursuant to the University of Michigan’s data use agreement, Optum’s de-identified Clinformatics® Data Mart Database (CDM) reviewed this paper prior to its circulation.

The content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Institutes of Health.
